title_en: CFPO: Counterfactual Policy Optimization for Multimodal Reasoning
title_zh: CFPO：多模态推理的反事实策略优化

sentences.en: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in multimodal reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉-语言模型（LVLM）在多模态推理中展现了卓越的能力。

sentences.en: However, prevailing reinforcement learning (RL) paradigms lack explicit counterfactual enhancement and causal learning mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 然而，主流的强化学习（RL）范式缺乏显式的反事实增强与因果学习机制。

sentences.en: This fundamental deficiency results in severe grounding failures, manifesting as a tendency to ignore visual evidence in favor of language priors or exhibiting hallucination drift during long chain-of-thought reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这一根本性缺陷会导致严重的接地失败，表现为在长思维链推理过程中倾向于忽略视觉证据而偏爱语言先验，或表现出幻觉漂移。

sentences.en: To address this root cause, we propose CounterFactual Policy Optimization (CFPO), a novel framework that enforces causal consistency between visual perception and textual reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为从根源上解决这一问题，我们提出反事时策略优化（CounterFactual Policy Optimization，CFPO），一个在视觉感知与文本推理之间强制实行因果一致性的新颖框架。

sentences.en: CFPO introduces a cross-modal counterfactual enhancement mechanism, which regularizes the policy by maximizing the discrepancy between the model’s predictions and those from a counterfactual state where critical visual cues are suppressed.
sentences.zh: CFPO 引入跨模态反事实增强机制，通过最大化模型预测与来自关键视觉线索被抑制的反事实状态预测之间的差异来正则化策略。

sentences.en: This approach seamlessly integrates with standard algorithms like GRPO and DAPO without requiring external reward models or additional supervision.
sentences.zh: 该方法与 GRPO 与 DAPO 等标准算法无缝集成，无需外部奖励模型或额外监督。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CFPO significantly improves reasoning fidelity, achieving consistent gains of 3.17%-6.25% over standard RL baselines and 1.32%-2.13% over the state-of-the-art perception-aware method (PAPO).
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CFPO 显著提升了推理忠实度，相较于标准 RL 基线获得 3.17%-6.25% 的一致提升，相较于最先进的感知感知方法（PAPO）获得 1.32%-2.13% 的提升。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/Raven-July/CFPO.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/Raven-July/CFPO 获取。

title_en: CG-MLLM: Captioning and Generating 3D content via Multi-modal Large Language Models
title_zh: CG-MLLM：通过多模态大语言模型描述与生成三维内容

sentences.en: Large Language Models(LLMs) have revolutionized text generation and multimodal perception, but their capabilities in 3D content generation remain underexplored.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）已经彻底改变了文本生成与多模态感知，但它们在 3D 内容生成方面的能力仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: Existing methods compromise by producing either low-resolution meshes or coarse structural proxies, failing to capture fine-grained geometry natively.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通过生成低分辨率网格或粗糙的结构代理来妥协，无法原生捕获细粒度的几何结构。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose CG-MLLM, a novel Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM) capable of 3D captioning and high-resolution 3D generation in a single framework.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 CG-MLLM，一个能够在单一框架内进行 3D 描述与高分辨率 3D 生成的新颖多模态大语言模型（MLLM）。

sentences.en: Leveraging the Mixture-of-Transformer architecture, CG-MLLM decouples disparate modeling needs, where the Token-level Autoregressive (TokenAR) Transformer handles token-level content, and the Block-level Autoregressive (BlockAR) Transformer handles block-level content.
sentences.zh: 利用混合变换器（Mixture-of-Transformer）架构，CG-MLLM 解耦了不同的建模需求，其中词元级自回归（TokenAR）变换器处理词元级内容，块级自回归（BlockAR）变换器处理块级内容。

sentences.en: By integrating a pre-trained vision-language backbone with a specialized 3D VAE latent space, CG-MLLM facilitates long-context interactions between standard tokens and spatial blocks within a single integrated architecture.
sentences.zh: 通过将预训练的视觉-语言主干与专门的 3D VAE 潜空间相结合，CG-MLLM 在单一集成架构内促进了标准词元与空间块之间的长上下文交互。

sentences.en: Experimental results show that CG-MLLM significantly outperforms existing MLLMs in generating high-fidelity 3D objects, effectively bringing high-resolution 3D content creation into the mainstream LLM paradigm.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，CG-MLLM 在生成高保真 3D 物体方面显著优于现有 MLLM，有效地将高分辨率 3D 内容创作带入了主流 LLM 范式。

title_en: CGRiC: Compositional Risk Certification for Structured LLM Outputs
title_zh: CGRiC：结构化大语言模型输出的组合风险认证

sentences.en: Large language models increasingly generate structured outputs, including citation-grounded summaries, multi-step reasoning chains, and tool-augmented responses, where correctness is inherently compositional: a single flawed claim can invalidate an otherwise accurate response.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型越来越多地生成结构化输出，包括带有引文支撑的摘要、多步推理链与工具增强的响应，其中正确性本质上是组合式的：一个单一的有缺陷论断就可能使原本准确的响应失效。

sentences.en: Existing certification methods treat outputs as atomic units, forcing a binary choice between unsafe acceptance and wasteful rejection.
sentences.zh: 现有认证方法将输出视为原子单元，迫使在不安全的接受与浪费的拒绝之间进行二选一。

sentences.en: We introduce \textbf{Claim Graph Risk Control (CGRiC)}, a framework that decomposes responses into dependency graphs of verifiable claims and assigns calibrated per-claim risk bounds via information-lift statistics.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 \textbf{Claim Graph Risk Control (CGRiC)}，一个将响应分解为可验证论断的依赖图，并借助信息提升统计量为每个论断分配经过校准的风险界的框架。

sentences.en: By composing these bounds, CGRiC provides explicit guarantees on the probability that any incorrect claim passes verification undetected.
sentences.zh: 通过组合这些界，CGRiC 为任何不正确的论断通过验证却未被发现这一概率提供了显式保证。

sentences.en: When this composed risk exceeds a target threshold, the system triggers localized repairs rather than full abstention, preserving correct content while fixing problematic claims.
sentences.zh: 当这一组合风险超过目标阈值时，系统会触发局部修复而非完全放弃，在修复有问题论断的同时保留正确内容。

sentences.en: Our approach explicitly models extraction noise and verifier imperfection, and exploits conditional independence structure for tighter certificates when validated.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法显式地建模提取噪声与验证器的不完美性，并利用条件独立结构在验证通过时获得更紧的证书。

sentences.en: Empirically, CGRiC achieves target risk levels while reducing abstention by 31\% compared to atomic baselines across QA, summarization, and reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，在 QA、摘要与推理任务上，CGRiC 在实现目标风险水平的同时，相较于原子基线将放弃率降低了 31\%。

title_en: CGSVD: Cascaded Granular Singular Value Decomposition for Large Language Model Compression
title_zh: CGSVD：用于大语言模型压缩的级联粒度奇异值分解

sentences.en: The exponential growth in the parameter scale of Large Language Models (LLMs) has precipitated an urgent demand for efficient compression techniques to facilitate practical deployment.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）参数规模的指数级增长，催生了对高效压缩技术的迫切需求以促进实际部署。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, low-rank decomposition based on Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) offers a principled, hardware-friendly pathway for compressing LLMs without retraining.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，基于奇异值分解（SVD）的低秩分解为在不重训的情况下压缩 LLM 提供了一条有原则且硬件友好的途径。

sentences.en: However, existing training-free approaches predominantly rely on uniform rank allocation, implicitly assuming homogeneous redundancy across the model depth and thereby neglecting the inherent non-uniformity of representational evolution.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有的免训练方法主要依赖均匀的秩分配，隐式地假设模型深度上的冗余是同质的，从而忽视了表征演化的固有非均匀性。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce CGSVD, a Cascaded Granular Singular Value Decomposition framework that leverages a dual-level non-uniform allocation strategy to maximize semantic preservation.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 CGSVD，一个级联粒度奇异值分解框架，它利用双层的非均匀分配策略来最大化语义保持。

sentences.en: Specifically, we quantify inter-layer significance via angular distance and assess intra-layer compressibility through spectral entropy, enabling precise identification of critical architectural components.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们通过角距离量化层间重要性，并通过谱熵评估层内可压缩性，从而能够精确识别关键的结构组件。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we propose an Iterative Residual Filling (IRF) mechanism to bridge the parameter gap caused by integer-rank truncation and ensure strict adherence to global compression targets.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出一种迭代残差填充（IRF）机制，以弥合整数秩截断所造成的参数缺口，并确保严格满足全局压缩目标。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on representative LLM families ranging from 3B to 13B parameters verify the superiority of our approach.
sentences.zh: 在从 3B 到 13B 参数的代表性 LLM 家族上的大量实验验证了我们方法的优越性。

sentences.en: Notably, under a 30\% compression ratio on the LLaMA3.1-8B model, CGSVD achieves a remarkable average zero-shot accuracy boost of 6.08% and reduces perplexity by 15.46 compared to the baseline.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在 LLaMA3.1-8B 模型上 30\% 的压缩比下，CGSVD 相对于基线实现了 6.08% 的显著平均零样本精度提升，并将困惑度降低了 15.46。

sentences.en: We release the [code](https://github.com/ironartisan/CGSVD) to facilitate future research.
sentences.zh: 我们发布了 [code](https://github.com/ironartisan/CGSVD) 以促进未来的研究。

title_en: Chain-of-Glimpse: Search-Guided Progressive Object-Grounded Reasoning for Video Understanding
title_zh: 瞥视链：用于视频理解的搜索引导渐进式物体落地推理

sentences.en: Video understanding requires identifying and reasoning over semantically discriminative visual objects across frames, yet existing object-agnostic solutions struggle to effectively handle substantial object variations over time.
sentences.zh: 视频理解需要在帧间识别并对语义判别性的视觉对象进行推理，然而现有的与对象无关的解决方案难以有效处理物体随时间发生的显著变化。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Chain-of-Glimpse, a search-guided progressive object-grounded reasoning framework that explicitly anchors each reasoning step to specific visual evidence regions, enabling compositional and multi-step decision-making.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 Chain-of-Glimpse，一个搜索引导的渐进式对象接地推理框架，它将每个推理步骤显式锚定到特定的视觉证据区域，从而实现组合式、多步骤的决策。

sentences.en: Formally, Chain-of-Glimpse formulates video reasoning as a step-by-step process that incrementally builds spatially grounded traces around task-relevant visual objects, thereby mitigating over-reliance on saliency-driven cues.
sentences.zh: 形式化地，Chain-of-Glimpse 将视频推理表述为一个逐步过程，在任务相关的视觉对象周围增量式地构建空间接地的轨迹，从而减轻对显著性驱动线索的过度依赖。

sentences.en: Specifically, Chain-of-Glimpse features a search-guided controller, optimized via reinforcement learning with a format reward that significantly incentivizes grounding capability, to iteratively ground visual evidence regions and form reliable reasoning trajectories, yielding accurate and interpretable multi-step decisions.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，Chain-of-Glimpse 具有一个搜索引导控制器，通过带格式奖励的强化学习进行优化，该奖励显著激励接地能力，以迭代地接地视觉证据区域并形成可靠的推理轨迹，从而产生准确且可解释的多步骤决策。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations across two categories of video reasoning benchmarks, including general video reasoning benchmarks such as NExTQA, Video-Holmes, CG-Bench-Reasoning, and VRBench, and grounded video reasoning benchmarks such as NExT-GQA, demonstrate that Chain-of-Glimpse consistently improves performance while exhibiting strong robustness and generalization across diverse video reasoning tasks.
sentences.zh: 涵盖两类视频推理基准的大量评估（包括 NExTQA、Video-Holmes、CG-Bench-Reasoning 与 VRBench 等通用视频推理基准，以及 NExT-GQA 等接地视频推理基准）表明，Chain-of-Glimpse 持续提升性能，并在多样的视频推理任务上展现出强稳健性与泛化能力。

title_en: Chain-of-Goals Hierarchical Policy for Long-Horizon Offline Goal-Conditioned RL
title_zh: 目标链分层策略：用于长程离线目标条件强化学习

sentences.en: Offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning remains challenging for long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 离线目标条件强化学习在长时序任务上仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: While hierarchical approaches mitigate this issue by decomposing tasks, most existing methods rely on separate high- and low-level networks and generate only a single intermediate subgoal, leaving several structural limitations in long-horizon decision-making.
sentences.zh: 虽然层次化方法通过分解任务缓解了这一问题，但大多数现有方法依赖分离的高层与低层网络，并且只生成单个中间子目标，在长时序决策中留下了若干结构性的局限。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we draw inspiration from chain-of-thought reasoning and propose the Chain-of-Goals Hierarchical Policy (CoGHP), a novel framework that reformulates hierarchical decision-making as autoregressive sequence modeling within a unified architecture.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们受思维链推理的启发，提出链式目标层次化策略（CoGHP），一个在统一架构内将层次化决策重构为自回归序列建模的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Given a state and a final goal, CoGHP autoregressively generates a sequence of latent subgoals followed by the primitive action, where each latent subgoal acts as a reasoning step that conditions subsequent predictions.
sentences.zh: 给定一个状态与一个最终目标，CoGHP 自回归地生成一系列潜在子目标，随后是原始动作，其中每个潜在子目标都充当一个推理步骤，对后续的预测施加条件。

sentences.en: To implement this efficiently, we introduce an MLP-Mixer backbone, which supports cross-token communication and captures structural relationships among state, goal, latent subgoals, and action.
sentences.zh: 为实现高效实现，我们引入一个 MLP-Mixer 主干，它支持跨词元通信，并捕获状态、目标、潜在子目标与动作之间的结构关系。

sentences.en: Across challenging navigation and manipulation benchmarks, CoGHP consistently outperforms strong offline baselines, demonstrating improved performance on long-horizon tasks.
sentences.zh: 在具有挑战性的导航与操作基准上，CoGHP 持续优于强离线基线，在长时序任务上展现出改进的性能。

sentences.en: Project page: https://wlsdn9350.github.io/projects/coghp/
sentences.zh: 项目页面：https://wlsdn9350.github.io/projects/coghp/

title_en: Chain-of-Thought Gradient Descent
title_zh: 思维链梯度下降

sentences.en: We show that Chain-of-Thought (CoT) expands the expressiveness of Transformer in-context learning (ICL).
sentences.zh: 我们表明，思维链（CoT）扩展了 Transformer 上下文学习（ICL）的表达力。

sentences.en: Specifically, we show CoT enable efficient simulation of In-Context Gradient Descent (ICGD) for $N$-layer neural network.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们表明 CoT 能够为 $N$-层神经网络实现高效的上下文梯度下降（ICGD）模拟。

sentences.en: Different from CoT, a Transformer with fixed depth and hidden dimension has fixed ICL capacity in one forward pass.
sentences.zh: 与 CoT 不同，具有固定深度与隐藏维度的 Transformer 在单次前向传播中具有固定的 ICL 能力。

sentences.en: Simulating larger models or more optimization steps in-context requires deeper or wider Transformers.
sentences.zh: 在上下文中模拟更大的模型或更多的优化步骤，需要更深或更宽的 Transformer。

sentences.en: CoT removes this limitation by providing an expandable workspace via the sequence trajectory.
sentences.zh: CoT 通过序列轨迹提供一个可扩展的工作空间来消除这一限制。

sentences.en: This enables arbitrary-step and arbitrary-capacity ICGD within a constant-depth Transformer.
sentences.zh: 这使恒定深度的 Transformer 能够实现任意步骤与任意容量的 ICGD。

sentences.en: Second, we provide a provable efficient guarantee unique to CoT through dynamical masking.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们通过动态掩码提供了 CoT 独有的可证明的效率保证。

sentences.en: The attention mechanism only process the relevant tokens for the current update step.
sentences.zh: 注意力机制只处理当前更新步骤的相关词元。

sentences.en: This eliminates the redundant ``process everything'' cost of single-pass deep models.
sentences.zh: 这消除了单遍深度模型冗余的“处理一切”成本。

sentences.en: Specifically, we prove this CoT mechanism improves the computational cost of the prior best in-context result [Wu et al., ICML 2025] by $O(N)$.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们证明这一 CoT 机制相较先前最优的上下文结果 [Wu et al., ICML 2025] 将计算成本改进了 $O(N)$。

sentences.en: Numerical validations support our theory.
sentences.zh: 数值验证支持我们的理论。

title_en: Chain-of-Thought Reasoning In The Wild Is Not Always Faithful
title_zh: 真实场景中的思维链推理并非总是忠实的

sentences.en: Recent studies indicate that when faced with explicit biases in prompts, models often omit mentioning these biases in their Chain-of-Thought (CoT) output, revealing that verbalized reasoning can give an incorrect picture of how models arrive at conclusions (unfaithfulness).
sentences.zh: 近期研究表明，当面对提示中的显式偏差时，模型常常在思维链（CoT）输出中省略提及这些偏差，揭示出口头化的推理可能给出关于模型如何得出结论的错误图景（不忠实性）。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that unfaithful CoT also occurs on naturally worded, non-adversarial prompts without adding artificial biases or editing model outputs.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明不忠实的 CoT 也发生在措辞自然、非对抗性的提示上，而无需人为添加偏差或编辑模型输出。

sentences.en: We find that when separately presented with the questions "Is X bigger than Y?" and "Is Y bigger than X?", models sometimes produce superficially coherent arguments to justify systematically answering Yes to both or No to both, despite the contradiction.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，当分别呈现“X 是否大于 Y？”与“Y 是否大于 X？”这两个问题时，模型有时会生成表面上连贯的论证来为系统地同时对两者回答“是”或同时对两者回答“否”辩护，尽管这自相矛盾。

sentences.en: We present preliminary evidence that this is due to models' implicit biases towards Yes or No, labeling this *Implicit Post-Hoc Rationalization*.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了初步证据，表明这是由于模型对“是”或“否”的隐式偏向所致，并将其命名为*隐式事后合理化*（Implicit Post-Hoc Rationalization）。

sentences.en: Our results reveal rates up to 13% for production models, and while frontier models are more faithful, none are entirely so, including thinking models like DeepSeek R1 (0.37%) and Sonnet 3.7 with thinking (0.04%).
sentences.zh: 我们的结果揭示，在生产模型上这一比例高达 13%，而虽然前沿模型更为忠实，但没有一个完全忠实，包括诸如 DeepSeek R1（0.37%）与带思考的 Sonnet 3.7（0.04%）等思维模型。

sentences.en: We also investigate *Unfaithful Illogical Shortcuts*, where models use subtly illogical reasoning to make speculative answers to hard math problems seem rigorously proven.
sentences.zh: 我们还研究了*不忠实的无逻辑捷径*，即模型使用微妙地不合逻辑的推理，使对困难数学问题的猜测性答案看似经过严格证明。

sentences.en: Our findings indicate that while CoT can be useful for assessing outputs, it is not a complete account of the internal process that produced the model's answer and should be used with caution in agentic or safety-critical settings.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，虽然 CoT 对评估输出可能有用，但它并非产生模型答案的内部过程的完整描述，在智能体或安全关键场景中应谨慎使用。

title_en: Chamaileon: Cross-Context Binder Design with Contextualized Modeling and Mixed Sampling
title_zh: Chamaileon：结合上下文化建模与混合采样的跨上下文结合蛋白设计

sentences.en: The rapid evolution of generative models has unlocked new potentials in protein binder design, a pivotal task in structural biology, by facilitating end-to-end generation via joint sequence-structure modeling or hallucination.
sentences.zh: 生成式模型的快速发展，通过促进基于序列-结构联合建模或幻觉的端到端生成，为蛋白质结合子设计——结构生物学中的一项关键任务——解锁了新的潜力。

sentences.en: However, existing approaches are predominantly implemented under a single-target, single-state assumption, limiting their ability to model multi-target or multi-state interactions required for advanced function-oriented protein design.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法主要是在单目标、单状态的假设下实现的，限制了它们对面向高级功能的蛋白质设计所需的多目标或多状态交互进行建模的能力。

sentences.en: Here, we introduce Chamaileon, which unifies multi-target and multi-state binder design by formulating the problem as cross-context binding landscape modeling.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们提出 Chamaileon，它通过将问题表述为跨情境结合景观建模，统一了多目标与多状态结合子设计。

sentences.en: The framework is underpinned by a training paradigm termed \textit{In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD)} for context-aware sequence-structure co-modeling.
sentences.zh: 该框架的支柱是一种被命名为 *In-Context Complex Co-Design (I3CD)* 的训练范式，用于情境感知的序列-结构联合建模。

sentences.en: During inference, we employ \textit{Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS)}, a scalable strategy that optimizes a single sequence across contexts while alleviating the scarcity of high-quality multi-conformational paired data.
sentences.zh: 在推理时，我们采用 *Mixture-of-Paths Sampling (MoPS)*，一种可扩展的策略，它在跨情境优化单条序列的同时，缓解了高质量多构象配对数据的稀缺。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluation on our newly constructed benchmark, \textit{CROSS}, demonstrates that Chamaileon effectively generates sequences adaptable to diverse conformational landscapes and multi-target requirements.
sentences.zh: 在我们新构建的基准 *CROSS* 上的大量评估表明，Chamaileon 能够有效地生成适应多样化构象景观与多目标需求的序列。

title_en: Channel Adapter for Time Series Foundation Models in Zero-Shot Multivariate Forecasting
title_zh: 用于时间序列基础模型零样本多变量预测的通道适配器

sentences.en: Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) have achieved strong performance in univariate time series forecasting.
sentences.zh: 时间序列基础模型（TSFM）在单变量时间序列预测中已取得强劲的性能。

sentences.en: However, most TSFMs rely on channel-independent pre-training that models each variable separately, limiting their ability to leverage inter-channel information that is crucial in real-world multivariate systems.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数 TSFM 依赖通道独立的预训练，即对每个变量分别建模，这限制了它们利用通道间信息的能力，而这类信息在真实世界的多变量系统中至关重要。

sentences.en: Motivated by this limitation, we propose ChaTSFM, a lightweight plug-and-play channel adapter that allows frozen TSFMs to leverage multivariate correlations in a zero-shot setting.
sentences.zh: 受这一局限的启发，我们提出 ChaTSFM，一个轻量级、即插即用的通道适配器，它使冻结的 TSFM 能够在零样本设定下利用多变量相关性。

sentences.en: ChaTSFM first builds a budgeted pre-training dataset to cover diverse heterogeneous inter-channel dependency patterns.
sentences.zh: ChaTSFM 首先构建一个有预算约束的预训练数据集，以覆盖多样异构的通道间依赖模式。

sentences.en: It then uses data-derived domain descriptors to learn a dataset-conditioned inter-channel similarity measure that reduces cross-domain metric distortion.
sentences.zh: 然后它使用从数据派生的域描述符，学习一种以数据集为条件的通道间相似性度量，从而减少跨域度量失真。

sentences.en: Finally, it injects sparse inter-channel information via gated refinement, leveraging multivariate information without degrading intra-channel temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 最后，它通过门控精炼注入稀疏的通道间信息，在不损害通道内时间动态的情况下利用多变量信息。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks validate the effectiveness of ChaTSFM, demonstrating consistent zero-shot improvements over four best-performing TSFMs while maintaining scalable deployment.
sentences.zh: 在九个基准上的大量实验验证了 ChaTSFM 的有效性，展示了对四个表现最佳的 TSFM 的一致零样本改进，同时保持了可扩展的部署。

sentences.en: Code is available at Code is available at https://github.com/Clearloveyuan/ChaTSFM.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 Code is available at https://github.com/Clearloveyuan/ChaTSFM 获取。

title_en: ChaosNexus: A Foundation Model for ODE-based Chaotic System Forecasting with Hierarchical Multi-scale Awareness
title_zh: ChaosNexus：具有分层多尺度感知的常微分方程混沌系统预测基础模型

sentences.en: Foundation models show great promise in achieving zero-shot or few-shot forecasting for ODE-based chaotic systems via large-scale pretraining.
sentences.zh: 基础模型通过大规模预训练，在实现基于 ODE 的混沌系统的零样本或少样本预测方面显示出巨大前景。

sentences.en: However, existing architectures often fail to capture the multi-scale temporal structures and distinct spectral characteristics of chaotic dynamics.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有架构往往无法捕获混沌动力学的多尺度时间结构与独特的谱特征。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce ChaosNexus, a foundation model for chaotic system forecasting underpinned by the proposed ScaleFormer architecture.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 ChaosNexus，一个以所提出的 ScaleFormer 架构为支柱的混沌系统预测基础模型。

sentences.en: By processing temporal contexts across hierarchically varying patch sizes, ChaosNexus effectively captures long-range dependencies and preserves high-frequency fluctuations.
sentences.zh: 通过在层次化变化的块大小上处理时间上下文，ChaosNexus 有效地捕获了长程依赖，并保留了高频波动。

sentences.en: To address heterogeneity across distinct systems, we integrate Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) layers into each ScaleFormer block and explicitly condition the final forecasts on a learned frequency fingerprint, providing the model with a global spectral view of the system.
sentences.zh: 为应对不同系统之间的异构性，我们将混合专家（MoE）层集成到每个 ScaleFormer 块中，并显式地以学习到的频率指纹为最终预测施加条件，为模型提供系统全局的谱视图。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on over 9,000 synthetic systems demonstrate that ChaosNexus achieves superior fidelity in long-term attractor statistics while maintaining competitive point-wise accuracy.
sentences.zh: 在超过 9,000 个合成系统上的大量评估表明，ChaosNexus 在长期吸引子统计方面取得了更优的保真度，同时保持了有竞争力的逐点精度。

sentences.en: Furthermore, in real-world applications, it achieves a remarkable zero-shot mean error below 1°C for 5-day station-based weather forecasting.
sentences.zh: 此外，在真实世界应用中，它在为期 5 天的站点气象预报中实现了低于 1 摄氏度的显著零样本平均误差。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/ChaosNexus.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/tsinghua-fib-lab/ChaosNexus 获取。

title_en: Characterization of Gaussian Universality Breakdown in High-Dimensional Empirical Risk Minimization
title_zh: 刻画高维经验风险最小化中高斯普适性的失效

sentences.en: We study high-dimensional convex empirical risk minimization (ERM) under general non-Gaussian data designs.
sentences.zh: 我们研究一般非高斯数据设计下的高维凸经验风险最小化（ERM）。

sentences.en: By heuristically extending the Convex Gaussian Min–Max Theorem (CGMT) to non-Gaussian settings, we derive an asymptotic min–max characterization of key statistics, enabling approximation of the mean $\mu_{\hat{\theta}}$ and covariance $C_{\hat{\theta}}$ of the ERM estimator $\hat{\theta}$.
sentences.zh: 通过启发式地将凸高斯 Minimax 定理（CGMT）推广到非高斯设定，我们推导出关键统计量的渐近极小极大表征，从而能够逼近 ERM 估计器 $\hat{\theta}$ 的均值 $\mu_{\hat{\theta}}$ 与协方差 $C_{\hat{\theta}}$。

sentences.en: Specifically, under a concentration assumption on the data matrix and standard regularity conditions on the loss and regularizer, we show that for a test covariate $x$ independent of the training data, the projection $\hat{\theta}^\top x$ approximately follows the convolution of the (generally non-Gaussian) distribution of $\mu_{\hat{\theta}}^\top x$ with an independent centered Gaussian variable of variance $\mathrm{tr}\!\big(C_{\hat{\theta}}\,\mathbb{E}[xx^\top]\big)$.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，在数据的集中性假设以及损失与正则化器的标准正则性条件下，我们表明：对于独立于训练数据的测试协变量 $x$，投影 $\hat{\theta}^{\top} x$近似服从 $\mu_{\hat{\theta}}^{\top} x$ 的（一般非高斯的）分布与方差为 $\mathrm{tr}\!\big(C_{\hat{\theta}},\mathbb{E}[xx^{\top}]\big)$的独立中心化高斯变量的卷积。

sentences.en: This result clarifies the scope and limits of Gaussian universality for ERMs.
sentences.zh: 这一结果阐明了 ERM 的高斯普适性的作用范围与极限。

sentences.en: Additionally, we prove that any $\mathcal{C}^2$ regularizer is asymptotically equivalent to a quadratic form determined solely by its Hessian at zero and gradient at $\mu_{\hat{\theta}}$.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们证明任何 $\mathcal{C}^2$ 正则化器都渐近等价于一个仅由其在原点的 Hessian 与在 $\mu_{\hat{\theta}}$ 处的梯度决定的二次型。

sentences.en: Numerical simulations across diverse losses and models are provided to validate our theoretical predictions and qualitative insights.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了跨多样损失与模型的数值模拟，以验证我们的理论预测与定性洞察。

title_en: Characterizing Agents in Production
title_zh: 刻画生产环境中的智能体

sentences.en: LLM-based agents already operate in production across many industries, yet we lack a clear understanding of which technical methods make these deployments successful.
sentences.zh: 基于 LLM 的智能体已经部署于许多行业的生产环境中，然而我们仍然缺乏对哪些技术方法使这些部署取得成功的清晰理解。

sentences.en: We present the first systematic study of Characterizing Agents in Production (CAP) using first-hand data from agent developers.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了第一项使用来自智能体开发者第一手数据对生产中智能体表征（CAP）进行的研究。

sentences.en: We conducted 20 in-depth case studies through interviews and surveyed 306 practitioners across 26 domains.
sentences.zh: 我们通过访谈进行了 20 项深入案例研究，并调查了跨 26 个领域的 306 名从业人员。

sentences.en: We examine why organizations build agents, how they build them, how they evaluate them, and the key challenges they face in deployment.
sentences.zh: 我们考察了组织为何构建智能体、如何构建它们、如何评估它们，以及它们在部署中面临的关键挑战。

sentences.en: Our findings show that production agents rely on simple, controllable approaches: 68% execute at most 10 steps before human intervention, 70% rely on prompting off-the-shelf models rather than weight tuning, and 74% depend primarily on human evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现表明，生产智能体依赖简单、可控的方法：68% 的智能体在人工干预之前至多执行 10 步，70% 依赖对现成模型的提示而非权重微调，74% 主要依赖人工评估。

sentences.en: Reliability—defined as consistent correct behavior over time—emerges as the dominant challenge, which practitioners address through system-level design choices.
sentences.zh: 可靠性——定义为随时间保持一致的正确行为——成为最主要的挑战，从业人员通过系统级的设计选择来应对它。

sentences.en: CAP documents the current state of production agents, providing the research community with visibility into real-world deployment practices and underexplored research opportunities.
sentences.zh: CAP 记录了生产智能体的现状，为研究社区提供了对真实世界部署实践与尚未充分探索的研究机会的洞察。

title_en: Characterizing the Effect of Noise in Language Generation in the Limit
title_zh: 刻画极限情形下噪声对语言生成的影响

sentences.en: Kleinberg and Mullainathan recently proposed a formal framework for studying         the phenomenon of language generation, called *language generation in the limit*.
sentences.zh: Kleinberg 与 Mullainathan 近期提出了一个研究语言生成现象的正式框架，称为*极限语言生成*（language generation in the limit）。

sentences.en: In this model, an adversary gives an enumeration of example strings from an unknown target language,         and the algorithm is tasked with correctly generating         unseen strings from the target language within finite time.
sentences.zh: 在该模型中，对抗者给出来自某个未知目标语言示例字符串的一个枚举，算法被要求在规定时间内正确地生成来自目标语言的未见字符串。

sentences.en: Refined notions of non-uniform and uniform generation were later introduced by         Li, Raman, and Tewari (2025), and a noisy model was introduced by Raman and Raman (2025),         which allows the adversary to insert extraneous strings.
sentences.zh: Li、Raman 与 Tewari（2025）随后引入了非均匀与均匀生成的精确概念，Raman 与 Raman（2025）则引入了一个带噪声模型，允许对抗者插入无关字符串。

sentences.en: A natural question in the noisy model is to quantify the effect of noise,         by studying the impact of each additional extraneous string.
sentences.zh: 带噪声模型中的一个自然问题，是通过研究每一个额外无关字符串的影响来量化噪声效应。

sentences.en: We show two complementary results in this setting.
sentences.zh: 我们在此设定中展示了两个互补的结果。

sentences.en: We first show that for both uniform and non-uniform generation, a single noisy string strictly reduces the set         of collections that can be generated, thus answering an open question in Raman and Raman (2025).
sentences.zh: 我们首先表明，对于均匀与非均匀生成两者，单个带噪字符串都会严格缩小可生成集合的类别，从而回答了 Raman 与 Raman（2025）中的一个开放问题。

sentences.en: Then, we show for both uniform and non-uniform generation that generation with a single noisy string is         equivalent to generation with any finite amount of noise,         sharply contrasting with the strict hierarchy for         noisy generation in the limit shown by Bai, Panigrahi, and Zhang (2026).
sentences.zh: 然后我们表明，对于均匀与非均匀生成两者，用单个带噪字符串进行生成等价于用任意有限量的噪声进行生成，这与 Bai、Panigrahi 与 Zhang（2026）所示极限中带噪生成的严格层级形成了鲜明对比。

sentences.en: Finally, we leverage our previous results to provide the first known characterization for         non-uniform noise-dependent generatability.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们利用先前的结果，为非均匀的依赖噪声的可生成性提供了第一个已知的表征。

title_en: Characterizing the Predictive Impact of Modalities with Supervised Latent-Variable Modeling
title_zh: 通过监督潜变量建模刻画各模态对预测的影响

sentences.en: Despite the recent success of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), existing approaches predominantly assume the availability of multiple modalities during training and inference.
sentences.zh: 尽管多模态大语言模型（MLLM）近来取得了成功，现有方法主要假设在训练与推理期间存在多种可用模态。

sentences.en: In practice, multimodal data is often incomplete because modalities may be missing, collected asynchronously, or available only for a subset of examples.
sentences.zh: 在实践中，多模态数据往往不完整，因为模态可能缺失、异步采集，或仅对部分示例可用。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose PRIMO, a supervised latent-variable imputation model that quantifies the predictive impact of any missing modality within the multimodal learning setting.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 PRIMO，一个监督潜变量插补模型，它量化多模态学习设定中任何缺失模态的预测影响。

sentences.en: PRIMO enables the use of all available training examples, whether modalities are complete or partial.
sentences.zh: PRIMO 使得无论模态是完整的还是部分的，都能使用所有可用的训练示例。

sentences.en: Specifically, it models the missing modality through a latent variable that captures its relationship with the observed modality in the context of prediction.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，它通过一个潜变量来建模缺失模态，该潜变量在预测的语境中捕获其与观测模态的关系。

sentences.en: During inference, we draw many samples from the learned distribution over the missing modality to both obtain the marginal predictive distribution (for the purpose of prediction) and analyze the impact of the missing modalities on the prediction for each instance.
sentences.zh: 在推理期间，我们从学习到的缺失模态分布中抽取大量样本，既用于获得边际预测分布（用于预测），也用于分析缺失模态对每个实例预测的影响。

sentences.en: We evaluate PRIMO on a synthetic XOR dataset, Audio-Vision MNIST, and MIMIC-III for mortality and ICD-9 prediction.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个合成 XOR 数据集、Audio-Vision MNIST 以及 MIMIC-III 上对 PRIMO 进行了死亡与 ICD-9 预测的评估。

sentences.en: Across all datasets, PRIMO obtains performance comparable to unimodal baselines when a modality is fully missing and to multimodal baselines when all modalities are available.
sentences.zh: 在所有数据集上，当某个模态完全缺失时，PRIMO 取得了与单模态基线相当的性能；当所有模态都可用时，则与多模态基线相当。

sentences.en: PRIMO quantifies the predictive impact of a modality at the instance level using a variance-based metric computed from predictions across latent completions.
sentences.zh: PRIMO 使用一个基于方差、由跨潜补全的预测计算得到的度量，在实例层面量化模态的预测影响。

sentences.en: We visually demonstrate how varying completions of the missing modality result in a set of plausible labels.
sentences.zh: 我们直观地展示了缺失模态的不同补全如何产生一组合理的可能标签。

title_en: Characterizing Vision-Language-Action Models across XPUs: Constraints and Acceleration for On-Robot Deployment
title_zh: 刻画跨 XPU 的视觉–语言–动作模型：机器人端部署的约束与加速

sentences.en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are promising for generalist robot control, but on-robot deployment is bottlenecked by real-time inference under tight cost and energy budgets.
sentences.zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对通用机器人控制很有前景，但机载部署受到在严格成本与能耗预算下实时推理的瓶颈制约。

sentences.en: Most prior evaluations rely on desktop-grade GPUs, obscuring the trade-offs and opportunities offered by heterogeneous edge accelerators (GPUs/XPUs/NPUs).
sentences.zh: 大多数先前的评估依赖桌面级 GPU，掩盖了异构边缘加速器（GPU/XPU/NPU）所提供的权衡与机遇。

sentences.en: We present a systematic framework for low-cost VLA deployment via model--hardware co-characterization.
sentences.zh: 我们通过模型-硬件协同表征，提出一个低成本 VLA 部署的系统性框架。

sentences.en: First, we build a cross-accelerator leaderboard and evaluate model--hardware pairs under \textbf{CET} (Cost, Energy, Time), showing that ``right-sized'' edge devices can be more cost-/energy-efficient than flagship GPUs while meeting control-rate constraints.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们构建一个跨加速器排行榜，并在 \textbf{CET}（成本、能耗、时间）下评估模型-硬件配对，表明“恰当尺寸”的边缘设备可以比旗舰 GPU 更具成本/能效，同时满足控制频率约束。

sentences.en: Second, using fine-grained SM tracing and Roofline analysis, we uncover a consistent two-phase inference pattern: a compute-bound VLM backbone followed by a memory-bound Action Expert, which induces phase-dependent underutilization and hardware inefficiency.
sentences.zh: 其次，使用细粒度的 SM 追踪与 Roofline 分析，我们发现一个一致的两阶段推理模式：一个计算受限的 VLM 主干，其后是一个内存受限的动作专家（Action Expert），这会引发依赖阶段的资源利用不足与硬件低效。

sentences.en: Finally, guided by these insights, we propose \textbf{DP-Cache} and \textbf{V-AEFusion} to reduce diffusion redundancy and enable asynchronous pipeline parallelism, achieving up to \(2.9\times\) speedup on GPUs and \(6\times\) on edge NPUs with only marginal success degradation.
sentences.zh: 最后，在这些洞察的引导下，我们提出 \textbf{DP-Cache} 与 \textbf{V-AEFusion}，以减少扩散冗余并实现异步流水线并行，在 GPU 上取得高达 $2.9\times$ 的加速，在边缘 NPU 上取得 $6\times$ 的加速，而成功率仅轻微下降。

sentences.en: The example leaderboard website is: \url{https://vla-leaderboard-01.vercel.app/}.
sentences.zh: 示例排行榜网站为：\url{https://vla-leaderboard-01.vercel.app/}。

title_en: Characterizing, Evaluating, and Optimizing Complex Reasoning
title_zh: 刻画、评估与优化复杂推理

sentences.en: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) increasingly rely on reasoning traces with complex internal structures.
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）日益依赖具有复杂内部结构的推理轨迹。

sentences.en: However, existing work lacks a unified answer to three fundamental questions:  (1) what defines high-quality reasoning,  (2) how to reliably evaluate long, implicitly structured reasoning traces, and  (3) how to use such evaluation signals for reasoning optimization.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有工作缺乏对三个根本问题的统一回答：（1）什么定义了高质量的推理，（2）如何可靠地评估冗长、隐式结构化的推理轨迹，以及（3）如何使用此类评估信号进行推理优化。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we provide a unified perspective.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提供了一个统一的视角。

sentences.en: (1) We introduce the ME$^2$ principle to characterize reasoning quality along macro- and micro-level concerning efficiency and effectiveness.
sentences.zh: （1）我们引入 ME$^2$ 原则，在宏观与微观层面表征推理质量，涉及效率与有效性。

sentences.en: (2) Built on this principle, we model reasoning traces as directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) and develop a DAG-based pairwise evaluation method, capturing complex reasoning structures.
sentences.zh: （2）基于这一原则，我们将推理轨迹建模为有向无环图（DAG），并开发一种基于 DAG 的成对评估方法，以捕获复杂的推理结构。

sentences.en: (3) Based on this method, we construct the TRM-Preference dataset and train a Thinking Reward Model (TRM) to evaluate reasoning quality at scale.
sentences.zh: （3）基于这一方法，我们构建了 TRM-Preference 数据集，并训练一个思维奖励模型（TRM）以大规模评估推理质量。

sentences.en: Experiments show that thinking rewards serve as an effective optimization signal.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，思维奖励作为有效的优化信号。

sentences.en: At test time, selecting better reasoning leads to better outcomes (up to 19.3\% gain), and during RL training, thinking rewards enhance reasoning and performance (up to 3.9\% gain) across diverse tasks.
sentences.zh: 在测试时，选择更好的推理会带来更好的结果（最高提升 19.3\%），在 RL 训练期间，思维奖励能跨多样任务增强推理与性能（最高提升 3.9\%）。

sentences.en: Code is available in the supplementary material.
sentences.zh: 代码可在补充材料中获取。

title_en: ChartE$^{3}$: A Comprehensive Benchmark for End-to-End Chart Editing
title_zh: ChartE$^{3}$：端到端图表编辑的综合基准

sentences.en: Charts are a fundamental visualization format for structured data analysis.
sentences.zh: 图表是结构化数据分析的基础可视化形式。

sentences.en: Enabling end-to-end chart editing according to user intent is of great practical value, yet remains challenging due to the need for both fine-grained control and global structural consistency.
sentences.zh: 根据用户意图实现端到端的图表编辑具有很大的实用价值，但由于既需要细粒度控制又需要全局结构一致性，它仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: Most existing approaches adopt pipeline-based designs, where natural language or code serves as an intermediate representation, limiting their ability to faithfully execute complex edits.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有方法采用基于流水线的设计，其中自然语言或代码充当中间表示，限制了它们忠实执行复杂编辑的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce ChartE$^{3}$, an **E**nd-to-**E**nd Chart **E**diting benchmark that directly evaluates models without relying on intermediate natural language programs or code-level supervision.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 ChartE$^3$，一个**端**到**端**图表**编**辑基准，它直接评估模型，而不依赖中间的自然语言程序或代码级监督。

sentences.en: ChartE$^{3}$ focuses on two complementary editing dimensions: local editing, which involves fine-grained appearance changes such as font or color adjustments, and global editing, which requires holistic, data-centric transformations including data filtering and trend line addition.
sentences.zh: ChartE$^3$ 聚焦于两个互补的编辑维度：局部编辑（涉及字号或颜色调整等细粒度外观变化）与全局编辑（需要数据过滤与趋势线添加等整体性、以数据为中心的变换）。

sentences.en: ChartE$^{3}$ contains over 1,200 high-quality samples constructed via an well-designed data pipeline with human curation.
sentences.zh: ChartE$^3$ 包含由设计良好的数据流水线与人工整理构建的超过 1,200 个高质量样本。

sentences.en: Each sample is provided as a triplet of a chart image, its underlying code, and a multimodal editing instruction, enabling evaluation from both visual and structural perspectives.
sentences.zh: 每个样本以图表图像、其底层代码与一条多模态编辑指令三元组的形式提供，从而支持从视觉与结构两个视角进行评估。

sentences.en: Extensive benchmarking of state-of-the-art multimodal large language models reveals substantial performance gaps, particularly on global editing tasks, highlighting critical limitations in current end-to-end chart editing capabilities.
sentences.zh: 对最先进多模态大语言模型的大量基准测试揭示了显著的性能差距，尤其是在全局编辑任务上，凸显了当前端到端图表编辑能力的关键局限。

title_en: Chasing Moving Targets with Online Self-Play Reinforcement Learning for Safer Language Models
title_zh: 通过在线自博弈强化学习追踪移动目标，构建更安全的语言模型

sentences.en: Conventional large language model (LLM) safety alignment relies on a reactive, disjoint loop: attackers exploit a static model, then defenders patch exposed vulnerabilities.
sentences.zh: 传统的大语言模型（LLM）安全对齐依赖一个反应式的、彼此割裂的循环：攻击者利用静态模型，防御者随后修补暴露的漏洞。

sentences.en: This sequential setup leads to attackers overfitting obsolete exploits while defenders perpetually lag behind emerging threats.
sentences.zh: 这种顺序式设定导致攻击者过度拟合过时的漏洞利用手段，而防御者则永远落后于新出现的威胁。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce Self-RedTeam, the first fully online self-play multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) algorithm that continuously co-evolves attacker and defender for robust safety alignment.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 Self-RedTeam，第一个完全在线的自博弈多智能体强化学习（MARL）算法，它持续地让攻击者与防御者共同进化，以实现稳健的安全对齐。

sentences.en: A single policy self-plays as both attacker and defender, generating adversarial prompts and defending against them, with a reward model adjudicating outcomes.
sentences.zh: 单一策略同时自我扮演攻击者与防御者，生成对抗性提示并对其进行防御，由奖励模型裁决结果。

sentences.en: Each role uses hidden chain-of-thought for strategic planning.
sentences.zh: 每个角色都使用隐藏的思维链进行策略规划。

sentences.en: Grounded in two-player zero-sum game theory, we establish a theoretical safety guarantee: if the game converges to Nash Equilibrium, the defender produces safe responses against any adversarial input.
sentences.zh: 以两人零和博弈论为基础，我们确立了一项理论安全保证：若博弈收敛到纳什均衡，防御者会对任何对抗性输入产生安全响应。

sentences.en: Empirically, Self-RedTeam generalizes across five models from the Llama and Qwen families, uncovering more diverse attacks (+17.80% SBERT) and improving safety of RLHF-trained models by up to 95% across 14 benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，Self-RedTeam 跨 Llama 与 Qwen 家族中的五个模型进行泛化，发现更多样化的攻击（SBERT 提升 +17.80%），并在 14 个基准上将 RLHF 训练模型的安全性提升高达 95%。

sentences.en: Our work motivates a shift from reactive patching to proactive co-evolution, enabling LLM safety self-improvement via online self-play MARL.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作推动从反应式修补转向主动式共同进化，使 LLM 能够通过在线自博弈 MARL 实现安全性的自我改进。

title_en: CHB: A Diagnostic Toolkit for Hardness-Aware Clustering Evaluation
title_zh: CHB：用于难度感知聚类评估的诊断工具包

sentences.en: Clustering is commonly compared through leaderboards that collapse performance into a single aggregate ranking.
sentences.zh: 聚类通常通过排行榜进行比较，这些排行榜将性能压缩成一个单一的总体排名。

sentences.en: Such summaries obscure why methods succeed, which data properties align with failure, and how conclusions shift under representation changes and realistic tuning constraints.
sentences.zh: 此类汇总遮蔽了方法为何成功、哪些数据属性与失败相关，以及结论在表示变化与现实的调参约束下如何发生偏移。

sentences.en: We present CHB, a diagnostic toolkit for hardness-aware clustering evaluation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CHB，一个面向硬度感知聚类评估的诊断工具包。

sentences.en: CHB maps each dataset--representation pair to an interpretable hardness fingerprint capturing (i) separation, (ii) cohesion and scale heterogeneity, and (iii) topology through scalable persistent-homology summaries.
sentences.zh: CHB 将每个数据集-表示对映射到一个可解释的硬度指纹，该指纹捕获（i）分离性，（ii）内聚性与尺度异质性，以及（iii）通过可扩展的持续同调摘要体现的拓扑。

sentences.en: Using this diagnostic space, CHB evaluates clustering algorithms under standardized, compute-aware tracks.
sentences.zh: 利用这一诊断空间，CHB 在标准化、计算感知的轨道上评估聚类算法。

sentences.en: Conditioning results on hardness coordinates turns comparison into diagnosis: across a broad range of datasets and their representations, CHB reveals reproducible structural regimes, uncovers regime-dependent ranking reversals across method families, and surfaces robustness signatures, including topology-linked breakdowns.
sentences.zh: 将结果在硬度坐标上取条件，会把比较转化为诊断：在一大批数据集及其表示上，CHB 揭示了可复现的结构性区域，发现了跨方法族的依赖区域的排名反转，并浮现出稳健性特征，包括与拓扑相关的崩溃。

sentences.en: CHB further enables representation auditing by attributing gains to measurable shifts in the hardness fingerprint rather than just external performance changes.
sentences.zh: CHB 还通过将收益归因于硬度指纹的可测量偏移（而非仅仅外部性能的变化），实现了表示审计。

sentences.en: We release CHB as an open, extensible artifact for evaluating new clustering methods and embeddings within a shared diagnostic framework.
sentences.zh: 我们以开放、可扩展的工件形式发布 CHB，以便在共享的诊断框架内评估新的聚类方法与嵌入。

title_en: Cheap2Rich: A Multi-Fidelity Framework for Data Assimilation and System Identification of Multiscale Physics - Rotating Detonation Engines
title_zh: Cheap2Rich：多尺度物理的数据同化与系统辨识多保真度框架——旋转爆震发动机

sentences.en: Bridging the sim2real gap between computationally inexpensive models and complex physical systems remains a central challenge in machine learning applications to engineering problems, particularly in multi-scale settings where reduced-order models typically capture only dominant dynamics.
sentences.zh: 弥合计算廉价模型与复杂物理系统之间的 sim2real 鸿沟，仍是机器学习应用于工程问题时的核心挑战，尤其是在多尺度设定中，约化模型通常只能捕获主导动力学。

sentences.en: In this work, we present Cheap2Rich, a multi-scale data assimilation framework that reconstructs high-fidelity state spaces from sparse sensor histories by combining a fast low-fidelity prior with learned, interpretable discrepancy corrections.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 Cheap2Rich，一个多尺度数据同化框架，它通过将快速的低保真先验与学习到的、可解释的差异修正相结合，从稀疏传感器历史中重建高保真状态空间。

sentences.en: We demonstrate the performance on rotating detonation engines (RDEs), a challenging class of systems that couple detonation-front propagation with injector-driven unsteadiness, mixing, and stiff chemistry across disparate scales.
sentences.zh: 我们以旋转爆震发动机（RDE）——一类将爆震波前传播与喷注器驱动的非定常性、混合以及跨不同尺度的刚性化学耦合起来的具有挑战性的系统——来展示性能。

sentences.en: Our approach successfully reconstructs high-fidelity RDE states from sparse measurements while isolating physically meaningful discrepancy dynamics associated with injector-driven effects.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法成功地从稀疏测量中重建高保真 RDE 状态，同时分离出与喷注器驱动效应相关的物理上有意义的差异动力学。

sentences.en: The results highlight a general multi-fidelity framework for data assimilation and system identification in complex multi-scale systems, enabling rapid design exploration and real-time monitoring and control while providing interpretable discrepancy dynamics.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了一个通用的多保真框架，用于复杂多尺度系统中的数据同化与系统辨识，能够在提供可解释差异动力学的同时，实现快速的设计探索以及实时监测与控制。

title_en: Chebyshev Policies and the Mountain Car Problem: Reinforcement Learning for Low-Dimensional Control Tasks
title_zh: Chebyshev 策略与山地车问题：低维控制任务的强化学习

sentences.en: We analytically solve the Mountain Car problem, a canonical benchmark in RL, and derive an optimal control solution, closing a gap after 36 years.
sentences.zh: 我们解析性地解决了 RL 中的经典基准——山地车（Mountain Car）问题，并推导出一个最优控制解，弥合了 36 年的空白。

sentences.en: This enables us to reveal two surprising insights: The optimal control is quite simple, yet modern RL agents display a large gap to optimality.
sentences.zh: 这使我们得以揭示两个令人惊讶的洞察：最优控制相当简单，然而现代 RL 智能体却表现出与最优性之间的巨大差距。

sentences.en: Motivated by the analysis of the optimal control, we introduce Chebyshev policies as a universal (i.e. dense) class of RL policies from first principles.
sentences.zh: 受最优控制分析的启发，我们从第一性原理引入 Chebyshev 策略，作为 RL 策略的一个通用（即稠密）类别。

sentences.en: They can be trained as drop-in replacements of neural nets, reducing the regret by a factor of 4.18, while requiring 277 times fewer parameters, fostering sample efficiency, explainability and realtime capability.
sentences.zh: 它们可以被训练为神经网络的即插即用替代品，将遗憾（regret）减少 4.18 倍，同时所需的参数减少 277 倍，从而促进样本效率、可解释性与实时能力。

sentences.en: Chebyshev policies are evaluated on further RL tasks, including a real-world nonlinear motion control testbed.
sentences.zh: Chebyshev 策略在更多的 RL 任务上进行了评估，包括一个真实的非线性运动控制测试平台。

sentences.en: They consistently improve performance over neural nets with PPO, ARS and REINFORCE.
sentences.zh: 它们在使用 PPO、ARS 与 REINFORCE 时，一致地相对于神经网络提升了性能。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate how Chebyshev policies offer a compelling and lightweight alternative or addition to neural nets for low-dimensional control tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，对于低维控制任务，Chebyshev 策略提供了神经网络的一个有吸引力且轻量的替代或补充。

title_en: CHESS: Chebyshev Spectral Synthesis for Trajectory Condensation
title_zh: CHESS：用于轨迹凝缩的 Chebyshev 谱合成

sentences.en: Learning from continuous-time trajectories requires modeling multivariate sensor measurements generated by underlying physical or dynamical processes.
sentences.zh: 从连续时间轨迹中学习，需要对由底层物理或动力学过程产生的多变量传感器测量进行建模。

sentences.en: Under extreme data compression and heterogeneous sampling, directly optimizing synthetic signals as discrete sample values becomes fundamentally misaligned with the underlining \emph{continuous-time physical processes}, often producing high-frequency, non-physical artifacts that overfit specific models and break reuse across architectures and sampling rates.
sentences.zh: 在极端数据压缩与异构采样下，直接将合成信号作为离散样本值进行优化，会与底层的\emph{连续时间物理过程}从根本上错位，往往产生高频的、非物理的伪影，这些伪影过度拟合特定模型，并破坏了跨架构与采样率的重用。

sentences.en: We propose CHESS, a \emph{function-first} synthesis framework shifts optimization from discrete samples to underlying continuous-time signal trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CHESS，一个\emph{函数优先}（function-first）的合成框架，将优化从离散样本转移到底层的连续时间信号轨迹。

sentences.en: CHESS injects physics-induced structure by jointly enforcing low-rank spatial coherence and piecewise Chebyshev polynomial temporal parameterization, constraining synthesis to a physically meaningful function manifold.
sentences.zh: CHESS 通过联合施加低秩的空间相干性与分段的 Chebyshev 多项式时间参数化来注入物理诱导的结构，将合成约束到一个物理上有意义的函数流形上。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical analysis establishing explicit smoothness and stability guaranties.
sentences.zh: 我们提供了确立显式光滑性与稳定性保证的理论分析。

sentences.en: Experiments on diverse sensor testbeds under the dataset distillation protocol demonstrate CHESS consistently outperform state-of-the-art methods with a compression ratios up to $133\times$ for each synthetic sample.
sentences.zh: 在数据集蒸馏协议下于多样传感器测试平台上的实验表明，CHESS 一致地优于最先进的方法，每个合成样本的压缩比高达 $133\times$。

sentences.en: Furthermore, CHESS exhibits strong cross-architecture generalization and enables zero-shot adaptation across different sampling resolutions.
sentences.zh: 此外，CHESS 展现出强大的跨架构泛化能力，并能在不同的采样分辨率之间实现零样本自适应。

title_en: Chiral Symmetry Breaking in Transformers: A Group-Equivariant Framework for Addressing the Reversal Curse via Adjoint Manifold Mappings
title_zh: Transformer 中的手性对称性破缺：通过伴随流形映射解决逆向诅咒的群等变框架

sentences.en: The "reversal curse" exposes a critical asymmetry in autoregressive models, where models trained on facts in one direction often fail to access the corresponding inverse relation.
sentences.zh: “逆转诅咒”暴露了自回归模型中的一个关键不对称性：在一个方向上训练事实的模型，往往无法访问相应的逆关系。

sentences.en: This work studies the phenomenon from a representation-level perspective, characterizing it as a form of chiral asymmetry between subject- and object-oriented latent states.
sentences.zh: 本工作从一个表示层面的视角研究这一现象，将其刻画为主体导向与客体导向潜在状态之间的一种手性不对称。

sentences.en: We introduce the Chiral Transformer, a lightweight framework that encourages an involutive adjoint mapping operator $\mathcal{T}$ through contrastive regularization.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 Chiral Transformer，一个轻量级框架，通过对比正则化鼓励一个对合的（involutive）伴随映射算子 $\mathcal{T}$。

sentences.en: At inference time, Adjoint-Induced Retrieval (AIR) uses this learned map as a structured readout over model-derived entity representations, rather than as an unconstrained autoregressive generation protocol.
sentences.zh: 在推理时，伴随诱导检索（AIR）将这一学习到的映射用作模型派生实体表示之上的结构化读取，而非一种无约束的自回归生成协议。

sentences.en: Empirical validation on inverse-relation benchmarks shows that this symmetry-aware retrieval setting substantially improves inverse factual access, with AIR reaching 65.07% accuracy on Fact-Inv-300.
sentences.zh: 在逆关系基准上的实证验证表明，这种对称感知的检索设定显著改善了逆向事实的访问，AIR 在 Fact-Inv-300 上达到了 65.07% 的准确率。

sentences.en: These findings support a representation-access view of the reversal curse: inverse relations may be difficult not only because of missing data, but also because standard autoregressive readout fails to expose useful latent structure.
sentences.zh: 这些发现支持关于逆转诅咒的一种表示-访问观点：逆关系之所以困难，可能不仅是因为数据缺失，还因为标准的自回归读取无法暴露有用的潜在结构。

title_en: Chunk-Guided Q-Learning
title_zh: 分块引导的 Q 学习

sentences.en: In offline reinforcement learning (RL), single-step temporal-difference (TD) learning can suffer from bootstrapping error accumulation over long horizons.
sentences.zh: 在离线强化学习（RL）中，单步时序差分（TD）学习可能遭受长时序上自举误差累积的问题。

sentences.en: Action-chunked TD methods mitigate this by backing up over multiple steps, but can introduce suboptimality by restricting the policy class to open-loop action sequences.
sentences.zh: 动作分块的 TD 方法通过多步回传缓解这一问题，但会因将策略类限制为开环动作序列而引入次优性。

sentences.en: To resolve this trade-off, we present Chunk-Guided Q-Learning (CGQ), a single-step TD algorithm that guides a fine-grained single-step critic by regularizing it toward a chunk-based critic trained using temporally extended backups.
sentences.zh: 为解决这一权衡，我们提出分块引导的 Q 学习（Chunk-Guided Q-Learning，CGQ），一种单步 TD 算法，它通过将细粒度的单步批评家朝向使用时间扩展回传训练的基于分块的批评家进行正则化来引导前者。

sentences.en: This reduces compounding error while preserving fine-grained value propagation.
sentences.zh: 这既减少了复合误差，又保留了细粒度的价值传播。

sentences.en: We theoretically show that CGQ attains tighter critic optimality bounds than either single-step or action-chunked TD learning alone.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上表明，CGQ 比单独的单步或动作分块 TD 学习都能获得更紧的批评家最优性界。

sentences.en: Empirically, CGQ achieves strong performance on challenging long-horizon OGBench tasks, often outperforming both single-step and action-chunked methods.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，CGQ 在具有挑战性的长时序 OGBench 任务上取得了强劲性能，常常同时优于单步与动作分块方法。

title_en: CINOC: Cardinality-Invariant Neural Operator Policies for Scalable PDE Control
title_zh: CINOC：用于可扩展偏微分方程控制的基数不变神经算子策略

sentences.en: Controlling partial differential equations (PDEs) with learning-based policies remains fundamentally limited by fixed-dimensional representations: policies trained for a specific sensor, actuator, or agent configuration typically fail when the configuration changes.
sentences.zh: 用基于学习的策略控制偏微分方程（PDE），仍然从根本上受限于固定维度的表示：为特定传感器、执行器或智能体配置训练的策略，在配置改变时通常会失效。

sentences.en: This limitation is particularly severe in multi-agent PDE control, where policies do not scale across population sizes without retraining.
sentences.zh: 这一局限在多智能体 PDE 控制中尤为严重，因为策略若不重新训练就无法在种群规模上进行扩展。

sentences.en: We address this challenge by introducing **C**ardinality **I**nvariant **N**eural **O**perator **C**ontrol (**CINOC**), reformulating PDE control as an operator learning problem that maps state fields to continuous control functions and trains them end-to-end through differentiable PDE solvers, yielding policies that naturally adapt to varying sensor and actuator configurations.
sentences.zh: 我们通过引入**基**数**不**变**神**经**算**子**控**制（**CINOC**）来应对这一挑战，将 PDE 控制重构为一个算子学习问题：将状态场映射到连续控制函数，并通过可微的 PDE 求解器端到端训练，从而得到能够自然适应不同传感器与执行器配置的策略。

sentences.en: Remarkably, CINOC policies trained on small swarms exhibit cardinality invariance, allowing for zero-shot transfer to significantly larger populations as well as robustness to partial agent failure.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，在小编队中训练的 CINOC 策略表现出基数不变性，能够零样本迁移到显著更大的种群，并对部分智能体失效具有稳健性。

sentences.en: This scalability arises from agents sharing a common policy and coordinating through their physical environment, which produces an emergent self-normalization effect.
sentences.zh: 这种可扩展性源于智能体共享一个共同的策略，并通过它们的物理环境进行协调，这产生了一种涌现的自我规范化效应。

sentences.en: To explain this phenomenon, we provide a theorem grounded in mean-field theory demonstrating that policy gradients computed from finite-agent systems converge to those of a continuous control limit.
sentences.zh: 为解释这一现象，我们提供了一个基于平均场理论的定理，证明由有限智能体系统计算得到的策略梯度收敛到连续控制极限的策略梯度。

sentences.en: Empirically, we validate CINOC on tracking, stabilization, and density transport across linear, nonlinear, chaotic, and turbulent PDEs.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们在线性、非线性、混沌与湍流 PDE 上验证了 CINOC 的跟踪、镇定与密度输运能力。

title_en: CIRBench: Evaluating Large Language Models as LLVM IR Optimizers
title_zh: CIRBench：将大语言模型作为 LLVM 中间表示优化器进行评估

sentences.en: Large language models are beginning to introduce a new paradigm for compilation: instead of only assisting at the source level, they can operate directly on **intermediate representations (IRs)**, the compiler’s internal code representation, Early studies suggest that LLM-guided optimization can sometimes rival traditional compiler optimizations on selected programs, but evidence remains fragmented.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型正开始为编译引入一种新的范式：它们不仅可以在源码层面提供协助，还可以直接作用于**中间表示（IR）**——编译器内部的代码表示。早期研究表明，LLM 引导的优化有时可以在选定程序上与传统编译器优化相匹敌，但证据仍然零散。

sentences.en: Yet the community still lacks a rigorous IR-level benchmark that tests whether a model not only understands IR but can rewrite it under compiler-grade semantic constraints with meaningful performance impact.
sentences.zh: 然而，社区仍然缺乏一个严谨的 IR 级基准，用以测试模型不仅理解 IR，而且能够在编译器级别的语义约束下重写 IR，并产生有意义的性能影响。

sentences.en: We present **CIRBench**, a benchmark of 800 curated IR instances spanning four compiler-oriented tracks: Analysis infers IR properties, Repair fixes invalid IR, Refactor applies a single semantics-preserving compiler optimization, and Transform performs performance-oriented rewrites, together mirroring core optimization responsibilities in modern compilers.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **CIRBench**，一个包含 800 个精选 IR 实例的基准，横跨四个面向编译器的轨道：Analysis 推断 IR 属性，Repair 修复无效 IR，Refactor 应用单一保持语义的编译器优化，Transform 执行面向性能的重写，它们共同映照出现代编译器的核心优化职责。

sentences.en: CIRBench combines verifier, equivalence checking, and end-to-end performance measurement into a unified, layered correctness-aware evaluation of LLMs on IR.
sentences.zh: CIRBench 将验证器、等价性检查与端到端性能测量结合成一个统一的、分层的、正确性感知的 LLM IR 评估。

sentences.en: On six mainstream LLMs, CIRBench shows that current models fail on many IR analysis and rewriting instances and on median underperform the compiler baseline, but we also observe a maximum speedup of $4.96\times$ over -O3.
sentences.zh: 在六个主流 LLM 上，CIRBench 表明当前模型在许多 IR 分析与重写实例上失败，并且在性能中位数上逊于编译器基线，但我们也观察到相对于 -O3 的最大加速为 $4.96\times$。

sentences.en: These findings highlight both the opportunities and the remaining challenges of using LLMs inside optimizing compilers.
sentences.zh: 这些发现既凸显了在优化编译器内部使用 LLM 的机遇，也凸显了剩余的挑战。

title_en: Circle-RoPE: Cone-like Decoupled Rotary Positional Embedding for Vision-Language Models
title_zh: Circle-RoPE：用于视觉语言模型的锥形解耦旋转位置嵌入

sentences.en: Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) is widely adopted in large language models, but when applied to vision-language models (VLMs) it couples text and image position indices and can introduce spurious cross-modal relative-position bias.
sentences.zh: 旋转位置嵌入（RoPE）在大语言模型中被广泛采用，但当应用于视觉-语言模型（VLM）时，它会耦合文本与图像的位置索引，并可能引入虚假的跨模态相对位置偏差。

sentences.en: We propose *Per-Token Distance* (PTD) to quantify cross-modal positional disentanglement, and we prove that $\mathrm{PTD}=0$ is a sufficient condition to eliminate the geometric attention bias induced by RoPE.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*逐词元距离*（Per-Token Distance，PTD）来量化跨模态位置解耦，并证明 $\mathrm{PTD}=0$ 是消除 RoPE 所诱导的几何注意力偏差的充分条件。

sentences.en: Guided by this criterion, we introduce Circle-RoPE, which remaps 2D image-token coordinates onto an annulus orthogonal to the text position axis, yielding a cone-like geometry where each text token is equidistant to all image tokens while preserving intra-image spatial structure.
sentences.zh: 在这一准则的引导下，我们引入 Circle-RoPE，它将 2D 图像词元坐标重新映射到一个与文本位置轴正交的圆环上，形成一种锥状几何，其中每个文本词元到所有图像词元等距，同时保留图像内的空间结构。

sentences.en: We further propose Alternating Geometry Encoding (AGE) to synergize complementary geometric priors by alternating the decoupled geometry of Circle-RoPE and the grid-based prior of standard RoPE across layers.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提出交替几何编码（AGE），通过跨层交替 Circle-RoPE 的解耦几何与标准 RoPE 的基于网格先验，来协同互补的几何先验。

sentences.en: This design ensures both rigorous cross-modal disentanglement and the preservation of fine-grained intra-image spatial structure, and experiments on diverse VLM backbones and multimodal benchmarks show consistent gains in spatial grounding and visual reasoning.
sentences.zh: 这一设计既确保了严格的跨模态解耦，又保留了对图像内细粒度空间结构的保持，在多样 VLM 主干与多模态基准上的实验表明，在空间定位与视觉推理上取得了一致的提升。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/lose4578/CircleRoPE.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/lose4578/CircleRoPE 获取。

title_en: CircuitPrint: Mechanistic Circuit Fingerprints for Large Language Models
title_zh: CircuitPrint：大语言模型的机制回路指纹

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are trained at significant computational and data cost, making them valuable intellectual property (IP).
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）以巨大的计算与数据成本进行训练，使其成为宝贵的知识产权（IP）。

sentences.en: Existing IP verification methods primarily rely either on invasive watermarking that degrades model utility, or on superficial behavioral signatures disrupted by fine-tuning and model merging.
sentences.zh: 现有的 IP 验证方法主要依赖侵入式的水印（这会损害模型效用），或依赖会被微调与模型合并破坏的表层行为特征。

sentences.en: This apparent trade-off between model utility and IP protection has constrained practical deployment.
sentences.zh: 模型效用与 IP 保护之间的这种表面上的权衡，一直制约着实际部署。

sentences.en: We challenge this trade-off and propose CircuitPrint, a non-invasive IP fingerprinting framework that enables robust verification through standard model queries by leveraging stable internal computational circuits of LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们挑战这一权衡，并提出 CircuitPrint，一个非侵入式的 IP 指纹框架，它通过利用 LLM 稳定的内部计算电路，经由标准模型查询实现稳健的验证。

sentences.en: We show that these circuits function as a persistent computational backbone across model derivatives, allowing them to serve as stable fingerprints for distinguishing LLMs.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，这些电路在模型衍生品中充当持久性的计算主干，从而可以作为区分 LLM 的稳定指纹。

sentences.en: Building on this stability, CircuitPrint constructs IP signatures by identifying mechanistically essential supernodes that causally produce specific predictions within these circuits.
sentences.zh: 基于这种稳定性，CircuitPrint 通过识别在这些电路内因果地产生特定预测的机制上必不可少的超节点，来构建 IP 签名。

sentences.en: Specifically, trigger queries are synthesized to replicate the internal suppression of these supernodes, thereby inducing distinctive and observable output shifts.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，触发查询被合成出来，以复现对这些超节点的内部抑制，从而诱导出独特且可观测的输出偏移。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that CircuitPrint substantially outperforms existing baselines while remaining robust under aggressive fine-tuning and model merging, effectively resolving this trade-off without altering model parameters.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，CircuitPrint 大幅优于现有基线，同时在激进的微调与模型合并下保持稳健，在不改变模型参数的情况下有效地解决了这一权衡。

title_en: CiteGuard: Conformal False-Discovery Control for Faithful Retrieval-Augmented Generation
title_zh: CiteGuard：通过共形错误发现控制实现忠实的检索增强生成

sentences.en: Large language models increasingly rely on retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to ground responses in external corpora.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型越来越依赖检索增强生成（RAG）来将应答扎根于外部语料。

sentences.en: Yet, even with strong retrievers, generated statements can remain unsupported, and the resulting citations are often not reliable indicators of evidence.
sentences.zh: 然而，即使有强大的检索器，生成的陈述仍可能缺乏支持，由此产生的引文往往也不是证据的可靠指标。

sentences.en: We introduce CiteGuard, a RAG decoding layer that treats sentence-level factuality as a multiple-testing problem and combines conformal calibration with false-discovery-rate control.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 CiteGuard，一个 RAG 解码层，它将句子级的事实性视为一个多重检验问题，并将保形校准与错误发现率控制结合起来。

sentences.en: CiteGuard converts claim–evidence scores into p-values for the null hypothesis "unsupported" and uses BH/BY procedures to decide which claims to keep (with citations) and which to abstain on.
sentences.zh: CiteGuard 将主张-证据分数转换为针对“无支持”原假设的 p 值，并使用 BH/BY 程序来决定保留哪些主张（附带引文）以及放弃哪些主张。

sentences.en: On FEVER and Natural Questions, CiteGuard reduces the false-discovery rate among accepted claims from 28–31% (vanilla RAG) to below 10% at α=0.10, while retaining 86–92% of supported claims.
sentences.zh: 在 FEVER 与 Natural Questions 上，CiteGuard 将接受主张中的错误发现率从（香草 RAG 的）28–31% 降低到 $\alpha=0.10$ 时的 10% 以下，同时保留了 86–92% 的有支持主张。

sentences.en: This yields a user-controlled risk budget: practitioners can trade off faithfulness and coverage via α, with finite-sample guarantees under standard exchangeability assumptions.
sentences.zh: 这产生了一个用户可控的风险预算：从业者可以通过 alpha 在忠实度与覆盖率之间进行权衡，并在标准可交换性假设下得到有限样本保证。

authors.name: Xiangyu Jiang
authors.institution: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics

title_en: CL-GCL: Comprehensive and Lightweight Graph Contrastive Learning
title_zh: CL-GCL：全面且轻量的图对比学习

sentences.en: Graph Contrastive Learning (GCL) has significantly advanced self-supervised representation learning on graphs, yet its practical efficacy remains hindered by random augmentations that induce semantic distortion and rigid one-to-one sampling strategy that amplifies inter-class entanglement and intra-class dispersion.
sentences.zh: 图对比学习（GCL）显著推进了图上的自监督表示学习，然而其实用有效性仍受到诱导语义失真的随机增广，以及放大类间纠缠与类内分散的僵化一对一采样策略的阻碍。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we develop CL-GCL, a Comprehensive and Lightweight Graph Contrastive Learning framework.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们开发了 CL-GCL，一个全面而轻量的图对比学习框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, we exploit graph coarsening to preserve structural semantics through community-level representations and manifold learning to capture local geometric relations without costly pairwise distance computations.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们利用图粗化通过社区级表示来保留结构语义，并利用流形学习来捕获局部几何关系，而无需代价高昂的成对距离计算。

sentences.en: This design naturally aligns with the neighborhood aggregation principle of Graph Convolutional Networks, enhancing structural consistency while eliminating negative sampling bias.
sentences.zh: 这一设计自然地与图卷积网络的邻域聚合原则相一致，在增强结构一致性的同时消除了负采样偏差。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove that CL-GCL approximates node-level contrastive loss under mild conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明，在温和条件下 CL-GCL 可以近似节点级对比损失。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate consistent superiority in both accuracy and efficiency over state-of-the-art GCL methods.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在精度与效率两方面都对最先进的 GCL 方法具有一致的优越性。

title_en: CLAA: Cross-Layer Attention Aggregation for Accelerating LLM Prefill
title_zh: CLAA：通过跨层注意力聚合加速大语言模型预填充

sentences.en: Token-ranking heuristics accelerate the prefill bottleneck in long-context LLM inference by selectively processing semantically relevant tokens.
sentences.zh: 词元排名启发式方法通过选择性地处理语义相关的词元，来加速长上下文 LLM 推断中的预填充瓶颈。

sentences.en: However, current evaluation relies on end-to-end benchmarks, making it difficult to isolate the quality of the token ranking itself.
sentences.zh: 然而，当前的评估依赖端到端基准，这使很难单独衡量词元排名本身的质量。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce an Answer-Informed Reference framework with two variants: a Model Reference (Model-Ref) that measures token importance using the model generated answer, and a Ground-Truth Reference (GT-Ref) that uses human reference answers.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们引入一个答案知情的参考框架，包含两种变体：模型参考（Model Reference，Model-Ref）使用模型生成的答案来衡量词元重要性，以及真实标签参考（Ground-Truth Reference，GT-Ref）使用人工参考答案。

sentences.en: Using GT-Ref, we establish that as few as 10% of prompt tokens suffice to match full-context performance on LongBench across all three evaluated models.
sentences.zh: 利用 GT-Ref，我们确立：在所有三个评估模型上，仅需 10% 的提示词元即可在 LongBench 上匹配全上下文的性能。

sentences.en: The framework also reveals that existing heuristics exhibit variance across layers, with rankings degrading sharply at specific layers.
sentences.zh: 该框架还揭示，现有启发式方法在跨层存在方差，排名在特定层会急剧退化。

sentences.en: Motivated by this instability, we propose Cross-Layer Attention Aggregation (CLAA), which aggregates importance scores across consecutive layers, eliminating the layer-dependent accuracy collapse observed in single-layer methods.
sentences.zh: 受这种不稳定性的启发，我们提出跨层注意力聚合（Cross-Layer Attention Aggregation，CLAA），它在连续层上聚合重要性分数，消除了在单层方法中观察到的依赖层的精度塌陷。

sentences.en: A meaningful gap remains between the best heuristic and GT-Ref, indicating theoretical room for improved token selection.
sentences.zh: 最佳启发式方法与 GT-Ref 之间仍存在一个有意义的差距，表明词元选择仍有理论上的改进空间。

title_en: Clarify Before You Draw: Proactive Agents for Robust Text-to-CAD Generation
title_zh: 先澄清，再绘制：面向鲁棒文本到 CAD 生成的主动智能体

sentences.en: Large language models have recently enabled text-to-CAD systems that synthesize parametric CAD programs (e.g., CadQuery) from natural-language prompts.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型近来使得文生 CAD 系统成为可能，这类系统从自然语言提示合成参数化 CAD 程序（例如 CadQuery）。

sentences.en: In practice, however, geometric descriptions can be under-specified or internally inconsistent: critical dimensions may be missing and constraints may conflict.
sentences.zh: 然而在实践中，几何描述可能是欠规定的或内部不一致的：关键尺寸可能缺失，约束可能相互冲突。

sentences.en: However, existing fine-tuned models tend to reactively follow the user’s instructions and hallucinate  dimensions when the text is ambiguous.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有微调模型往往反应式地遵循用户指令，并在文本模糊时凭空捏造尺寸。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose a proactive agentic framework for text-to-CadQuery generation, named as \textbf{ProCAD}, that resolves specification issues before code synthesis.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出一个面向文生 CadQuery 的主动式智能体框架，命名为 \textbf{ProCAD}，它能在代码合成之前解决规格问题。

sentences.en: Our framework pairs a proactive clarifying agent, which audits the prompt and asks targeted clarification questions only when necessary to produce a self-consistent specification, with a CAD coding agent that translates the specification into an executable CadQuery program.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架将一个主动式澄清智能体（它审计提示，并仅在必要时提出有针对性的澄清问题，以产出一份自洽的规格）与一个 CAD 编码智能体（它将规格翻译成可执行的 CadQuery 程序）配对。

sentences.en: We fine-tune the coding agent based on a curated high-quality text-to-CadQuery dataset and train the clarifying agent via agentic SFT on clarification trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们基于一个精选的高质量文生 CadQuery 数据集微调编码智能体，并通过对澄清轨迹进行智能体 SFT 来训练澄清智能体。

sentences.en: Experiments show that proactive clarification significantly improves robustness to ambiguous prompts while keeping interaction overhead low.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，主动式澄清显著提升了对模糊提示的稳健性，同时保持了较低的交互开销。

sentences.en: ProCAD outperforms frontier closed-source models, including Claude Sonnet 4.5, reducing the mean Chamfer distance by 79.9\% and lowering the invalidity ratio from 4.8\% to 0.9\%.
sentences.zh: ProCAD 优于前沿的闭源模型（包括 Claude Sonnet 4.5），将平均 Chamfer 距离降低 79.9\%，并将无效率从 4.8\% 降至 0.9\%。

sentences.en: Our code and datasets are made publicly available on \url{https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/Pro-CAD}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与数据集已在 \url{https://github.com/BoYuanVisionary/Pro-CAD} 公开。

title_en: CLARITree: Cholesky and Lookahead Accelerations for Regression with Interpretable Piecewise Linear Trees
title_zh: CLARITree：采用 Cholesky 分解与前瞻加速的可解释分段线性树回归

sentences.en: Regression trees are among the most interpretable yet expressive model classes in machine learning.
sentences.zh: 回归树是机器学习中最可解释同时也是最具表达力的模型类别之一。

sentences.en: Historically, greedy induction has been the dominant approach for constructing well-performing regression trees.
sentences.zh: 从历史上看，贪心归纳一直是构建性能良好回归树的主导方法。

sentences.en: While optimal methods based on dynamic programming and branch-and-bound exist, they are computationally prohibitive for general linear regression trees, despite often achieving substantially better performance than greedy approaches.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于动态规划与分支定界的最优方法存在，但对于一般的线性回归树而言它们在计算上代价高昂，尽管它们常常比贪心方法取得显著更好的性能。

sentences.en: Recent work has shown that specialized lookahead strategies can dramatically improve runtime while maintaining near-optimal performance, primarily in classification settings.
sentences.zh: 近期工作表明，专门的 lookahead 策略能够大幅提升运行时间，同时保持近乎最优的性能，主要是在分类设定中。

sentences.en: In this work, we develop a novel algorithm for near-optimal, sparse, piecewise linear regression trees that combines a lookahead-style search strategy with efficient rank-one Cholesky updates of the Gram matrix.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们开发了一种新的算法，用于构造近乎最优、稀疏的分段线性回归树，它将 lookahead 式搜索策略与 Gram 矩阵的高效秩一 Cholesky 更新相结合。

sentences.en: We demonstrate, both theoretically and empirically, that our method achieves a favorable trade-off between computational efficiency, predictive accuracy, and sparsity, and scales significantly better than the current state of the art.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上与经验上都表明，我们的方法在计算效率、预测精度与稀疏性之间取得了有利的权衡，并且其扩展性显著优于当前最先进的方法。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: CLASP: Online learning algorithms for Convex Losses And Squared Penalties
title_zh: CLASP：凸损失与平方惩罚的在线学习算法

sentences.en: Addressing Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO), we introduce CLASP (Convex Losses And Squared Penalties), a framework that minimizes cumulative loss together with squared constraint violations.
sentences.zh: 针对约束在线凸优化（COCO），我们引入 CLASP（Convex Losses And Squared Penalties），一个将累积损失与平方约束违反一并最小化的框架。

sentences.en: We propose two variants of CLASP, CLASP-I and CLASP-F, allowing for a joint or separate handling of the static decision set and the time-varying constraints, a decoupling flexibility that affords simpler implementations when projections onto the static decision set are easy.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CLASP 的两种变体，CLASP-I 与 CLASP-F，允许对静态决策集与随时间变化的约束进行联合或分离处理，这种解耦灵活性在到静态决策集的投影很容易时提供了更简单的实现。

sentences.en: Our theoretical analysis departs from prior work by fully leveraging the variety of \emph{cutter operators}, and contraction properties such as the strongly quasi-nonexpansiveness, a proof strategy not previously applied in this setting.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论分析与先前工作不同，它充分利用了\emph{cutter operators}的多样性，以及诸如强拟非扩张性（strongly quasi-nonexpansiveness）等收缩性质，这是一种此前未在该设定中应用过的证明策略。

sentences.en: For convex losses, both CLASP algorithms achieve regret $O\left(T^{\max\\{\beta,1-\beta\\}}\right)$ and cumulative squared penalty $O\left(T^{\\{1-\beta\\}}\right)$ for any $\beta \in (0,1)$.
sentences.zh: 对于凸损失，两种 CLASP 算法对任意$\beta \in (0,1)$都实现了后悔 $O\left(T^{\max\{\beta,1-\beta\}}\right)$ 与累积平方惩罚 $O\left(T^{1-\beta}\right)$。

sentences.en: Most importantly, for strongly convex problems, we provide the first logarithmic guarantees on both regret and cumulative squared penalty: In the strongly convex case, both CLASP algorithms guarantee that the regret is upper bounded by $O( \log T )$ and the cumulative squared penalty is also upper bounded by $O( \log T )$.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，对于强凸问题，我们提供了后悔与累积平方惩罚的首个对数保证：在强凸情形下，两种 CLASP 算法都保证后悔以 $O(\log T)$ 为上界，累积平方惩罚也以 $O(\log T)$ 为上界。
