title_en: Class-Conditional Distribution Balancing for Group Robust Classification
title_zh: 用于群体鲁棒分类的类别条件分布平衡

sentences.en: Spurious correlations that lead models to correct predictions for the wrong reasons pose a critical challenge for robust real-world generalization.
sentences.zh: 导致模型出于错误原因做出正确预测的虚假相关，对稳健的现实世界泛化构成了严峻挑战。

sentences.en: Existing research attributes this issue to group imbalance and addresses it by maximizing group-balanced or worst-group accuracy, which heavily relies on expensive bias annotations.
sentences.zh: 现有研究将这一问题归因于群体失衡，并通过最大化群体平衡或最差群体准确率来应对，而这严重依赖昂贵的偏差标注。

sentences.en: A compromise approach involves predicting bias information using extensively pretrained foundation models, which requires large-scale data and is limited to physically interpretable biases.
sentences.zh: 一种折衷方法涉及使用经过大规模预训练的基础模型来预测偏差信息，这需要大规模数据，并且仅限于物理上可解释的偏差。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we offer a novel perspective by reframing the spurious correlations as imbalances/mismatches in class-conditional distributions caused by general biases, whether interpretable or not, and propose a simple yet effective robust learning method that mitigates the need for bias annotations or predictions.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提供一个新颖的视角，将虚假相关重新表述为由一般性偏差（无论是否可解释）引起的类条件分布失衡/错配，并提出一种简单而有效的稳健学习方法，以减轻对偏差标注或预测的需求。

sentences.en: With the goal of maximizing the conditional entropy (uncertainty) of the label given spurious factors, our method leverages a sample reweighting strategy to achieve class-conditional distribution balancing, which automatically highlights minority groups and classes, effectively mitigating spurious correlations and producing a debiased data distribution for classification.
sentences.zh: 以最大化给定虚假因子下标签的条件熵（不确定性）为目标，我们的方法利用样本重加权策略实现类条件分布平衡，自动突出少数类与少数群体，有效缓解虚假相关，并为分类产生一个去偏的数据分布。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that our approach consistently delivers strong overall performance, and is competitive with methods that rely on bias supervision.
sentences.zh: 大量实验与分析表明，我们的方法一贯地提供强劲的总体性能，并且与依赖偏差监督的方法具有竞争力。

title_en: Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum and Faster Hyperparameter Exploration to Tackle Class Imbalance in Federated Learning
title_zh: 通过类别分组归一化动量与更快的超参数探索解决联邦学习中的类别不平衡

sentences.en: Class imbalance poses a critical challenge in federated learning (FL), where underrepresented classes suffer from poor predictive performance yet cannot be addressed by standard centralized techniques due to privacy and heterogeneity constraints.
sentences.zh: 类不均衡对联邦学习（FL）构成了严峻的挑战，其中代表性不足的类别预测性能差，却又因隐私与异质性约束而无法通过标准的集中式技术来解决。

sentences.en: We propose FedCGNM (Federated Class-Grouped Normalized Momentum), a client-side optimizer in FL that partitions classes into a small number of groups based on minimum within-group variance, maintains a momentum per group, normalizes each group momentum to unit length, and uses the summation of the normalized group momentums as an update direction.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 FedCGNM（联邦类分组归一化动量），一种 FL 中的客户端侧优化器，它根据最小化组内方差的准则将类别划分为少量组，为每个组维护一个动量，将每个组动量归一化为单位长度，并使用归一化组动量之和作为更新方向。

sentences.en: This design both equalizes gradient magnitude across majority and minority groups and mitigates the noise inherent in rare-class gradients.
sentences.zh: 这一设计既均衡了多数组与少数组之间的梯度幅度，又减轻了稀有类梯度固有的噪声。

sentences.en: We further provide a theoretical convergence analysis explicitly accounting for time-varying resampling-rates.
sentences.zh: 我们还提供了一种显式考虑时变重采样率的理论收敛分析。

sentences.en: Additionally, to efficiently optimize these rates in small-client regimes, we introduce FedHOO, an X-armed-bandit (XAB) based algorithm that exploits federated parallelism that evaluates many combinations of two candidate rates per client at linear cost.
sentences.zh: 此外，为在小编号客户端（small-client）的情境中高效优化这些比率，我们引入 FedHOO，一种基于 X 臂老虎机（XAB）的算法，它利用联邦并行性，以线性代价评估每个客户端的两个候选比率的许多组合。

sentences.en: Empirical evaluation on four public long-tailed benchmarks and a proprietary chip-defect dataset demonstrates that FedCGNM consistently outperforms baselines, with FedHOO yielding further gains in small-scale federations.
sentences.zh: 在四个公开的长尾基准与一个专有的芯片缺陷数据集上的实证评估表明，FedCGNM 一贯优于基线，而 FedHOO 在小型联邦中带来了进一步的收益。

title_en: Class-Prior Perturbation-Robust Regularization for Imbalanced Unreliable Partial Label Learning
title_zh: 不平衡不可靠部分标签学习中的类别先验扰动鲁棒正则化

sentences.en: Imbalanced Unreliable Partial Label Learning (I-UPLL) is a challenging weakly supervised learning setting in which severe class imbalance and unreliable candidate labels jointly degrade model performance.
sentences.zh: 不均衡不可靠部分标签学习（I-UPLL）是一种具有挑战性的弱监督学习设定，其中严重的类不均衡与不可靠的候选标签共同使模型性能退化。

sentences.en: By revisiting existing approaches for imbalanced learning, we observe that most of them fundamentally rely on estimating the class prior to guide balancing operations, such as re-sampling, pseudo-label generation, or logit adjustment.
sentences.zh: 通过重新审视现有的不均衡学习方法，我们观察到它们大多从根本上依赖估计类先验来指导诸如重采样、伪标签生成或 logit 调整等平衡操作。

sentences.en: However, under I-UPLL, obtaining stable and accurate prior estimates at the early stage of training is often unrealistic due to the ambiguity and unreliability of partial labels, thereby leading the model to rapidly converge to a suboptimal solution.
sentences.zh: 然而，在 I-UPLL 下，由于部分标签的模糊性与不可靠性，在训练早期获得稳定而准确的先验估计往往是不现实的，从而导致模型迅速收敛到次优解。

sentences.en: To address this issue, we propose CLAPOR, a novel CLAss-PriOr perturbation-Robust regularization framework that fundamentally avoids dependence on accurate prior estimation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 CLAPOR，一个新颖的类先验扰动稳健正则化框架，它从根本上避免了对准确先验估计的依赖。

sentences.en: Specifically, the proposed regularization trains the model under deliberately perturbed class priors, sampled from a Dirichlet distribution that deviates from the current estimated prior.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，所提出的正则化在人为扰动的类先验下训练模型，这些先验从偏离当前估计先验的 Dirichlet 分布中采样。

sentences.en: This design encourages consistent performance under prior uncertainty and naturally preserves attention to minority classes.
sentences.zh: 这一设计鼓励在先验不确定下保持一致的性能，并自然保留对少数类的关注。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of CLAPOR across various settings of I-UPLL.
sentences.zh: 在基准数据集上的大量实验证明了 CLAPOR 在 I-UPLL 的各种设定下的有效性。

title_en: CLEAR: Context-Aware Learning with End-to-End Mask-Free Inference for Adaptive Subtitle Removal
title_zh: CLEAR：结合端到端无掩码推理的上下文感知学习，实现自适应字幕移除

sentences.en: Video subtitle removal is essential for content localization and media re-editing, yet existing mask-guided diffusion methods face critical limitations: training inefficiency requiring extensive annotations and full model fine-tuning, inference complexity demanding explicit mask sequences, and static prior utilization unable to adapt to quality variations.
sentences.zh: 视频字幕移除对内容本地化与媒体再编辑至关重要，然而现有的掩码引导扩散方法面临关键局限：需要大量标注与整个模型微调的训练低效、需要显式掩码序列的推理复杂，以及无法适应质量变化的静态先验利用。

sentences.en: We present CLEAR (Context-aware Learning for End-to-end Adaptive subtitle Removal), a lightweight adapter-based framework addressing these challenges through three technical innovations.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CLEAR（Context-aware Learning for End-to-end Adaptive subtitle Removal），一个轻量级、基于适配器的框架，通过三项技术创新应对这些挑战。

sentences.en: First, self-supervised prior learning (Stage I) extracts occlusion guidance from video pairs using pixel differences as weak supervision, eliminating annotation dependency while learning generalizable subtitle features across languages.
sentences.zh: 第一，自监督先验学习（阶段 I）利用像素差异作为弱监督，从视频对中提取遮挡引导，在消除标注依赖的同时，学习跨语言可泛化的字幕特征。

sentences.en: Second, LoRA-based adaptive refinement (Stage II) enables parameter-efficient training that preserves pre-trained visual priors while achieving true mask-free end-to-end inference without external detection modules.
sentences.zh: 第二，基于 LoRA 的自适应精炼（阶段 II）实现参数高效的训练，既保留预训练的视觉先验，又在无需外部检测模块的情况下实现真正无掩码的端到端推理。

sentences.en: Third, adaptive focal weighting dynamically adjusts prior influence based on local quality assessment, effectively handling diverse subtitle styles and noisy guidance signals.
sentences.zh: 第三，自适应焦点加权根据局部质量评估动态调整先验影响，有效处理多样的字幕风格与含噪的引导信号。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate CLEAR's superior performance in multilingual subtitle removal while requiring only 0.77% trainable parameters, establishing a new paradigm for efficient video text removal without inference-time mask dependencies.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CLEAR 在多语言字幕移除方面具有优越性能，同时仅需 0.77% 的可训练参数，为无需推理时掩码依赖的高效视频文本移除确立了新范式。

title_en: ClimateAR: Multi-Scale Autoregressive Generative Modeling for Climate Forecasting
title_zh: ClimateAR：用于气候预测的多尺度自回归生成建模

sentences.en: Accurate climate forecasting provides critical support for decision-making in agriculture, energy, and disaster preparedness.
sentences.zh: 准确的气候预测为农业、能源与灾害应对中的决策提供关键支持。

sentences.en: Current deterministic models often fail to capture climate uncertainty, while existing generative approaches oversimplify the system by neglecting key spatiotemporal dependencies and cross-scale interactions.
sentences.zh: 当前的确定性模型往往无法捕获气候不确定性，而现有的生成式方法则通过忽略关键的时空依赖与跨尺度交互，对系统进行了过度简化。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce ClimateAR, an AutoRegressive generative model for probabilistic seasonal-to-interannual Climate forecasting.
sentences.zh: 为克服这些局限，我们引入 ClimateAR，一个用于概率性季节到年际气候预测的自回归生成模型。

sentences.en: The framework incorporates two novel components: (1) an aligned tokenizer that bridges and aligns heterogeneous simulation and real-world data to improve transferability across domains, and (2) a mixed-scale conditioning mechanism that captures multi-scale climate interactions for robust probabilistic forecasting.
sentences.zh: 该框架包含两个新颖的组件：（1）一个对齐分词器，它桥接并对齐异构的模拟与真实世界数据，以提升跨域的迁移性；（2）一种混合尺度条件机制，捕获多尺度的气候交互，以实现稳健的概率性预测。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on the ERA5 reanalysis dataset show that ClimateAR achieves state-of-the-art performance, improving anomaly correlation skill by 37.56\% on average compared to leading baselines.
sentences.zh: 在 ERA5 再分析数据集上的大量评估表明，ClimateAR 取得了最先进的性能，与领先基线相比，异常相关技能平均提升 37.56\%。

title_en: CLIMB: Taming the LoRA Residency Cliff in Multi-LoRA Serving
title_zh: CLIMB：缓解多 LoRA 服务中的 LoRA 驻留性能断崖

sentences.en: Multi-tenant multi-LoRA serving multiplexes many LoRA adapters on a single GPU under high utilization, where most device memory is reserved for the KV cache, leaving only a small residency budget $K$ for adapters.
sentences.zh: 多租户多 LoRA 服务在高利用率下将许多 LoRA 适配器复用在单个 GPU 上，其中大部分设备内存预留给 KV 缓存，只给适配器留下很小的驻留预算 $K$。

sentences.en: In this regime, adapter readiness is atomic: if an adapter is not device-resident, the engine must perform a mandatory fetch, stalling shared execution and amplifying tail latency system-wide.
sentences.zh: 在这种情境下，适配器的就绪状态是原子的：如果某个适配器不驻留于设备，引擎就必须执行一次强制取回，使共享执行停摆，并在系统范围内放大尾部延迟。

sentences.en: With only $K$ residency slots, we identify a LoRA residency cliff: once the active adapter working set exceeds $K$, time-to-first-token (TTFT) tail latency can exhibit a congestion collapse rather than smooth degradation.
sentences.zh: 在仅有 $K$ 个驻留槽位的情况下，我们识别出一个 LoRA 驻留悬崖：一旦活跃适配器工作集超过 K，首词元时间（TTFT）尾部延迟就可能表现出拥塞崩溃而非平稳退化。

sentences.en: To tame this cliff, we propose CLIMB, a minimal ingress controller that enforces feasibility-first admission by queueing non-resident adapters outside the engine, prioritizing critical (VIP) traffic, and rotating background adapters via round-robin.
sentences.zh: 为驯服这一悬崖，我们提出 CLIMB，一个最小化的入口控制器，它通过将非驻留适配器排队在引擎之外、对关键（VIP）流量给予优先，以及通过轮询轮转后台适配器，来实施可行性优先的准入控制。

sentences.en: On a cliff-inducing workload, CLIMB averts collapse, reducing VIP TTFT p99 from 38.7 s to 13.1 s at matched throughput (10.66 rps) by keeping VIP engine latency near 0.13 s and shifting the residual tail into explicit ingress queueing.
sentences.zh: 在一个诱发悬崖的工作负载上，CLIMB 避免了崩溃，在匹配的吞吐量（10.66 rps）下，通过将 VIP 引擎延迟保持在接近 0.13 秒并将残余尾部移入显式入口排队，将 VIP TTFT p99 从 38.7 秒降低到 13.1 秒。

sentences.en: Overall, CLIMB shifts fetch-induced stalls from inside the engine to managed ingress queues, mitigating tail amplification without throughput loss in the evaluated settings.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，CLIMB 将取回诱导的停摆从引擎内部转移到受管理的入口队列，在所评估的设定中，在不损失吞吐量的情况下缓解了尾部放大。

title_en: CLINIC : Evaluating Multilingual Trustworthiness in Language Models for Healthcare
title_zh: CLINIC：评估医疗语言模型的多语言可信度

sentences.en: Integrating language models (LMs) in healthcare systems holds great promise for improving medical workflows and decision-making.
sentences.zh: 将语言模型（LM）整合进医疗保健系统，对改进医疗工作流与决策制定具有巨大的前景。

sentences.en: However, a critical barrier to their global adoption is the lack of reliable evaluation of their trustworthiness in multilingual healthcare settings.
sentences.zh: 然而，阻碍其全球采用的一个关键障碍是：在多语言医疗保健环境下，缺乏对其可信度的可靠评估。

sentences.en: Existing LMs are predominantly trained in high-resource languages, making them ill-equipped to handle the complexity and diversity of healthcare queries in mid- and low-resource languages, which poses significant challenges for deployment in global healthcare contexts where linguistic diversity is essential.
sentences.zh: 现有 LM 主要在高资源语言上训练，使其难以应对中低资源语言中医疗查询的复杂性与多样性，这在语言多样性至关重要的全球医疗情境中，对其部署构成了重大挑战。

sentences.en: In this work, we present CLINIC, a Comprehensive Multilingual Benchmark to evaluate the trustworthiness of language models in healthcare.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 CLINIC，一个全面的多语言基准，用于评估医疗保健领域语言模型的可信度。

sentences.en: CLINIC systematically benchmarks LMs across five key dimensions of trustworthiness: truthfulness, fairness, safety, robustness, and privacy, operationalized through 18 diverse tasks spanning 15 languages and covering a wide range of critical healthcare topics.
sentences.zh: CLINIC 在可信度的五个关键维度上系统地对 LM 进行基准测试：真实性、公平性、安全性、稳健性与隐私性，通过 18 个多样的任务加以落地，覆盖 15 种语言与广泛的关键医疗主题。

sentences.en: Our extensive evaluation reveals that LMs struggle with factual correctness, demonstrate bias across demographic and linguistic groups, and remain susceptible to privacy breaches and adversarial attacks.
sentences.zh: 我们的大量评估揭示，LM 在事实正确性上表现挣扎，在人口统计群体与语言群体之间表现出偏差，并且仍然容易受到隐私泄露与对抗性攻击的影响。

sentences.en: By highlighting these shortcomings, CLINIC lays the foundation for enhancing the global reach and safety of LMs in healthcare across diverse languages.
sentences.zh: 通过凸显这些不足，CLINIC 为提升 LM 在跨多样语言的医疗保健中的全球覆盖与安全性奠定了基础。

title_en: CLINIC: Towards High-quality Graph Out-Of-Distribution Detection
title_zh: CLINIC：迈向高质量图分布外检测

sentences.en: This paper studies the problem of graph out-of-distribution (OOD) detection, which aims to identify anomaly graphs out of a graph dataset.
sentences.zh: 本文研究图分布外（OOD）检测问题，其目标是从图数据集中识别出异常图。

sentences.en: Prior efforts usually focus on the utilization of topological structures with unsupervised graph learning to foster typical pattern recognition, which overlooks the semantic structure preserved in contextually affine neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 先前的努力通常聚焦于利用拓扑结构与无监督图学习来促进典型模式识别，这忽视了语境仿射邻域中保存的语义结构。

sentences.en: Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Contextual Affinity Exploration with Twin Concordance (CLINIC) for graph OOD detection.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们提出一种名为上下文亲和性探索与孪生一致性（CLINIC）的新方法，用于图 OOD 检测。

sentences.en: The core of CLINIC is to explore and exploit the contextual affinity of the graph data samples for discriminative graph representations.
sentences.zh: CLINIC 的核心是探索并利用图数据样本的上下文亲和性，以获得有区分力的图表示。

sentences.en: In particular, our CLINIC first builds a contextual affinity graph to depict the semantic structure in the hidden space.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们的 CLINIC 首先构建一个上下文亲和图，以刻画隐藏空间中的语义结构。

sentences.en: More importantly, we introduce high-order affinity to enhance geometric understanding of the structure by utilizing a meta-graph neural network.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，我们引入高阶亲和性，通过元图神经网络增强对结构的几何理解。

sentences.en: To enhance representation discriminability with high robustness, we introduce twin concordance learning, which not only minimizes the difference of affinity distributions across different views, but also encourages the consistency between contextually affinitive neighbors.
sentences.zh: 为在高鲁棒性下增强表示的区分性，我们引入孪生一致性学习，它不仅最小化不同视图之间亲和性分布的差异，还鼓励上下文亲和邻居之间的一致性。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce a compression strategy to expand the decision boundary for enhanced separation between in-distribution and out-of-distribution graphs.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入一种压缩策略来扩展决策边界，以增强分布内图与分布外图之间的分离。

sentences.en: Extensive experimental results demonstrate the superiority of our CLINIC across ten real datasets in comparison to various baselines.
sentences.zh: 大量实验结果表明，与各种基线相比，我们的 CLINIC 在十个真实数据集上具有优越性。

title_en: ClinTutor-R1: Advancing Scalable and Robust One-to-Many Alignment in Clinical Socratic Education
title_zh: ClinTutor-R1：推进临床苏格拉底式教学中可扩展且鲁棒的一对多对齐

sentences.en: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable success in dyadic (one-on-one) instruction, they face significant challenges in One-to-Many alignment, such as clinical ward rounds, where an instructor must simultaneously guide a diverse group of trainees.
sentences.zh: 虽然大语言模型（LLM）在二元（一对一）教学中取得了显著成功，但它们在面向一对多对齐（例如临床查房）时面临重大挑战，因为此时教师必须同时引导一群多样化的受训者。

sentences.en: Current models often suffer from context dilution and goal misalignment, failing to balance individual scaffolding with collective learning progress.
sentences.zh: 当前的模型往往受困于语境稀释与目标错位，无法在个性化支架与集体学习进度之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: To address this, we introduce ClinEdu, a multi-agent pedagogical simulator that model the complexity of group dynamics.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们引入 ClinEdu，一个多智能体教学模拟器，它建模群体动力学的复杂性。

sentences.en: Leveraging this platform, we construct ClinTeach, a large-scale dataset of Socratic teaching dialogues, and propose ClinTutor-R1, the first multimodal agent explicitly architected to achieve one-to-many alignment in clinical education, employing an explicit internal thinking mechanism to model both individual belief states and group consensus.
sentences.zh: 利用这一平台，我们构建了 ClinTeach，一个大规模的苏格拉底式教学对话数据集，并提出 ClinTutor-R1，第一个专门设计用于在临床教育中实现一对多对齐的多模态智能体，它采用显式的内部思考机制来同时建模个体信念状态与群体共识。

sentences.en: We validate our framework through a comprehensive protocol covering both standard static benchmarks and rigorous in-situ interactive evaluation within ClinEdu.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个全面的协议验证我们的框架，该协议涵盖标准的静态基准与在 ClinEdu 内的严格现场交互式评估。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that ClinTutor-R1 outperforms base models by over 20% and achieves parity with proprietary reasoning models , while exhibiting exceptional scalability in maintaining instructional quality across expanding student cohorts.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，ClinTutor-R1 在基准模型之上提升了超过 20%，并与专有推理模型达到同等水平，同时在不断扩大的学生群体中保持教学质量的出色可扩展性。

title_en: CLIP Tricks You: Training-free Token Pruning for Efficient Pixel Grounding in Large Vision-Language Models
title_zh: CLIP 的妙招：通过无需训练的词元剪枝实现大型视觉语言模型高效像素定位

sentences.en: In large vision-language models, visual tokens typically constitute the majority of input tokens, leading to substantial computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 在大型视觉-语言模型中，视觉词元通常构成输入词元的多数，导致大量的计算开销。

sentences.en: To address this, recent studies have explored pruning redundant or less informative visual tokens for image understanding tasks.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，近期研究探索了为图像理解任务剪掉冗余或信息量较少的视觉词元。

sentences.en: However, these methods struggle with pixel grounding tasks, where token importance is highly contingent on the input text.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法在像素接地任务上表现挣扎，因为在那些任务中词元重要性高度依赖于输入文本。

sentences.en: Through an in-depth analysis of CLIP, we observe that visual tokens within referent regions often exhibit low similarity to their textual representation.
sentences.zh: 通过对 CLIP 的深入分析，我们观察到指示区域内的视觉词元往往与其文本表示具有较低的相似性。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we introduce LiteLVLM, a training-free, text-guided token pruning strategy for efficient pixel grounding inference.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞察的启发，我们引入 LiteLVLM，一种免训练的、文本引导的词元剪枝策略，用于高效的像素接地推理。

sentences.en: By reversing the ranking of CLIP's visual-text similarity, LiteLVLM effectively retains visual tokens covering the referent regions, while recovering context tokens to enable clear foreground-background separation.
sentences.zh: 通过逆转 CLIP 的视觉-文本相似度排名，LiteLVLM 有效地保留了覆盖指示区域的视觉词元，同时恢复上下文词元以实现清晰的前景-背景分离。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that LiteLVLM significantly outperforms existing methods by over 5% across diverse token budgets.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，在不同的词元预算下，LiteLVLM 显著优于现有方法超过 5%。

sentences.en: Without any training or fine-tuning, LiteLVLM maintains 90% of the original performance with a 22% speedup and a 2.3$\times$ memory reduction.
sentences.zh: 无需任何训练或微调，LiteLVLM 就能以 22% 的加速与 2.3$\times$ 的内存缩减，保持原始性能的 90%。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/sejong-rcv/LiteLVLM.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码可在 https://github.com/sejong-rcv/LiteLVLM 获取。

title_en: Clipped Q-Learning: Your Value Clipping Is Secretly A Robust Operator
title_zh: 裁剪 Q 学习：价值裁剪其实是一种鲁棒算子

sentences.en: We study a simple yet principled modification of classical Q-learning that clips the value estimate in the Bellman backup by a threshold $\lambda$.
sentences.zh: 我们研究经典 Q 学习的一个简单而有原则的修改：在 Bellman 回传中通过一个阈值 $\lambda$ 裁剪价值估计。

sentences.en: The resulting algorithm, clipped Q-learning, is motivated by a key theoretical insight: the clipped Bellman backup is an unbiased one-sample estimation of a robust Bellman operator arising naturally from a transition-regularized MDP framework.
sentences.zh: 由此得到的算法——裁剪 Q 学习——由一个关键的理论洞察驱动：裁剪的 Bellman 回传是一个稳健 Bellman 算子的无偏单样本估计，该算子自然地产生于一个转移正则化的 MDP 框架。

sentences.en: This formulation corresponds to optimizing performance against a specific class of adversarial dynamics perturbations at the test time that reallocate transition probability mass away from high-value states, thereby inducing conservative but stable decision making.
sentences.zh: 这一形式化对应于在测试时针对一类特定的对抗性动力学扰动优化性能，这类扰动将转移概率质量从高价值状态重新分配出去，从而诱导保守但稳定的决策。

sentences.en: Under this interpretation, clipped Q-learning can be viewed as tracking the fixed point of the robust Bellman equation and learning policies that hedge against adversarial dynamics shifts at test time.
sentences.zh: 在此解释下，裁剪 Q 学习可以被视为追踪稳健 Bellman 方程的固定点，并学习在测试时对冲对抗性动力学偏移的策略。

sentences.en: We analyze two clipped Q-learning variants with an optimistic exploration bonus and establish polynomial regret guarantees, demonstrating statistical efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们分析了带有乐观探索奖励的两种裁剪 Q 学习变体，并确立了多项式遗憾保证，证明了其统计效率。

sentences.en: Beyond the tabular setting, our framework suggests that value clipping is a modular mechanism that can be incorporated into general value-based RL algorithms with function approximation.
sentences.zh: 除了表格设定之外，我们的框架表明，价值裁剪是一个模块化机制，可以被整合进带函数逼近的一般基于价值的 RL 算法中。

sentences.en: As a proof of concept, we evaluate a clipped Double DQN algorithm on a control task and observe robustness improvements consistent with our theoretical predictions.
sentences.zh: 作为概念验证，我们在一个控制任务上评估了一个裁剪 Double DQN 算法，并观察到与我们的理论预测一致的稳健性改进。

title_en: Clipping Bottleneck: Stabilizing RLVR via Stochastic Recovery of Near-Boundary Signals
title_zh: 裁剪瓶颈：通过随机恢复近边界信号稳定可验证奖励强化学习

sentences.en: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a central paradigm for scaling LLM reasoning, yet its optimization often suffers from training instability and suboptimal convergence.
sentences.zh: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为扩展 LLM 推理的核心范式，然而其优化常常遭受训练不稳定与次优收敛的困扰。

sentences.en: Through a systematic dissection of clipping-based GRPO-style objectives, we identify the rigid clipping decision induced by hard clipping as a key practical bottleneck in the studied RLVR setups.
sentences.zh: 通过对基于裁剪的 GRPO 风格目标进行系统性剖析，我们识别出硬裁剪所引入的刚性裁剪决策，是所研究 RLVR 设定中的一个关键实际瓶颈。

sentences.en: Specifically, our analysis suggests that informative signals can lie in the **near-boundary** region just beyond the clipping threshold, and are therefore discarded by the standard hard-clipping rule.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们的分析表明，有信息量的信号可以位于裁剪阈值之外、恰好在**近边界**区域，因而被标准的硬裁剪规则丢弃。

sentences.en: Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose **Near-boundary Stochastic Rescue (NSR)**, a minimal, plug-and-play modification that stochastically retains these slightly out-of-bound tokens to recover lost signals.
sentences.zh: 受这一诊断的启发，我们提出**近边界随机救援（NSR）**，一个极简的、即插即用的修改，它随机保留这些略微越界的词元，以恢复丢失的信号。

sentences.en: While NSR, via stochastic sampling, can be interpreted as inducing an implicit gradient decay in expectation, our ablations reveal that its stochastic, boundary-local rescue mechanism is consistently more effective than deterministic gradient decay.
sentences.zh: 虽然 NSR 通过随机采样可以被解释为在期望上诱导隐式梯度衰减，但我们的消融揭示，其随机的、边界局部的救援机制一贯地比确定性梯度衰减更有效。

sentences.en: Validated by extensive experiments across model sizes from 7B to 30B and both dense and MoE architectures, as a plug-and-play solution, NSR substantially improves training stability and delivers consistent gains over strong baselines such as DAPO and GSPO.
sentences.zh: 在从 7B 到 30B 的模型规模以及稠密与 MoE 两种架构上的大量实验验证下，作为一种即插即用的解决方案，NSR 显著提升了训练稳定性，并在 DAPO 与 GSPO 等强基线上带来了一致的收益。

sentences.en: Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/qwenpilot/NSR.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码公开于 https://github.com/qwenpilot/NSR 。

title_en: Clipping Low-Probability Tokens in SFT Yields a Generalizable Initialization for RL
title_zh: 在监督微调中裁剪低概率词元，为强化学习提供可泛化的初始化

sentences.en: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is a critical step for adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specialized domains, often serving as an initialization for subsequent reinforcement learning (RL).
sentences.zh: 监督微调（SFT）是将大语言模型（LLM）适配到专门领域的关键步骤，通常充当后续强化学习（RL）的初始化。

sentences.en: However, SFT can overfit a small set of expert data, harming generalization and eroding prior knowledge.
sentences.zh: 然而，SFT 可能过度拟合一小部分专家数据，损害泛化能力并侵蚀先验知识。

sentences.en: This can limit downstream RL, which benefits from a strong, generalizable initialization for exploration.
sentences.zh: 这可能限制下游 RL，因为下游 RL 受益于一个强健的、可泛化的初始化来进行探索。

sentences.en: Here, we demonstrate that prior knowledge degradation primarily results from tokens in the expert data to which the base model assigns low probability.
sentences.zh: 在此，我们证明先验知识的退化主要源于专家数据中基础模型赋予低概率的那些词元。

sentences.en: Specifically, these low-probability tokens represent a significant deviation from the model’s current prior knowledge.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，这些低概率词元代表了与模型当前先验知识的显著偏离。

sentences.en: Due to the nature of the log-likelihood objective, they produce larger gradient magnitudes, which speed up adaptation to the new data but degrade generalization.
sentences.zh: 由于对数似然目标的特性，它们产生更大的梯度幅度，这加速了对新数据的适应，却损害了泛化。

sentences.en: In this paper, we study the token-wise clipping strategy, a commonly used trust-region method for bounding per-token updates.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们研究了逐词元裁剪策略，一种常用的、用于限制每次词元更新的置信域方法。

sentences.en: We find that it reshapes token-level learning priorities, promoting more progressive adaptation that fits the new data while preserving general abilities.
sentences.zh: 我们发现它重塑了词元级的学习优先级，促进了更渐进的适应，在拟合新数据的同时保留了通用能力。

sentences.en: Compared with standard SFT, clipping low-probability tokens reduces out-of-distribution forgetting by 11.54\% and improves final RL performance by 7.09\% across the agentic benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 与标准 SFT 相比，裁剪低概率词元在智能体基准上将分布外遗忘降低了 11.54\%，并将最终 RL 性能提升了 7.09\%。

sentences.en: Moreover, latent-space analysis shows smaller representational drift under clipping, indicating that it provides a generalizable initialization.
sentences.zh: 此外，潜在空间分析表明，在裁剪下表示漂移更小，表明它提供了可泛化的初始化。

title_en: Clipping Makes Distributed and Federated Asynchronous SGD Robust to Stragglers
title_zh: 裁剪使分布式与联邦异步随机梯度下降对慢节点更鲁棒

sentences.en: In modern machine learning, parallelization of training is an important strategy for increasing scale.
sentences.zh: 在现代机器学习中，训练并行化是扩大规模的重要策略。

sentences.en: Asynchronous stochastic gradient descent (ASGD), which maximally utilizes available hardware, avoids having to wait for slow workers.
sentences.zh: 异步随机梯度下降（ASGD）最大化利用可用硬件，避免了等待慢速工作节点。

sentences.en: However, with constant step sizes, the convergence of ASGD is nonetheless negatively effected by slow workers due to large delays in updates.
sentences.zh: 然而，在恒定步长下，ASGD 的收敛仍会因慢速工作节点带来的大更新延迟而受到负面影响。

sentences.en: At the same time, it has been empirically observed in asynchronous training of deep learning models that gradient clipping ``stabilizes'' training.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，在深度学习模型的异步训练中，经验观察到梯度裁剪能够“稳定”训练。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a theoretical justification for this behavior, as we show that clipping removes the dependence of the maximum delay in the oracle complexity.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们为这一行为提供了理论依据，我们表明裁剪消除了 oracle 复杂度中对最大延迟的依赖。

sentences.en: We employ a sub-Weibull model of gradient noise which generalize sub-Gaussian and sub-exponential disitributions to more heavy-tailed distributions, motivated by empirical observations in deep learning.
sentences.zh: 我们采用一种次 Weibull 梯度噪声模型，它将次高斯与次指数分布推广到更重尾的分布，这受深度学习经验观察的启发。

sentences.en: We show convergence in expectation, and for the first time in asynchronous optimization, convergence with high probability.
sentences.zh: 我们证明了在期望上的收敛，并且首次在异步优化中证明了高概率收敛。

title_en: Closing the Expression Gap in LLM Instructions via Socratic Questioning
title_zh: 通过苏格拉底式提问弥合大语言模型指令的表达差距

sentences.en: A fundamental bottleneck in human-AI collaboration is the ``intention expression gap", the difficulty for humans to effectively convey complex, high-dimensional thoughts to AI.
sentences.zh: 人机协作中的一个根本瓶颈是“意图表达鸿沟”，即人类难以向 AI 有效传达复杂、高维的思想。

sentences.en: This challenge often traps users in inefficient trial-and-error loops and is exacerbated by the diverse expertise levels of users.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战常常使用户陷入低效的试错循环，并且因用户专业水平的差异而加剧。

sentences.en: We reframe this problem from passive instruction following to a Socratic collaboration paradigm, proposing an agent that actively probes for information to resolve its uncertainty about user intent.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一问题从被动执行指令重构为一种苏格拉底式协作范式，提出一个主动探查信息以消解其对用户意图不确定性的智能体。

sentences.en: We name the proposed agent Nous, trained to acquire proficiency in this inquiry policy.
sentences.zh: 我们将所提出的智能体命名为 Nous，训练它习得这一询问策略的能力。

sentences.en: The core mechanism of Nous is a training framework grounded in the first principles of information theory.
sentences.zh: Nous 的核心机制是一个以信息论第一性原理为基础的训练框架。

sentences.en: Within this framework, we define the information gain from dialogue as an intrinsic reward signal, which is fundamentally equivalent to the reduction of Shannon entropy over a structured task space.
sentences.zh: 在此框架内，我们将在结构化任务空间上的对话信息增益定义为内在奖励信号，它本质上等价于香农熵的减少。

sentences.en: This reward design enables us to avoid reliance on costly human preference annotations or external reward models.
sentences.zh: 这一奖励设计使我们能够避免依赖昂贵的人工偏好标注或外部奖励模型。

sentences.en: To validate our framework, we develop an automated simulation pipeline to generate a large-scale, preference-based dataset for the challenging task of scientific diagram generation.
sentences.zh: 为验证我们的框架，我们开发了一条自动化仿真流水线，为科学图解生成这一具有挑战性的任务生成一个大规模、基于偏好的数据集。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments, including ablations, subjective and objective evaluations, and tests across user expertise levels, demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed framework.
sentences.zh: 包括消融、主观与客观评估以及跨用户专业水平测试在内的全面实验，证明了我们所提框架的有效性。

sentences.en: Nous achieves leading efficiency and output quality, while remaining robust to varying user expertise.
sentences.zh: Nous 在保持对多变用户专业水平稳健的同时，实现了领先的效率与输出质量。

sentences.en: Our research provides a systematic methodology and a new perspective for addressing  ambiguous intentions in complex human-machine collaboration.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究为应对复杂人机协作中的模糊意图提供了一套系统的方法论与新的视角。

title_en: Closing the Loop: Universal Repository Representation with RPG-Encoder
title_zh: 闭合循环：利用 RPG-Encoder 实现通用代码仓库表征

sentences.en: Current repository agents encounter a reasoning disconnect due to fragmented representations, as existing methods rely on isolated API documentation or dependency graphs that lack semantic depth.
sentences.zh: 当前的仓库智能体因碎片化的表示而遭遇推理断裂，因为现有方法依赖缺乏语义深度的孤立 API 文档或依赖图。

sentences.en: We consider repository comprehension and generation to be inverse processes within a unified cycle: generation expands intent into implementation, while comprehension compresses implementation back into intent.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，在统一循环中，仓库理解与生成了逆过程：生成将意图展开为实现，而理解将实现压缩回意图。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose RPG-Encoder, a framework that generalizes the Repository Planning Graph (RPG) from a static generative blueprint into a unified, high-fidelity representation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 RPG-Encoder，一个将仓库规划图（RPG）从静态的生成蓝图推广为统一、高保真表示的框架。

sentences.en: RPG-Encoder closes the reasoning loop through three mechanisms: (1) Encoding raw code into the RPG that combines lifted semantic features with code dependencies;
sentences.zh: RPG-Encoder 通过三种机制闭合推理回路：（1）将原始代码编码进结合了提升语义特征与代码依赖的 RPG；

sentences.en: (2) Evolving the topology incrementally to decouple maintenance costs from repository scale, reducing overhead by 95.7%; and (3) Operating as a unified interface for structure-aware navigation.
sentences.zh: （2）增量式地演进拓扑，以将维护成本与仓库规模解耦，将开销降低 95.7%；以及（3）作为支持结构感知导航的统一接口运作。

sentences.en: In evaluations, RPG-Encoder establishes state-of-the-art repository understanding on SWE-bench Verified with 93.7% Acc@5 and exceeds the best baseline by over 10% on SWE-bench Live.
sentences.zh: 在评估中，RPG-Encoder 在 SWE-bench Verified 上以 93.7% 的 Acc@5 建立了最先进的仓库理解，并在 SWE-bench Live 上超出最佳基线超过 10%。

sentences.en: These results highlight our superior fine-grained localization accuracy in complex codebases.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了我们在复杂代码库中的卓越细粒度定位精度。

sentences.en: Furthermore, it achieves 98.5% reconstruction coverage on RepoCraft, confirming RPG's high-fidelity capacity to mirror the original codebase and closing the loop between intent and implementation.
sentences.zh: 此外，它在 RepoCraft 上实现了 98.5% 的重建覆盖率，证实了 RPG 镜像原始代码库的高保真能力，并在意图与实现之间闭合了回路。

sentences.en: Our code and data are available at https://github.com/microsoft/RPG-ZeroRepo.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与数据可在 https://github.com/microsoft/RPG-ZeroRepo 获取。

title_en: Closing the Sim-to-Real Gap in Non-Markovian Spreading Processes via GPU-Accelerated Distributional RL
title_zh: 通过 GPU 加速的分布强化学习弥合非马尔可夫传播过程的仿真–真实差距

sentences.en: Controlling spreading processes on networks, such as epidemics, information cascades, and product adoption, requires policies that perform on realistic stochastic dynamics, not just tractable approximations.
sentences.zh: 控制网络上的传播过程，例如流行病、信息级联与产品采用，需要能够在真实随机动力学上表现良好的策略，而不仅仅是易于处理的近似。

sentences.en: Yet policies trained on standard simplifications (mean-field ODEs, Markovian dynamics) suffer severe performance degradation at deployment.
sentences.zh: 然而，在标准简化（平均场 ODE、马尔可夫动力学）上训练的策略在部署时表现严重退化。

sentences.en: We trace this sim-to-real gap to three theoretical pathologies: Optimism Bias, where deterministic approximations systematically underestimate variance via Jensen's inequality;
sentences.zh: 我们将这一仿真到现实差距追溯到三个理论病理：乐观偏差（Optimism Bias），即确定性近似通过 Jensen 不等式系统性低估方差；

sentences.en: Hub Blindness, where global state aggregation obscures the super-spreaders driving scale-free networks; and the Valley of Death, where mean-value critics fail to navigate the bimodal nature (extinction vs. viral) of cascade outcomes.
sentences.zh: 枢纽盲区（Hub Blindness），即全局状态聚合掩盖了驱动无标度网络的超级传播者；以及死亡之谷（Valley of Death），即均值批评家无法驾驭级联结果的双峰性（灭绝与病毒式传播）。

sentences.en: We resolve these challenges through two synergistic contributions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过两项协同的贡献来应对这些挑战。

sentences.en: First, the Stratified Mean-Field Observer partitions nodes by influence tier, preserving hub dynamics at $O(N)$ cost while producing fixed-dimensional observations that enable zero-shot transfer across network scales and topologies.
sentences.zh: 首先，分层平均场观测器（Stratified Mean-Field Observer）按影响力层级对节点进行划分，以 O(N) 的成本保留枢纽动力学，同时产生固定维度的观测，从而实现跨网络规模与拓扑的零样本迁移。

sentences.en: Second, we show that distributional RL via Truncated Quantile Critics improves risk-aware control of bimodal cascades.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们表明，通过截断分位数批评家实现的分布式强化学习，能够改进对双峰级联的风险感知控制。

sentences.en: Trained on a GPU-accelerated simulator supporting non-Markovian renewal dynamics, our approach achieves $59\times$ improvement over Markovian baselines and robust zero-shot transfer to real-world social networks (Facebook, Twitter, YouTube), significantly mitigating the simulation-to-reality gap.
sentences.zh: 在一个支持非马尔可夫更新动力学的 GPU 加速模拟器上训练后，我们的方法相较于马尔可夫基线实现了 $59\times$ 的改进，并稳健地零样本迁移到真实世界的社会网络（Facebook、Twitter、YouTube），显著缓解了仿真到现实差距。

title_en: CLoVE: Personalized Federated Learning through Clustering of Loss Vector Embeddings
title_zh: CLoVE：通过损失向量嵌入聚类实现个性化联邦学习

sentences.en: We propose CLoVE (Clustering of Loss Vector Embeddings), a novel algorithm for Clustered Federated Learning (CFL).
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CLoVE（Clustering of Loss Vector Embeddings），一种用于聚类联邦学习（CFL）的新颖算法。

sentences.en: In CFL, clients are naturally grouped into clusters based on their data distribution.
sentences.zh: 在 CFL 中，客户端根据其数据分布自然地分组为聚类。

sentences.en: However, identifying these clusters is challenging, as client assignments are unknown.
sentences.zh: 然而，识别这些聚类具有挑战性，因为客户端分配是未知的。

sentences.en: CLoVE utilizes client embeddings derived from model losses on client data, and leverages the insight that clients in the same cluster share similar loss values, while those in different clusters exhibit distinct loss patterns.
sentences.zh: CLoVE 利用从客户端数据上的模型损失派生出的客户端嵌入，并利用这样的洞见：同一聚类中的客户端共享相似的损失值，而不同聚类中的客户端则表现出不同的损失模式。

sentences.en: Based on these embeddings, CLoVE is able to iteratively identify and separate clients from different clusters and optimize cluster-specific models through federated aggregation.
sentences.zh: 基于这些嵌入，CLoVE 能够迭代地识别并分离来自不同聚类的客户端，并通过联邦聚合优化聚类特定的模型。

sentences.en: Key advantages of CLoVE over existing CFL algorithms are (1) its simplicity, (2) its applicability to both supervised and unsupervised settings, and (3) the fact that it eliminates the need for near-optimal model initialization, which makes it more robust and better suited for real-world applications.
sentences.zh: CLoVE 相较于现有 CFL 算法的关键优点是：（1）其简单性，（2）其同时适用于监督与无监督设定，以及（3）它消除了对近似最优模型初始化的需求，这使其更加稳健，更适合现实应用。

sentences.en: We establish theoretical convergence bounds, showing that CLoVE can recover clusters accurately with high probability in a single round and converges exponentially fast to optimal models in a linear setting.
sentences.zh: 我们确立了理论收敛界，表明 CLoVE 能够在单轮中以高概率精确恢复聚类，并在线性设定中以指数速度收敛到最优模型。

sentences.en: Our comprehensive experiments comparing with a variety of both CFL and generic Personalized Federated Learning (PFL) algorithms on different types of datasets and an extensive array of non-IID settings demonstrate that CLoVE achieves highly accurate cluster recovery in just a few rounds of training, along with state-of-the-art model accuracy, across a variety of both supervised and unsupervised PFL tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们与各种 CFL 与通用个性化联邦学习（PFL）算法在多种数据集与广泛非 IID 设定上进行的全面比较实验表明，CLoVE 仅需几轮训练就能实现高度精确的聚类恢复，并在各种监督与无监督 PFL 任务上取得最先进的模型精度。

title_en: Cluster-Aware Causal Mixer for Online Anomaly Detection in Multivariate Time Series
title_zh: 用于多变量时间序列在线异常检测的聚类感知因果混合器

sentences.en: Early and accurate detection of anomalies in time-series data is critical due to the substantial risks associated with false or missed detections.
sentences.zh: 对时间序列数据中异常的早期且准确检测至关重要，因为误报或漏报会带来巨大风险。

sentences.en: While MLP-based mixer models have shown promise in time-series analysis, they do not maintain temporal causality during data processing.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于 MLP 的混合模型已在时间序列分析中显示出前景，但它们在数据处理过程中并不保持时序因果性。

sentences.en: Moreover, real-world multivariate time series often contain numerous channels with diverse inter-channel correlations.
sentences.zh: 此外，真实世界的多元时间序列往往包含众多具有多样通道间相关性的通道。

sentences.en: Spurious correlations in the reconstructed time series lead to noisy representations, resulting in inaccurate anomaly detection.
sentences.zh: 重建时间序列中的虚假相关会导致有噪声的表示，从而使异常检测不准确。

sentences.en: In addition, anomaly scoring methods that ignore temporal continuity can mislead sequential detection.
sentences.zh: 此外，忽略时间连续性的异常评分方法可能会误导序列检测。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose a cluster-aware causal mixer for multivariate time-series anomaly detection.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出一个聚类感知因果混合器，用于多元时间序列异常检测。

sentences.en: Channels are grouped into clusters based on their correlations, and each cluster is embedded through a dedicated embedding layer.
sentences.zh: 通道根据其相关性分组为聚类，每个聚类通过专门的嵌入层进行嵌入。

sentences.en: A causal mixer is introduced to integrate information while maintaining temporal causality.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个因果混合器，在保持时序因果性的同时整合信息。

sentences.en: We further develop a sequential anomaly-scoring method that accumulates evidence over time and refines anomaly boundaries.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步开发了一种序列异常评分方法，它随时间积累证据并精炼异常边界。

sentences.en: Our proposed model operates in an online fashion, making it suitable for real-time time-series anomaly detection.
sentences.zh: 我们提出的模型以在线方式运作，因此适用于实时的时序异常检测。

sentences.en: Experimental evaluations across six public benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently achieves superior performance.
sentences.zh: 在六个公开基准数据集上的实验评估表明，所提方法持续取得优越性能。

title_en: Clustered Influence Functions
title_zh: 聚类影响函数

sentences.en: Influence functions are a standard tool for data debugging and unlearning, but they become impractical for **high-query** subset workloads such as large-$K$ cross-validation, repeated resampling, or interactive what-if analysis as each subset query typically requires an expensive inverse-curvature solve.
sentences.zh: 影响函数是数据调试与遗忘的标准工具，但对于**高查询**子集工作负载（例如大 K 交叉验证、重复重采样或交互式 what-if 分析）而言它们变得不切实际，因为每个子集查询通常都需要一次昂贵的逆曲率求解。

sentences.en: We introduce **Clustered Influence Functions (CiF)**, which turns subset influence into an **amortized subset oracle**.
sentences.zh: 我们引入**聚类影响函数（CiF）**，它将子集影响转变为一个**摊销的子集 oracle**。

sentences.en: We build a compact cache once by clustering training gradients, solve a damped Generalised Gauss-Newton system only for cluster means, and answer new subset queries by a linear recombination using cluster membership counts.
sentences.zh: 我们通过聚类训练梯度一次性构建一个紧凑缓存，仅对聚类均值求解阻尼广义 Gauss-Newton 系统，并通过使用聚类成员计数进行线性重组来回答新的子集查询。

sentences.en: This yields per-query cost of $O(Cp)$ linear in the cache size $C$, and the number of model parameters $p$.
sentences.zh: 这使得每次查询的成本变为 O(Cp)，随缓存大小 C 与模型参数个数 p 线性变化。

sentences.en: We further provide a diagnostic error bound that decomposes approximation error into a **clustering scatter** term and a **solver residual** term, making the accuracy-compute tradeoff explicit through the cache budget and solver tolerance.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供了一个诊断误差界，将近似误差分解为**聚类离散度**项与**求解器残差**项，从而通过缓存预算与求解器容差使精度-计算权衡显式化。

sentences.en: Evaluations across MNIST, CIFAR-10 show that CiF matches per-query influence rankings while significantly reducing the total runtime in high-$Q$ regimes, enabling influence-based workflows that are otherwise computationally prohibitive.
sentences.zh: 在 MNIST、CIFAR-10 上的评估表明，CiF 匹配了逐查询的影响排名，同时在高 Q 情境下显著减少了总运行时间，使原本计算上难以实现的影响函数工作流成为可能。

title_en: Clustering as Reasoning: A $k$-Means Interpretation of Chain-of-Thought Graph Learning
title_zh: 将聚类视为推理：对思维链图学习的 $k$ 均值解释

sentences.en: Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting has shown promise in enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) on text-attributed graphs (TAGs).
sentences.zh: 思维链（CoT）提示在提升大语言模型（LLM）对文本属性图（TAG）的推理能力方面显示出前景。

sentences.en: This work reframes CoT-based graph learning through the principle of clustering as reasoning, offering a $k$-means interpretation of how iterative reasoning operates over graph-structured data.
sentences.zh: 本工作通过“聚类即推理”这一原则重新框定基于 CoT 的图学习，为迭代推理如何在图结构数据上运作提供了一个 $k$-均值解释。

sentences.en: We observe that existing graph CoT methods rely on disjoint architectures and fixed graph representations, limiting step-by-step semantic-topological interaction and interpretability.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，现有的图 CoT 方法依赖不相交的架构与固定的图表示，限制了逐步的语义-拓扑交互与可解释性。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose a unified framework named KCoT that integrates CoT reasoning with graph representation learning.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出一个名为 KCoT 的统一框架，它将 CoT 推理与图表示学习整合起来。

sentences.en: Our key theoretical result reveals a formal mathematical correspondence between a Transformer block and the $k$-means algorithm, allowing reasoning to be interpreted as iterative assignment and update steps.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键理论结果表明，Transformer 块与 $k$-均值算法之间存在正式数学对应关系，使得推理可以被解释为迭代的分配与更新步骤。

sentences.en: Based on this insight, we introduce a Semantic Discriminating Prompt that explicitly formulates these steps as structured CoT reasoning, together with a structure-grounded alignment strategy to fuse topological priors with evolving thought-conditioned representations.
sentences.zh: 基于这一洞见，我们引入一个语义判别提示，将这些步骤显式表述为结构化的 CoT 推理，同时提出一种结构扎根的对齐策略，将拓扑先验与演进的思维条件表示相融合。

sentences.en: Experiments on standard benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art methods, validating clustering as a principled mechanism for CoT-based graph learning.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上的实验表明，相较于最先进的方法取得了一致的改进，验证了聚类作为基于 CoT 图学习的一个有原则机制。

title_en: Clustering in Deep Stochastic Transformers
title_zh: 深度随机 Transformer 中的聚类

sentences.en: Transformers have revolutionized deep learning across various domains but understanding the precise token dynamics remains a theoretical challenge.
sentences.zh: Transformer 已经彻底改变了各个领域的深度学习，但理解精确的词元动力学仍然是一个理论挑战。

sentences.en: Existing theories of deep Transformers with layer normalization typically predict that tokens cluster to a single point; however, these results rely on deterministic weight assumptions, which fail to capture the standard initialization scheme in Transformers.
sentences.zh: 现有关于带层归一化的深层 Transformer 的理论通常预测词元会聚类到单一点；然而，这些结果依赖确定性权重的假设，无法捕获 Transformer 中的标准初始化方案。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that accounting for the intrinsic stochasticity of random initialization alters this picture.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们表明，考虑随机初始化的固有随机性会改变这一图景。

sentences.en: More precisely, we analyze deep Transformers where noise arises from the random initialization of value matrices.
sentences.zh: 更准确地说，我们分析了噪声源于值矩阵随机初始化的深层 Transformer。

sentences.en: Under diffusion scaling and token-wise RMS normalization, we prove that, as the number of Transformer layers goes to infinity, the discrete token dynamics converge to an interacting-particle system on the sphere where tokens are driven by a \emph{common} matrix-valued Brownian noise.
sentences.zh: 在扩散缩放与逐词元 RMS 归一化下，我们证明：当 Transformer 层数趋于无穷时，离散词元动力学收敛到一个球面上的相互作用粒子系统，其中词元受到一个\emph{共同的}矩阵值布朗噪声的驱动。

sentences.en: In this limit, we show that initialization noise prevents the collapse to a single cluster predicted by deterministic models.
sentences.zh: 在这一极限下，我们表明，初始化噪声阻止了确定性模型所预测的坍缩到单一聚类。

sentences.en: For two tokens, we prove a phase transition governed by the interaction strength and the token dimension: unlike deterministic attention flows, antipodal configurations become attracting with positive probability.
sentences.zh: 对于两个词元，我们证明了由相互作用强度与词元维度支配的相变：与确定性注意力流不同，对跖构型（antipodal configurations）以正概率变得具有吸引力。

sentences.en: Numerical experiments confirm the predicted transition, reveal that antipodal formations persist for more than two tokens, and demonstrate that suppressing the intrinsic noise degrades accuracy.
sentences.zh: 数值实验证实了所预测的相变，揭示了超过两个词元时对跖构型仍然持续存在，并表明抑制固有噪声会降低精度。

title_en: CMI-RewardBench: Evaluating Music Reward Models with Compositional Multimodal Instruction
title_zh: CMI-RewardBench：利用组合式多模态指令评估音乐奖励模型

sentences.en: While music generation models have evolved to handle complex multimodal inputs mixing text, lyrics, and reference audio, evaluation mechanisms have lagged behind, remaining fragmented and narrowly focused.
sentences.zh: 虽然音乐生成模型已经发展到能够处理混合文本、歌词与参考音频的复杂多模态输入，但评估机制却落后了，仍然零散且聚焦狭窄。

sentences.en: In this paper, we bridge this critical gap by establishing a comprehensive ecosystem for Compositional Music Instruction (CMI) reward modeling, where the generated music may be conditioned on text descriptions, lyrics, and/or audio prompts.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过为组合式音乐指令（CMI）奖励建模建立一个全面的生态来弥合这一关键差距，其中生成的音乐可以以文本描述、歌词和/或音频提示为条件。

sentences.en: We first introduce CMIPref-Pseudo, a large-scale preference dataset comprising 110k pseudo-labeled samples, and CMI-Pref, a high-quality, human-annotated corpus tailored for fine-grained alignment tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们首先引入 CMIPref-Pseudo，一个包含 110k 个伪标签样本的大规模偏好数据集，以及 CMI-Pref，一个为细粒度对齐任务量身定制的高质量、人工标注语料。

sentences.en: To unify the evaluation landscape, we propose CMIRewardBench, a unified benchmark that evaluates music reward models on heterogeneous samples across musicality, text–music alignment, and compositional instruction alignment.
sentences.zh: 为统一评估格局，我们提出 CMIRewardBench，一个统一的基准，它在异质样本上评估音乐奖励模型的音乐性、文本-音乐对齐与组合式指令对齐。

sentences.en: Leveraging these resources, we develop CMI reward models (CMI-RMs), a parameter-efficient reward model family capable of processing heterogeneous inputs.
sentences.zh: 利用这些资源，我们开发了 CMI 奖励模型（CMI-RM），一个能够处理异质输入的参数高效奖励模型家族。

sentences.en: We evaluate their correlation with human judgments scores on Music Arena and CMI-Pref test set, as well as preference agreement on Music Arena and CMI-Pref.
sentences.zh: 我们评估了它们与 Music Arena 与 CMI-Pref 测试集上人类判断分数的相关性，以及在 Music Arena 与 CMI-Pref 上的偏好一致性。

sentences.en: Additional analyses examine performance variation across factors such as annotators, annotation timing and confidence, music generation models, and audio length.
sentences.zh: 额外的分析考察了跨标注者、标注时间与置信度、音乐生成模型与音频长度等因子的性能差异。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that CMI-RM not only correlates strongly with human judgments, but also enables effective inference-time scaling via topk filtering.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，CMI-RM 不仅与人类判断强相关，还通过 top-k 过滤实现了有效的推理时扩展。

sentences.en: Our work provides the necessary data, benchmarks, and models to advance aligned music generation.
sentences.zh: 我们的工作为推进对齐的音乐生成提供了必要的数据、基准与模型。

title_en: cMoLLM at Scale: Horizontal Scaling Laws for Convolutionally-Gated Mixture-of-LLMs
title_zh: 大规模 cMoLLM：卷积门控大语言模型混合的横向缩放定律

sentences.en: Scaling large language models (LLMs) has driven their success, yet dense Transformers couple capacity and computation: every parameter is activated for every token, making training and inference costs grow linearly with model size—a critical bottleneck as models approach trillion-parameter regimes.
sentences.zh: 扩展大语言模型（LLM）推动了其成功，然而稠密 Transformer 将能力与计算耦合在一起：每个参数对每个词元都被激活，使训练与推理成本随模型规模线性增长——这是模型逼近万亿参数时代的临界瓶颈。

sentences.en: We aim to scale capacity through MoE-style mixture throughout the LLM pipeline rather than only the FFN.
sentences.zh: 我们旨在通过在整个 LLM 流水线中采用 MoE 式混合来扩展能力，而不仅仅是在 FFN 中。

sentences.en: Prior pipeline-level approaches include ParaScale, which introduces virtual tokens and parallel streams but incurs substantial overhead and suffers from homogenized routing and gradient collapse, and AltUp, which uses an auxiliary prediction branch but offers limited adaptivity and slow convergence.
sentences.zh: 先前的流水线级方法包括：ParaScale，它引入虚拟词元与并行流，但产生了大量开销并遭受均匀化路由与梯度坍缩的困扰；以及 AltUp，它使用辅助预测分支而提供了有限的适应性与缓慢的收敛。

sentences.en: We establish that MoE-style mixture layers can be reformulated as variable-kernel dynamic convolutions, where each expert corresponds to a $1{\times}1$ convolutional kernel and routing implements input-conditioned kernel aggregation.
sentences.zh: 我们确立，MoE 式混合层可以被重新表述为变核动态卷积，其中每个专家对应于一个 $1\times1$ 卷积核，路由则实现输入条件的核聚合。

sentences.en: Building on this equivalence, we introduce cMoLLM: a convolutionally gated mixture-of-LLMs that routes over end-to-end streams through fully differentiable dynamic convolution.
sentences.zh: 基于这一等价性，我们引入 cMoLLM：一种卷积门控的 LLM 混合，它通过全可微的动态卷积在端到端流上进行路由。

sentences.en: In GPT-2-style models trained on FineWeb, cMoLLM improves language modeling perplexity and downstream GLUE and SQuAD accuracy under matched compute, with better stream utilization, more stable optimization, and favorable scaling compared to ParaScale- and AltUp-style baselines.
sentences.zh: 在用 FineWeb 训练的 GPT-2 风格模型中，cMoLLM 在匹配计算量下改善了语言建模困惑度以及下游 GLUE 与 SQuAD 精度，与 ParaScale 与 AltUp 风格基线相比，具有更好的流利用率、更稳定的优化以及有利的扩展性。

title_en: Co-Evolving Latent Action World Models
title_zh: 协同进化的潜在动作世界模型

sentences.en: Adapting pre-trained video generation models into controllable world models via latent actions is a promising step towards creating generalist world models.
sentences.zh: 通过潜在动作将预训练的视频生成模型适配成可控的世界模型，是迈向构建通用世界模型的有前景的一步。

sentences.en: The dominant paradigm adopts a two-stage approach that trains latent action model (LAM) and the world model separately, resulting in redundant training and limiting their potential for co-adaptation.
sentences.zh: 主导范式采用两阶段方法，分别训练潜在动作模型（LAM）与世界模型，导致训练冗余，并限制了它们共同适应的潜力。

sentences.en: A conceptually simple and appealing idea is to directly replace the forward dynamic model in LAM with a powerful world model and training them jointly, but it is non-trivial and prone to representational collapse.
sentences.zh: 一个概念上简单而有吸引力的想法是，直接用强大的世界模型替换 LAM 中的前向动力学模型并联合训练它们，但这并不平凡，而且容易发生表示坍缩。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose CoLA-World, which for the first time successfully realizes this synergistic paradigm, resolving the core challenge in joint learning through a critical warm-up phase that effectively aligns the representations of the from-scratch LAM with the pre-trained world model.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 CoLA-World，它首次成功实现了这一协同范式，通过一个关键的预热阶段——有效地将从头训练的 LAM 的表示与预训练的世界模型对齐——解决了联合学习的核心挑战。

sentences.en: This unlocks a co-evolution cycle: the world model acts as a knowledgeable tutor, providing gradients to shape a high-quality LAM, while the LAM offers a more precise and adaptable control interface to the world model.
sentences.zh: 这开启了一个共同演化循环：世界模型充当博学的导师，提供梯度以塑造高质量的 LAM，而 LAM 则为世界模型提供更精确且可适应的控制接口。

sentences.en: Empirically, CoLA-World matches or outperforms prior two-stage methods in both video simulation quality and downstream visual planning, establishing a robust and efficient new paradigm for the field.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，CoLA-World 在视频仿真质量与下游视觉规划两方面都匹敌或超越了先前的两阶段方法，为该领域确立了一个稳健而高效的新范式。

title_en: Co-Generative De Novo Functional Protein Design
title_zh: 协同生成式从头功能蛋白设计

sentences.en: *De novo* functional protein design aims to generate protein sequences that realize specified biochemical functions without relying on evolutionary templates, enabling broad applications in biotechnology and medicine.
sentences.zh: *从头*功能性蛋白质设计旨在生成能够实现指定生化功能、而不依赖进化模板的蛋白质序列，从而在生物技术与医学中实现广泛的应用。

sentences.en: Existing approaches adopt either direct function-to-sequence mapping or decoupled structure-sequence generation strategies but often fail to achieve functionality and foldability simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 现有方法要么采用直接的功能到序列映射，要么采用解耦的结构-序列生成策略，但常常无法同时实现功能性与可折叠性。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose **CodeFP**, a **Co**-generative protein language model for ***de** novo* **F**unctional **P**rotein design that simultaneously decodes sequence and structure tokens, thereby enabling superior simultaneous realization of functionality and foldability.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 **CodeFP**，一个用于***从**头* **功**能性**蛋**白质设计的**协**同生成蛋白质语言模型，它同时解码序列与结构词元，从而能够同时更好地实现功能性与可折叠性。

sentences.en: CodeFP utilizes functional local structures to enrich functional semantic encodings, overcoming the suboptimal translation of flat encodings into structure tokens, while introducing auxiliary functional supervision to alleviate training ambiguity stemming from the one-to-many structure-to-token mapping.
sentences.zh: CodeFP 利用功能性局部结构来丰富功能语义编码，克服了将平面编码次优地翻译成结构词元的问题，同时引入辅助的功能监督以缓解源自一对一多样结构到词元映射的训练模糊性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments show that CodeFP consistently achieves average improvements of 6.1\% in functional consistency and 3.2\% in foldability over the strongest baseline.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，相较于最强基线，CodeFP 在功能一致性上实现了一贯的平均 6.1\% 提升，在可折叠性上实现了一贯的平均 3.2\% 提升。

title_en: Co-RedTeam: Orchestrated Security Discovery and Exploitation with LLM Agents
title_zh: Co-RedTeam：利用大语言模型智能体编排安全漏洞发现与利用

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in assisting cybersecurity tasks, yet existing approaches struggle with automatic vulnerability discovery and exploitation due to limited interaction, weak execution grounding, and a lack of experience reuse.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在协助网络安全任务方面显示出前景，然而现有方法由于有限的交互、薄弱的执行接地以及缺乏经验复用，在自动漏洞发现与利用方面表现挣扎。

sentences.en: We propose Co-RedTeam, a security-aware multi-agent framework designed to mirror real-world red-teaming workflows by integrating security-domain knowledge, code-aware analysis, execution-grounded iterative reasoning, and long-term memory.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Co-RedTeam，一个安全感知的多智能体框架，旨在通过整合安全领域知识、代码感知分析、执行接地的迭代推理与长期记忆，来镜像真实世界的红队工作流。

sentences.en: Co-RedTeam decomposes vulnerability analysis into coordinated discovery and exploitation stages, enabling agents to plan, execute, validate, and refine actions based on real execution feedback while learning from prior trajectories.
sentences.zh: Co-RedTeam 将漏洞分析分解为协同的发现与利用两个阶段，使智能体能够基于真实的执行反馈进行规划、执行、验证与精炼行动，同时从先前的轨迹中学习。

sentences.en: Extensive evaluations on challenging security benchmarks demonstrate that Co-RedTeam consistently outperforms strong baselines across diverse backbone models, achieving over 60\% success rate in vulnerability exploitation and over 10\% absolute improvement in vulnerability detection.
sentences.zh: 在具有挑战性的安全基准上的大量评估表明，Co-RedTeam 在各种骨干模型上一致地优于强基线，在漏洞利用上取得超过 60\% 的成功率，在漏洞检测上取得超过 10% 的绝对改进。

sentences.en: Ablation and iteration studies further confirm the critical role of execution feedback, structured interaction, and memory for building robust and generalizable cybersecurity agents.
sentences.zh: 消融与迭代研究进一步证实了执行反馈、结构化交互与记忆对构建稳健且可泛化的网络安全智能体的关键作用。

title_en: Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators
title_zh: 粗粒化玻尔兹曼生成器

sentences.en: Sampling equilibrium molecular configurations from the Boltzmann distribution is a longstanding challenge.
sentences.zh: 从 Boltzmann 分布中采样平衡分子构型是一个长期存在的挑战。

sentences.en: Boltzmann Generators (BGs) address this by combining exact-likelihood generative models with importance sampling, but practical scalability is limited.
sentences.zh: Boltzmann 生成器（BG）通过将精确似然生成模型与重要性采样相结合来解决这一问题，但实际的可扩展性有限。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, coarse-grained surrogates enable the modeling of larger systems by reducing effective dimensionality, yet often lack a reweighting procedure required to ensure asymptotically correct statistics.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，粗粒化代理通过降低有效维度来实现对更大系统的建模，但往往缺乏确保渐近正确统计学所需的重新加权过程。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose Coarse-Grained Boltzmann Generators (CG-BGs), a framework for reduced-order generative modeling with importance sampling in coarse-grained coordinate space.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出粗粒化 Boltzmann 生成器（CG-BG），一个粗粒化坐标空间中进行重要性采样的约化生成建模框架。

sentences.en: CG-BGs generate samples using a flow-based model and reweight them using a learned potential of mean force (PMF).
sentences.zh: CG-BG 使用基于流的模型生成样本，并使用学习到的平均力势（PMF）对它们进行重新加权。

sentences.en: We show that the PMF can be learned from rapidly converged trajectories via enhanced sampling force matching.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，PMF 可以通过增强采样力匹配，从快速收敛的轨迹中学习。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate that CG-BGs capture solvent-mediated interactions in highly reduced representations while substantially reducing computational cost relative to atomistic BGs, providing a practical route toward equilibrium sampling of larger molecular systems.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，CG-BG 在高度约化的表示中捕获了溶剂介导的相互作用，同时相对于原子级 BG 大幅降低了计算成本，为更大分子系统的平衡采样提供了一条实用途径。

title_en: COBRA: Contribution-Based Bayesian Rank Allocation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning
title_zh: COBRA：用于参数高效微调的基于贡献的贝叶斯秩分配

sentences.en: Full fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational and storage costs.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的完全微调会带来难以承受的计算与存储成本。

sentences.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) addresses this limitation, with Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) gaining widespread adoption due to its simplicity and zero inference overhead.
sentences.zh: 参数高效微调（PEFT）弥补了这一局限，其中低秩适配（LoRA）凭借其简单性与零推理开销被广泛采用。

sentences.en: However, LoRA and its variants typically rely on uniform rank allocation or a single importance metric such as gradient magnitude or output sensitivity to guide rank distribution.
sentences.zh: 然而，LoRA 及其变体通常依赖均匀的秩分配，或依赖诸如梯度幅度或输出敏感性等单一重要性指标来指导秩分布。

sentences.en: This approach fails to recognize that gradient magnitude and output contribution are decoupled properties, leading to suboptimal allocation where critical layers are under-provisioned while less important ones waste capacity.
sentences.zh: 这种方法未能认识到梯度幅度与输出贡献是解耦的性质，导致分配次优：关键层供给不足，而较不重要的层则浪费容量。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose COBRA, a principled framework integrating dual importance factors for adaptive rank allocation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 COBRA，一个整合双重重要性因子进行自适应秩分配的有原则框架。

sentences.en: COBRA operates in three stages: (1) layer conductance attribution quantifies each layer's contribution via path-integral attribution; (2) dual-factor aggregation combines contribution with adaptation demand, producing the Task-Adaptive Layer Conductance (TA-LC) distribution; and (3) Bayesian rank allocation translates this distribution into optimal heterogeneous ranks via variational optimization.
sentences.zh: COBRA 分三个阶段运作：（1）层电导归因通过路径积分归因量化每层的贡献；（2）双因子聚合将贡献与适配需求结合起来，产生任务自适应层电导（TA-LC）分布；（3）贝叶斯秩分配通过变分优化将此分布转化为最优的异质秩。

sentences.en: Layer conductance provides layer-level interpretability by explicitly quantifying how much each layer contributes to predictions without redundancy, directly aligning with the granularity of rank allocation decisions and enabling principled cross-layer comparison for rank distribution.
sentences.zh: 层电导通过显式量化每层对预测贡献多少而无冗余，提供了层级的可解释性，直接与秩分配决策的粒度对齐，并实现了用于秩分布的有原则跨层比较。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse architectures and tasks demonstrate that COBRA consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving up to 1.6 points improvement on GLUE and a 6.6\% average MSE reduction in high-rank regression regimes under comparable parameter budgets.
sentences.zh: 跨多样架构与任务的实验表明，COBRA 一致地优于现有方法，在可比较的参数预算下，在 GLUE 上取得高达 1.6 分的改进，在高秩回归情境下平均 MSE 降低 6.6\%。

title_en: CoCoEdit: Content-Consistent Image Editing via Region Regularized Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: CoCoEdit：通过区域正则化强化学习实现内容一致的图像编辑

sentences.en: Image editing has achieved impressive results with the development of large-scale generative models.
sentences.zh: 随着大规模生成式模型的发展，图像编辑取得了令人印象深刻的成果。

sentences.en: However, existing models mainly focus on the editing effects of intended objects and regions, often leading to unwanted changes in unintended regions.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有模型主要关注预期对象与区域的编辑效果，往往导致未预期区域发生不期望的变化。

sentences.en: We present a post-training framework for $\textbf{Co}$ntent-$\textbf{Co}$nsistent $\textbf{Edit}$ing ($\textbf{CoCoEdit}$) by using region regularized reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个通过区域正则化强化学习实现的\textbf{Co}ntent-\textbf{Co}nsistent \textbf{Edit}ing（\textbf{CoCoEdit}）后训练框架。

sentences.en: We first augment existing editing datasets with refined instructions and masks, from which 40K diverse and high quality samples are curated as training set.
sentences.zh: 我们首先用精炼的指令与掩码增广现有的编辑数据集，从中整理出 40K 个多样且高质量的样本作为训练集。

sentences.en: We introduce a pixel-level similarity reward that complements MLLM-based rewards, enabling models to ensure both editing quality and content consistency during the editing process.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一种像素级相似度奖励，它补充基于 MLLM 的奖励，使模型能够在编辑过程中同时确保编辑质量与内容一致性。

sentences.en: To overcome the spatial-agnostic nature of the rewards, we propose a region-based regularizer, aiming to preserve non-edited regions for high-reward samples while encouraging editing effects for low-reward samples.
sentences.zh: 为克服奖励的空间无关性，我们提出一个基于区域的正则化器，其目标是为高奖励样本保留未编辑区域，同时为低奖励样本鼓励编辑效果。

sentences.en: For evaluation, we annotate editing masks for GEdit-Bench and ImgEdit-Bench, introducing pixel-level similarity metrics to measure content consistency and editing quality.
sentences.zh: 为进行评估，我们为 GEdit-Bench 与 ImgEdit-Bench 标注了编辑掩码，引入像素级相似度度量来衡量内容一致性与编辑质量。

sentences.en: Applying CoCoEdit to Qwen-Image-Edit and FLUX-Kontext, we achieve not only superior editing scores to state-of-the-art models, but also significantly better content consistency, measured by PSNR/SSIM metrics and human subjective ratings.
sentences.zh: 将 CoCoEdit 应用到 Qwen-Image-Edit 与 FLUX-Kontext 上，我们不仅取得了优于最先进模型的编辑分数，还在 PSNR/SSIM 指标与人类主观评分衡量的内容一致性上显著更优。

sentences.en: Codes, data and models of CoCoEdit can be found at https://github.com/langmanbusi/CoCoEdit.
sentences.zh: CoCoEdit 的代码、数据与模型可在 https://github.com/langmanbusi/CoCoEdit 获取。

title_en: CoCoEmo: Composable and Controllable Human-Like Emotional TTS via Activation Steering
title_zh: CoCoEmo：通过激活引导实现可组合、可控的类人情感文本转语音

sentences.en: Emotional expression in human speech is nuanced and compositional, often involving multiple, sometimes conflicting, affective cues that may diverge from linguistic content.
sentences.zh: 人类语音中的情感表达是微妙且组合式的，常常涉及多种、有时相互冲突的情感线索，可能与语言内容相背离。

sentences.en: In contrast, most expressive text-to-speech (TTS) systems enforce a single utterance-level emotion, collapsing affective diversity and suppressing mixed or text–emotion–misaligned expression.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，大多数富有表现力的语音合成（TTS）系统强制使用单一的语句级情感，抹平了情感多样性，并抑制了混合的或文本-情感错位的表达。

sentences.en: While activation steering via latent direction vectors offers a promising solution, it remains unclear whether emotion representations are linearly steerable in TTS, where steering should be applied within hybrid TTS architectures, and how such complex emotion behaviors should be evaluated.
sentences.zh: 虽然通过潜在方向向量的激活引导提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但在 TTS 中情感表示是否可线性引导、引导应在混合 TTS 架构中的何处应用，以及应如何评估这类复杂的情感行为，仍然不清楚。

sentences.en: This paper presents the first systematic analysis of activation steering for emotional control in hybrid TTS models, introducing a quantitative, controllable steering framework, and multi-rater evaluation protocols that enable composable mixed-emotion synthesis and reliable text–emotion mismatch synthesis.
sentences.zh: 本文提出了针对混合 TTS 模型中情感控制的激活引导的首次系统性分析，引入了一个量化的、可控的引导框架，以及多评分者评估协议，从而支持可组合的混合情感合成与可靠的文本-情感错位合成。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate, for the first time, that emotional prosody and expressive variability are primarily synthesized by the TTS language module instead of the flow-matching module, and also provide a lightweight steering approach for generating natural, human-like emotional speech.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果首次证明，情感韵律与表达变异性主要由 TTS 语言模块而非流匹配模块合成，并提供了生成自然、类人情感语音的轻量级引导方法。

title_en: CoCoQuant: Breaking the Bandwidth Wall via Co-Optimized Communication and Computation Quantization
title_zh: CoCoQuant：通过通信与计算量化协同优化突破带宽瓶颈

sentences.en: The rapid scaling of large language models (LLMs) has made distributed inference indispensable, yet end-to-end latency is increasingly dominated by communication, forming a critical bandwidth wall that fundamentally limits the practical gains of existing quantization techniques.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）的快速扩展使分布式推理变得不可或缺，然而端到端延迟日益由通信主导，形成一个关键的带宽墙，从根本上限制了现有量化技术的实际收益。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically treat communication and computation in isolation, failing to exploit their coupled nature and introducing limited system-level acceleration and accuracy degradation.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常孤立地对待通信与计算，未能利用它们耦合的本质，并且带来的系统级加速有限，还伴随着精度下降。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose CoCoQuant, a co-designed framework that jointly optimizes communication and computation as a unified end-to-end design space.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出 CoCoQuant，一个协同设计的框架，它将通信与计算作为统一的端到端设计空间进行联合优化。

sentences.en: CoCoQuant introduces a precision-aligned graph-rewriting that enables zero-overhead fusion between low-precision communication and computation.
sentences.zh: CoCoQuant 引入一种精度对齐的图重写机制，实现低精度通信与计算之间的零开销融合。

sentences.en: CoCoQuant formulates a hardware-aware mixed-precision allocation problem that integrates roofline-based cost modeling with relative sensitivity calibration, solved via global integer linear programming.
sentences.zh: CoCoQuant 将硬件感知的混合精度分配问题形式化，该问题将基于 roofline 的成本建模与相对灵敏度校准相结合，并通过全局整数线性规划求解。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on LLMs of varing scales demonstrate that CoCoQuant achieves Pareto-optimal accuracy-latency trade-offs, delivering up to 2.92 end-to-end speedup with a negligible increase in perplexity (0.22).
sentences.zh: 在不同规模的 LLM 上的大量实验表明，CoCoQuant 实现了 Pareto 最优的精度-延迟权衡，在困惑度仅增加微不足道的 0.22 的情况下，带来了高达 2.92 倍的端到端加速。

title_en: CoCoReviewBench: A Completeness- and Correctness-Oriented Benchmark for AI Reviewers
title_zh: CoCoReviewBench：面向 AI 审稿人的完整性与正确性基准

sentences.en: Despite the rapid development of AI reviewers, evaluating such systems remains challenging: metrics favor overlap with human reviews over correctness.
sentences.zh: 尽管 AI 审稿人发展迅速，但评估此类系统仍然具有挑战性：指标更青睐与人类审稿的重叠，而非正确性。

sentences.en: However, since human reviews often cover only a subset of salient issues and sometimes contain mistakes, they are unreliable as gold references.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于人类审稿往往只覆盖显著问题的一个子集，并且有时含有错误，它们作为黄金参考并不可靠。

sentences.en: To address this, we build category-specific benchmark subsets and skip evaluation when the corresponding human reviews are missing to strengthen ***Co***mpleteness.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们构建类别特定的基准子集，并在相应的人类审稿缺失时跳过评估，以增强***完***整性。

sentences.en: We also leverage reviewer--author--meta-review discussions as expert annotations and filter unreliable reviews accordingly to strengthen ***Co***rrectness.
sentences.zh: 我们还利用审稿人-作者-元审稿讨论作为专家标注，并据此过滤不可靠的审稿，以增强***正***确性。

sentences.en: Finally, we introduce `CoCoReviewBench`, which curates 3,900 papers from ICLR and NeurIPS to enable reliable and fine-grained evaluation of AI reviewers.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们引入 CoCoReviewBench，它从 ICLR 与 NeurIPS 整理了 3,900 篇论文，以实现对 AI 审稿人可靠且细粒度的评估。

sentences.en: Analysis shows that AI reviewers remain limited in correctness and are prone to hallucinations, and highlights reasoning models as more effective reviewers, motivating further directions for improving AI reviewers.
sentences.zh: 分析表明，AI 审稿人在正确性上仍然有限，并且容易产生幻觉，同时凸显出推理模型是更有效的审稿人，为改进 AI 审稿人指明了进一步的方向。

sentences.en: Benchmarks and models are available at .
sentences.zh: 基准与模型可在 . 获取。

title_en: CocoRNA: Collective RNA Design with Cooperative Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: CocoRNA：通过协作多智能体强化学习进行集体 RNA 设计

sentences.en: Designing RNA sequences that reliably fold into specific secondary structures is essential for understanding their biological functions but remains a challenging computational problem.
sentences.zh: 设计能够可靠折叠成特定二级结构的 RNA 序列，对理解其生物学功能至关重要，但仍是一个具有挑战性的计算问题。

sentences.en: We propose CocoRNA, a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for RNA inverse design.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CocoRNA，一个面向 RNA 逆设计的协作式多智能体强化学习框架。

sentences.en: CocoRNA simplifies the design task by decomposing it into smaller sub-problems, each solved collaboratively by multiple agents.
sentences.zh: CocoRNA 通过将设计任务分解成更小的子问题来简化任务，每个子问题由多个智能体协作求解。

sentences.en: This approach reduces the complexity of the problem and improves the exploration of design policies.
sentences.zh: 这种方法降低了问题的复杂度，并改进了对设计策略的探索。

sentences.en: During training, a centralized critic uses global structural information to guide the agents, enabling them to jointly optimize their design strategies.
sentences.zh: 在训练期间，一个集中式批评家利用全局结构信息来引导智能体，使它们能够联合优化其设计策略。

sentences.en: As a result, CocoRNA learns high-quality RNA design policies that generalize effectively to unseen structures without additional training.
sentences.zh: 因此，CocoRNA 学习到高质量的 RNA 设计策略，无需额外训练即可有效地泛化到未见结构。

sentences.en: Experiments on the Rfam dataset demonstrate that CocoRNA substantially outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both success rate and design speed.
sentences.zh: 在 Rfam 数据集上的实验表明，CocoRNA 在成功率与设计速度两方面都大幅优于最先进的方法。

sentences.en: Further experiments on other biological sequence design tasks highlight the effectiveness and broad potential of CocoRNA for complex design tasks.
sentences.zh: 在其他生物序列设计任务上的进一步实验，凸显了 CocoRNA 对复杂设计任务的有效性与广阔潜力。

title_en: CoD-Lite: Real-Time Diffusion-Based Generative Image Compression
title_zh: CoD-Lite：基于扩散的实时生成式图像压缩

sentences.en: Recent advanced diffusion methods typically derive strong generative priors by scaling diffusion transformers.
sentences.zh: 近期先进的扩散方法通常通过扩展扩散 Transformer 来获得强大的生成先验。

sentences.en: However, scaling fails to generalize when adapted for real-time compression scenarios that demand lightweight models.
sentences.zh: 然而，在适配于要求轻量模型的实时压缩场景时，扩展无法泛化。

sentences.en: In this paper, we explore the design of real-time and lightweight diffusion codecs by addressing two pivotal questions.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过解决两个关键问题来探索实时且轻量的扩散编解码器的设计。

sentences.en: First, does diffusion pre-training benefit lightweight diffusion codecs?
sentences.zh: 第一，扩散预训练是否有利于轻量扩散编解码器？

sentences.en: Through systematic analysis, we find that generation-oriented pre-training is less effective at small model scales whereas compression-oriented pre-training yields consistently better performance.
sentences.zh: 通过系统性分析，我们发现，面向生成的预训练在小模型规模下效果较差，而面向压缩的预训练则取得持续更好的性能。

sentences.en: Second, are transformers essential?
sentences.zh: 第二，Transformer 是否必不可少？

sentences.en: We find that while global attention is crucial for standard generation, lightweight convolutions suffice for compression-oriented diffusion when paired with distillation.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，虽然全局注意力对标准生成至关重要，但当与蒸馏配对时，轻量卷积对面向压缩的扩散而言就足够了。

sentences.en: Guided by these findings, we establish a one-step lightweight convolution diffusion codec that achieves real-time 60 FPS encoding and 42 FPS decoding at 1080p.
sentences.zh: 基于这些发现，我们建立了一个单步轻量卷积扩散编解码器，在 1080p 下实现了实时的 60 FPS 编码与 42 FPS 解码。

sentences.en: Further enhanced by distillation and adversarial learning, the proposed codec reduces bitrate by 85% at a comparable FID to MS-ILLM, bridging the gap between generative compression and practical real-time deployment.
sentences.zh: 在蒸馏与对抗学习的进一步增强下，所提出的编解码器在 FID 与 MS-ILLM 相当的情况下将码率降低了 85%，弥合了生成式压缩与实用实时部署之间的差距。

sentences.en: Codes are released at https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/CoD_Lite.
sentences.zh: 代码已在 https://github.com/microsoft/GenCodec/tree/main/CoD_Lite 发布。
