title_en: CoDA-Bench: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
title_zh: CoDA-Bench：代码智能体能否处理数据密集型任务？

sentences.en: Advanced agents are increasingly demonstrating the potential to operate as autonomous engineers, creating a growing demand for evaluation benchmarks that capture the complexity of real-world development.
sentences.zh: 先进的智能体越来越展现出作为自主工程师运作的潜力，从而产生了对能够捕获现实世界开发复杂性的评估基准的日益增长的需求。

sentences.en: Such environments typically involve both complex code and large-scale data (i.e., file system).
sentences.zh: 此类环境通常同时涉及复杂代码与大规模数据（即文件系统）。

sentences.en: However, existing benchmarks usually evaluate code-centric or data-centric capabilities in isolation, leaving a clear gap with real development scenarios.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有基准通常孤立地评估以代码为中心或以数据为中心的能力，与现实开发场景之间存在明显差距。

sentences.en: In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing CoDA-Bench, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate code and data intelligence in a data-intensive environment.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过引入 CoDA-Bench 来弥合这一差距，它是第一个在数据密集型环境中联合评估代码与数据智能的基准。

sentences.en: We construct a data-intensive Linux sandbox based on the Kaggle ecosystem (containing hundreds of datasets), where agents must actively explore complex file hierarchies to identify relevant resources and generate code for data-driven analytical tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们基于 Kaggle 生态（包含数百个数据集）构建一个数据密集型的 Linux 沙箱，其中智能体必须主动探索复杂的文件层级以识别相关资源，并为数据驱动的分析任务生成代码。

sentences.en: CoDA-Bench comprises 1,009 tasks spanning 31 communities, with each task environment containing an average of 980 files, simulating realistic data scale and noise.
sentences.zh: CoDA-Bench 包含横跨 31 个社区的 1,009 个任务，每个任务环境平均包含 980 个文件，模拟了现实的数据规模与噪声。

sentences.en: Evaluations of advanced agents reveal that even top-performing systems struggle to effectively integrate data discovery with code execution, achieving a success rate of only 61.1\%.
sentences.zh: 对先进智能体的评估表明，即使是表现最佳的系统也难以有效地将数据发现与代码执行整合起来，成功率仅为 61.1\%。

sentences.en: These results highlight a substantial gap in current agentic capabilities for data-intensive tasks and point to promising directions for future research.
sentences.zh: 这些结果凸显了当前智能体在处理数据密集型任务时的能力上存在实质性差距，并为未来的研究指明了有前景的方向。

title_en: Code2Video: A Code-centric Paradigm for Educational Video Creation
title_zh: Code2Video：以代码为中心的教育视频创作范式

sentences.en: While recent generative models can synthesize videos in pixel space, they often fail to produce educational videos with precise structures, domain knowledge, and coherent transitions.
sentences.zh: 虽然近期的生成模型可以在像素空间合成视频，但它们往往无法产出具有精确结构、领域知识与连贯转场的教育视频。

sentences.en: We argue that this setting is better served by operating in a renderable environment that is explicitly controlled by code.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，这一设定更适合在一个由代码显式控制的可渲染环境中进行。

sentences.en: We propose **Code2Video**, a code-centric agent framework that generates educational videos by writing executable Python programs.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 **Code2Video**，一个以代码为中心的智能体框架，它通过编写可执行的 Python 程序来生成教育视频。

sentences.en: Code2Video includes three agents: a *Planner* that converts lecture content into a temporal storyboard, a *Coder* that turns the storyboard into runnable code with scope-guided auto-fix, and a *Critic* that refines layout using a VLM guided by *visual anchor prompting*, *i.e.*, mappings from target visual outcomes to code edits.
sentences.zh: Code2Video 包含三个智能体：一个*规划器（Planner）*，它将课程内容转换为时间线故事板；一个*编码器（Coder）*，它通过范围引导的自动修复将故事板转成可运行代码；以及一个*批评家（Critic）*，它借助由*视觉锚点提示（visual anchor prompting）*——即从目标视觉结果到代码编辑的映射——引导的 VLM 来精炼版式。

sentences.en: For evaluation, we build **MMMC**, a benchmark of professionally produced, discipline-specific educational videos.
sentences.zh: 为进行评估，我们构建 **MMMC**，一个由专业制作、特定学科的教育视频组成的基准。

sentences.en: We assess Code2Video using aesthetic scores (VLM-as-a-Judge), code efficiency, and **TeachQuiz**, an end-to-end metric that measures how well an *unlearned* VLM can recover knowledge after watching generated videos.
sentences.zh: 我们使用美学分数（VLM 作为评判者）、代码效率以及 **TeachQuiz**（一个端到端指标，衡量一个*未学习过*的 VLM 在观看生成的视频后能恢复多少知识）来评估 Code2Video。

sentences.en: Code2Video improves performance by 40% over direct code generation and produces videos comparable to human-crafted tutorials.
sentences.zh: Code2Video 相较于直接代码生成提升了 40% 的性能，并产出了与人工精心制作的教程相当的视频。

sentences.en: The code and datasets are available at [https://github.com/showlab/Code2Video](https://github.com/showlab/Code2Video).
sentences.zh: 代码与数据集可在 [https://github.com/showlab/Code2Video](https://github.com/showlab/Code2Video) 获取。

title_en: Code2Worlds: Empowering Coding LLMs for 4D World Generation
title_zh: Code2Worlds：赋予编程大语言模型四维世界生成能力

sentences.en: Achieving spatial intelligence requires moving beyond visual plausibility to build world simulators grounded in physical laws.
sentences.zh: 实现空间智能要求超越视觉真实性，去构建扎根于物理规律的世界模拟器。

sentences.en: While coding LLMs have advanced static 3D scene generation, extending this paradigm to 4D dynamics remains a critical frontier.
sentences.zh: 虽然编码 LLM 已经推进了静态 3D 场景生成，但将这一范式扩展到 4D 动力学仍然是一个关键的前沿。

sentences.en: This task presents two fundamental challenges: multi-scale context entanglement, where monolithic generation fails to balance local object structures with global environmental layouts; and a semantic-physical execution gap, where open-loop code generation leads to physical hallucinations lacking dynamic fidelity.
sentences.zh: 这一任务提出了两个根本性的挑战：多尺度上下文纠缠（此时整体式生成无法在局部物体结构与全局环境布局之间取得平衡），以及语义-物理执行鸿沟（此时开环代码生成会产生缺乏动态保真度的物理幻觉）。

sentences.en: We introduce Code2Worlds, a framework that formulates 4D generation as language-to-simulation code generation.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 Code2Worlds，一个将 4D 生成表述为语言到仿真代码生成的框架。

sentences.en: First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that disentangles retrieval-augmented object generation from hierarchical environmental orchestration.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们提出一个双流架构，它将检索增强的物体生成与层次化的环境编排解耦。

sentences.en: Second, to ensure dynamic fidelity, we establish a physics-aware closed-loop mechanism in which a PostProcess Agent scripts dynamics, coupled with a VLM-Motion Critic that performs self-reflection to iteratively refine simulation code.
sentences.zh: 其次，为确保动态保真度，我们建立了一个物理感知的闭环机制，其中一个后处理智能体（PostProcess Agent）来编写动力学脚本，并与一个进行自我反思以迭代精炼仿真代码的 VLM-运动批评家（VLM-Motion Critic）相耦合。

sentences.en: Evaluations on the Code4D benchmark show Code2Worlds outperforms baselines with a 41% SGS gain and 49% higher Richness, while uniquely generating physics-aware dynamics absent in prior static methods.
sentences.zh: 在 Code4D 基准上的评估表明，Code2Worlds 以 41% 的 SGS 提升与 49% 更高的丰富度（Richness）优于基线，并且独特地生成了先前的静态方法所不具备的物理感知动力学。

title_en: CodeChemist: Test-Time Scaling for Low-Resource Code Generation via Functional Knowledge Transfer
title_zh: CodeChemist：通过功能知识迁移实现低资源代码生成的测试时扩展

sentences.en: Code Large Language Models (CodeLLMs) have been widely adopted for Natural Language to Programming Language code generation, powering applications with large user bases.
sentences.zh: 代码大语言模型（CodeLLM）已被广泛采用于自然语言到编程语言的代码生成，驱动着拥有庞大用户群体的应用。

sentences.en: Their performance, however, varies sharply across programming languages (PLs) and is particularly suboptimal for low-resource PLs due to data scarcity, limiting their overall usability.
sentences.zh: 然而，它们的性能在不同编程语言（PL）之间差异悬殊，并且由于数据稀缺，在低资源 PL 上尤其次优，从而限制了其整体可用性。

sentences.en: In this work, we introduce CodeChemist, a simple yet effective, training-free test-time scaling framework that transfers the model's functional knowledge from high-resource to low-resource PLs via synthesized test cases, without relying on external models.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们引入 CodeChemist，一个简单而有效、免训练的测试时扩展框架，它通过合成的测试用例将模型的功能知识从高资源 PL 迁移到低资源 PL，而无需依赖外部模型。

sentences.en: Specifically, CodeChemist first applies multi-temperature hedged sampling to generate a pool of candidate solutions in the low-resource PL and synthesizes a set of test inputs.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，CodeChemist 首先应用多温度对冲采样，在低资源 PL 中生成一个候选解池，并合成一组测试输入。

sentences.en: It then estimates uncertainty: when uncertainty is low, it selects the output via in-language majority voting; otherwise, it constructs cross-lingual I/O test oracles by executing high-resource reference programs and selects the candidate with the highest pass rate.
sentences.zh: 然后它估计不确定性：当不确定性较低时，通过同语言多数投票选择输出；否则，通过执行高资源参考程序构建跨语言 I/O 测试 oracle，并选择通过率最高的候选。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodeChemist significantly outperforms existing test-time scaling methods, improving code generation for both low-resource PLs (e.g., Lua) and complex-syntax PLs (e.g., C++, Java) without retraining.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CodeChemist 显著优于现有的测试时扩展方法，无需重训练即可改进低资源 PL（例如 Lua）与复杂语法 PL（例如 C++、Java）两者的代码生成。

title_en: CodeClash: Benchmarking Goal-Oriented Software Engineering
title_zh: CodeClash：评测目标导向的软件工程

sentences.en: Existing coding benchmarks evaluate language models (LMs) on concrete, well-specified tasks such as fixing bugs or writing tests.
sentences.zh: 现有的编码基准在具体、定义良好的任务（例如修复 bug 或编写测试）上评估语言模型（LM）。

sentences.en: However, human programmers do not spend all day addressing isolated GitHub issues.
sentences.zh: 然而，人类程序员并不是整天处理孤立的 GitHub 问题。

sentences.en: Instead, real-world software development is grounded in the pursuit of high-level goals.
sentences.zh: 相反，现实世界的软件开发扎根于对高层目标的追求。

sentences.en: Evaluating whether LMs can iteratively develop code to accomplish open-ended objectives without explicit guidance remains an open challenge.
sentences.zh: 评估 LM 是否能够在没有显式引导的情况下迭代式地开发代码以完成开放式目标，仍然是一个开放挑战。

sentences.en: We introduce CodeClash, a benchmark where LMs compete in multi-round tournaments to build the best codebase for achieving a competitive objective.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 CodeClash，一个基准，其中 LM 在多轮锦标赛中竞争，以构建实现某个竞争性目标的最佳代码库。

sentences.en: Each round proceeds in two parts: agents edit their code, then their codebases compete head-to-head in a code arena that determines winners based on objectives like score maximization, resource acquisition, or survival.
sentences.zh: 每一轮分两部分进行：智能体编辑其代码，然后其代码库在代码竞技场中正面交锋，基于诸如分数最大化、资源获取或生存等目标确定胜者。

sentences.en: Models must decide for themselves how to improve their code both absolutely and against their opponents.
sentences.zh: 模型必须自行决定如何既绝对地又针对对手地改进其代码。

sentences.en: We run 1680 tournaments to evaluate 8 LMs across 6 arenas, revealing how models exhibit diverse development styles and share fundamental limitations in strategic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们运行了 1680 场锦标赛，在 6 个竞技场中评估 8 个 LM，揭示出模型如何表现出多样化的开发风格，并在策略性推理上共享根本性的局限。

sentences.en: Models also struggle with long-term codebase maintenance; repositories become progressively messy and redundant.
sentences.zh: 模型在长期维护代码库方面也表现挣扎；代码库会逐渐变得混乱且冗余。

sentences.en: Top models lose every round against expert human programmers.
sentences.zh: 顶级模型在对阵专家人类程序员时每轮都会输掉。

sentences.en: We open-source CodeClash to advance the study of autonomous, goal-oriented code development.
sentences.zh: 我们开放了 CodeClash 的源代码，以推进对自主、目标导向代码开发的研究。

title_en: CodeMamba: Shifting from Target Semantics to Self-Supervised Background Manifold Learning for Singularity Detection in Infrared Sequences
title_zh: CodeMamba：从目标语义转向自监督背景流形学习，以检测红外序列中的奇异点

sentences.en: Multi-frame infrared small target detection suffers from extreme semantic paucity of targets and representation collapse due to overwhelming class imbalance, resulting in the persistent inability to accurately distinguish point-like targets from dynamic background clutter.
sentences.zh: 多帧红外小目标检测受困于目标极端匮乏的语义以及因压倒性的类不均衡导致的表示坍缩，从而始终无法将点状目标与动态背景杂波准确区分开来。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose CodeMamba, a collaborative dual-stream framework that reframes this task as the complementary mechanisms of background manifold modeling and motion singularity capturing.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 CodeMamba，一个协作式双流框架，它将这一任务重构为背景流形建模与运动奇异性捕获这两种互补的机制。

sentences.en: The implicit stream emphasizes background regularity and anomaly localization, while the explicit stream focuses on motion consistency and spatiotemporal singularity.
sentences.zh: 隐式流强调背景规律性与异常定位，而显式流则聚焦于运动一致性与时空奇异性。

sentences.en: Finally, we design a Bayesian uncertainty-weighted fusion module that estimates the reliability of each stream by quantifying its observation noise.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们设计了一个贝叶斯不确定性加权融合模块，通过量化每个流的观测噪声来估计其可靠性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the IRDST and DAUB benchmarks demonstrate that CodeMamba not only outperforms existing methods but also achieves enhanced sensitivity to point-like targets.
sentences.zh: 在 IRDST 与 DAUB 基准上的大量实验表明，CodeMamba 不仅优于现有方法，还实现了对点状目标更强的敏感性。

title_en: CodeTaste: Can LLMs Generate Human-Level Code Refactorings?
title_zh: CodeTaste：大语言模型能否生成人类水平的代码重构？

sentences.en: LLM coding agents can generate working code, but their solutions often accumulate complexity, duplication, and architectural debt.
sentences.zh: LLM 编码智能体能够生成可工作的代码，但它们的解决方案往往累积了复杂性、重复与架构债。

sentences.en: Human developers address such issues through refactoring: behavior-preserving program transformations that improve structure and maintainability.
sentences.zh: 人类开发者通过重构来应对此类问题：重构是不改变行为的程序变换，用于改进结构与可维护性。

sentences.en: We investigate whether agents (i) can execute refactorings reliably and (ii) identify the refactorings that human developers actually chose in real codebases.
sentences.zh: 我们研究智能体是否（i）能够可靠地执行重构，以及（ii）能够识别人类开发者在真实代码库中实际选择的重构。

sentences.en: To this end, we construct CodeTaste, a benchmark mined from large multi-file open-source refactorings.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们构建了 CodeTaste，一个从大规模多文件开源重构中挖掘所得基准。

sentences.en: To score solutions, we combine repository test suites that measure functional correctness with tailored static checks that verify removal of undesired and introduction of desired code patterns using dataflow reasoning.
sentences.zh: 为对解决方案评分，我们将度量功能正确性的代码库测试套件，与验证（通过数据流推理）不受欢迎模式被移除、期望模式被引入的定制静态检查结合起来。

sentences.en: Our results show a clear gap: agents perform well at implementing refactorings that are specified in detail, but often fail to discover the human refactoring choices when given a focus area for changes.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果显示出明显的差距：智能体在实现被详细规定的重构时表现良好，但当给定变化聚焦区域时，往往无法发现人类的重构选择。

sentences.en: A propose-then-implement decomposition improves alignment, and selecting the best-aligned proposal before implementation can yield further gains.
sentences.zh: “先提议后实现”的分解改善了对齐度，而在实现之前选择对齐度最佳的提议则可以带来进一步的收益。

sentences.en: CodeTaste provides an evaluation target and a potential preference signal for aligning coding agents with human refactoring decisions in realistic codebases.
sentences.zh: CodeTaste 提供了一个评估目标，以及一个用于将编码智能体与人类在现实代码库中的重构决策对齐的潜在偏好信号。

sentences.en: We release the benchmark, leaderboard, and code.
sentences.zh: 我们发布了基准、排行榜与代码。

title_en: CODiff: One-Step Diffusion Model for Camouflaged Object Detection
title_zh: CODiff：用于伪装物体检测的单步扩散模型

sentences.en: Diffusion-based camouflaged object detection (COD) has recently shown great potential.
sentences.zh: 基于扩散的隐蔽目标检测（COD）近来展现出巨大的潜力。

sentences.en: In contrast to existing approaches that rely on multiple sample steps to refine the predicted masks, we propose CODiff, which reformulates the diffusion process to enable one-step mask prediction while maintaining competitive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 与现有方法依赖多步采样来精炼预测掩码不同，我们提出 CODiff，它重新表述了扩散过程，以在保持有竞争力精度的同时实现单步掩码预测。

sentences.en: Specifically, we first establish the theoretical feasibility of one-step sampling for COD.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们首先确立 COD 单步采样的理论可行性。

sentences.en: Based on this, we design a dedicated network for one-step inference with a global semantic guidance mechanism to guide the denoising process globally and hierarchical condition integration blocks to provide fine-grained structural semantics.
sentences.zh: 基于此，我们设计了一个用于单步推理的专门网络，其中包含一个全局语义引导机制来全局地引导去噪过程，以及层次化条件整合模块来提供细粒度的结构语义。

sentences.en: In addition, we design a straight-forward regularization to learn better intermediate features by bridging the representation gap between the condition backbone and the diffusion model.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们设计了一个直接的正则化方法，通过弥合条件主干与扩散模型之间的表示差距来学习更好的中间特征。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that CODiff achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple benchmarks, improving MAE by over 22\% on the challenging COD10K dataset.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，CODiff 在多个基准上取得了最先进的性能，在具有挑战性的 COD10K 数据集上将 MAE 提升了超过 22\%。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/KiiSooo/CODiff.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/KiiSooo/CODiff 获取。

title_en: CoEvol-NO: State and Coordinate Co-Evolution with an Error-Driven Predictor-Corrector Paradigm for Neural Operator Transformer
title_zh: CoEvol-NO：通过误差驱动预测–校正范式实现神经算子 Transformer 的状态与坐标协同演化

sentences.en: Despite the fast progress in neural operator learning, long-sequence modeling still is a standing challenge whereby latent states have been introduced with techniques well derived.
sentences.zh: 尽管神经算子学习进展迅速，长序列建模仍然是一个长久存在的挑战，而潜状态已通过精心推导的技术被引入。

sentences.en: Diverging from existing methods that treat latent states as transient variables or decoupled representations, CoEvol-NO introduces a {persistent state} to establish a {co-evolutionary framework}, where the latent state and mesh sequence are updated jointly and bidirectionally.
sentences.zh: 与将潜状态视为瞬态变量或解耦表示的现有方法不同，CoEvol-NO 引入一个{持久状态}来建立{共同演化框架}，其中潜状态与网格序列被联合地、双向地更新。

sentences.en: Inspired by classical numerical methods, we model the layer-wise state evolution as a {Predictor-Corrector (PC)} process.
sentences.zh: 受经典数值方法的启发，我们将逐层状态演化建模为一个{预测-校正（PC）}过程。

sentences.en: Specifically, a ``Predictor'' generates a tentative target, followed by a ``Corrector'' that refines the persistent state via an {error-driven update mechanism}.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，一个“预测器”生成一个试探性的目标，随后一个“校正器”通过{误差驱动的更新机制}精炼持久状态。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our theoretical analysis reveals that the widely used \textit{direct substitution} and \textit{residual update} paradigms are essentially {first-order approximations} of this error-driven correction under different loss assumptions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的理论分析揭示，广泛使用的\textit{direct substitution} 与 \textit{residual update} 范式，本质上是在不同损失假设下这一误差驱动校正的{一阶近似}。

sentences.en: We theoretically prove that CoEvol-NO achieves strict {linear time complexity}.
sentences.zh: 我们在理论上证明 CoEvol-NO 实现了严格的{线性时间复杂度}。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on five standard benchmarks and two large-scale industrial design tasks demonstrate that CoEvol-NO consistently achieves {state-of-the-art (SOTA)} performance.
sentences.zh: 在五个标准基准与两个大规模工业设计任务上的大量实验表明，CoEvol-NO 一贯地实现了{最先进（SOTA）}性能。

title_en: Coevolutionary Continuous Discrete Diffusion: Make Your Diffusion Language Model a Latent Reasoner
title_zh: 协同演化的连续–离散扩散：让扩散语言模型成为潜在空间推理器

sentences.en: Diffusion language models, especially masked discrete diffusion models, have achieved great success recently.
sentences.zh: 扩散语言模型，尤其是掩码离散扩散模型，近来取得了巨大的成功。

sentences.en: While there are some theoretical and primary empirical results showing the advantages of latent reasoning with looped transformers or continuous CoT, continuous diffusion models typically underperform their discrete counterparts.
sentences.zh: 虽然有一些理论与初步的实证结果表明，利用循环 Transformer 或连续思维链进行潜在推理具有优势，但连续扩散模型的表现通常逊于其离散对应物。

sentences.en: In this paper, we argue that diffusion language models do not necessarily need to be in the discrete space.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们认为扩散语言模型不一定需要在离散空间中进行。

sentences.en: In particular, we prove that continuous diffusion models have stronger expressivity than discrete diffusions and looped transformers.
sentences.zh: 特别地，我们证明连续扩散模型比离散扩散与循环 Transformer 具有更强的表达力。

sentences.en: We attribute the contradiction between the theoretical expressiveness and empirical performance to their practical trainability: while continuous diffusion provides intermediate supervision that looped transformers lack, they are harder to generate and decode tokens in the continuous representation space compared with discrete states.
sentences.zh: 我们将理论表达力与实证性能之间的矛盾归因于它们在实际中的可训练性：虽然连续扩散提供了循环 Transformer 所缺乏的中间监督，但与离散状态相比，在连续表示空间中生成与解码词元更为困难。

sentences.en: We therefore propose **C**oevolutionary **C**ontinuous **D**iscrete **D**iffusion (CCDD), which defines a joint multimodal diffusion process on the union of a continuous representation space and a discrete token space, leveraging a single model to simultaneously denoise in the joint space.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出**共**同演化的**连**续**离**散**扩**散（CCDD），它在连续表示空间与离散词元空间的并集上定义一个联合多模态扩散过程，利用单一模型在联合空间中同时去噪。

sentences.en: By combining two modalities, CCDD is expressive with rich semantics in the latent space, as well as good trainability and sample quality with the help of explicit discrete tokens.
sentences.zh: 通过结合两种模态，CCDD 在潜在空间中具有丰富语义的表达力，并在显式离散词元的帮助下具有良好的可训练性与样本质量。

sentences.en: We also propose effective architectures and advanced training/sampling techniques for CCDD, which reveals strong empirical performance in extensive language modeling experiments on real-world tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们还为 CCDD 提出了有效的架构与先进的训练/采样技术，在现实世界任务的大量语言建模实验中揭示了强大的实证性能。

title_en: CoF-T2I: Video Models as Pure Visual Reasoners for Text-to-Image Generation
title_zh: CoF-T2I：将视频模型作为文生图的纯视觉推理器

sentences.en: Recent video generation models have revealed the emergence of Chain-of-Frame (CoF) reasoning, enabling frame-by-frame visual inference.
sentences.zh: 近期的视频生成模型揭示了帧链（CoF）推理的涌现，实现了逐帧的视觉推理。

sentences.en: With this capability, video models have been successfully applied to various visual tasks (*e.g.*, maze solving, visual puzzles).
sentences.zh: 凭借这一能力，视频模型已被成功应用于各种视觉任务（*例如*迷宫求解、视觉谜题）。

sentences.en: However, their potential to enhance text-to-image (T2I) generation remains largely unexplored due to the absence of a clearly defined visual reasoning starting point and interpretable intermediate states in the T2I generation process.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于 T2I 生成过程中缺乏明确定义的视觉推理起点与可解释的中间状态，它们增强文生图（T2I）生成的潜力在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose **CoF-T2I**, a model that integrates CoF reasoning into T2I generation via progressive visual refinement, where intermediate frames act as explicit reasoning steps and the final frame is taken as output.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一差距，我们提出 **CoF-T2I**，一个通过渐进式视觉精炼将 CoF 推理整合进 T2I 生成的模型，其中中间帧充当显式的推理步骤，最终帧被作为输出。

sentences.en: To establish such explicit generation process, we curate **CoF-Evol-Instruct**, a dataset of CoF trajectories that model the generation process from semantics to aesthetics.
sentences.zh: 为建立这种显式的生成过程，我们整理了 **CoF-Evol-Instruct**，一个建模从语义到美学生成过程的 CoF 轨迹数据集。

sentences.en: To further improve quality and avoid motion artifacts, we enable an independent encoding operation for each frame.
sentences.zh: 为进一步提升质量并避免运动伪影，我们为每一帧启用独立的编码操作。

sentences.en: Experiments show that CoF-T2I significantly outperforms the base video model and achieves competitive performance, reaching 0.86 on GenEval and 7.468 on Imagine-Bench.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，CoF-T2I 显著优于基础视频模型，并取得了有竞争力的性能，在 GenEval 上达到 0.86，在 Imagine-Bench 上达到 7.468。

sentences.en: These results indicate the substantial promise of video models for advancing high-quality text-to-image generation.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，视频模型在推进高质量文生图方面具有巨大的前景。

authors.name: Shenglong Zhang
authors.institution: Xi'an University of Electronic Science and Technology

title_en: CofactGVR: Counterfactual Intervention for Grounded Visual Reasoning
title_zh: CofactGVR：用于视觉落地推理的反事实干预

sentences.en: Despite rapid progress in Grounded Visual Reasoning (GVR) with MLLMs and RL-style fine-tuning, existing approaches often lack effective learning signals for intermediate grounding decisions and are prone to shortcut solutions.
sentences.zh: 尽管带 MLLM 与 RL 风格微调的接地视觉推理（GVR）进展迅速，现有方法往往缺乏用于中间接地决策的有效学习信号，并且容易走向捷径解。

sentences.en: In this work, we explicitly decompose GVR into Evidence Generation followed by Counterfactual Answer Reasoning, and formalize this structure as a Causal Grounding Graph (CGG) in which the generated evidence acts as a causal mediator.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们将 GVR 显式地分解为证据生成与随后的反事实答案推理两个阶段，并将这一结构形式化为一个因果接地图（CGG），其中生成的证据充当因果中介。

sentences.en: Building on this formulation, we propose CofactGVR, which estimates the mediator’s utility via a matched counterfactual intervention that perturbs the predicted region while keeping the original image–question context fixed.
sentences.zh: 基于这一表述，我们提出 CofactGVR，它通过一个匹配的反事实干预来估计中介的效用，该干预扰动预测区域，同时保持原始图像-问题上下文不变。

sentences.en: The factual–counterfactual reward gap yields a principled intermediate bonus, selectively assigned to high-quality factual rollouts to promote evidence-faithful reasoning.
sentences.zh: 事实-反事实奖励差距产生一个有原则的中间奖励，被选择性地分配给高质量的事实 rollout，以促进证据忠实的推理。

sentences.en: To further stabilize and efficiently exploit this causal training signal, we incorporate a Quantile-filtered Prioritized Advantage Sampling (Q-PAS) strategy that preferentially updates on trajectories with high-magnitude advantages while filtering low-signal samples.
sentences.zh: 为进一步稳定并高效地利用这一因果训练信号，我们引入一种分位数过滤的优先优势采样（Q-PAS）策略，它优先更新具有高幅度优势的轨迹，同时过滤低信号样本。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across GVR benchmarks show consistent improvements, indicating that CofactGVR strengthens reliance on informative visual evidence under controlled interventions.
sentences.zh: 在 GVR 基准上的大量实验显示出一致的改进，表明 CofactGVR 在受控干预下增强了对信息性视觉证据的依赖。

sentences.en: Our source code will be released at https://github.com/zhangy0822/CofactGVR.
sentences.zh: 我们的源代码将在 https://github.com/zhangy0822/CofactGVR 发布。

title_en: CoFrGeNet: Continued Fraction Architectures for Language Generation
title_zh: CoFrGeNet：用于语言生成的连分数架构

sentences.en: Transformers are arguably the preferred architecture for language generation.
sentences.zh: Transformer 可以说是语言生成的首选架构。

sentences.en: In this paper, inspired by continued fractions, we introduce a new function class for generative modeling.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，受连分数的启发，我们为生成式建模引入了一个新的函数类。

sentences.en: The architecture family implementing this function class is named CoFrGeNets - Continued Fraction Generative Networks.
sentences.zh: 实现这一函数类的架构家族被命名为 CoFrGeNet——连分数生成网络（Continued Fraction Generative Networks）。

sentences.en: We design novel architectural components based on this function class that can replace Multi-head Attention and Feed-Forward Networks in Transformer blocks while requiring much fewer parameters.
sentences.zh: 我们基于这一函数类设计了新颖的架构组件，它们可以替代 Transformer 块中的多头注意力与前馈网络，同时所需的参数少得多。

sentences.en: We derive custom gradient formulations to optimize the proposed components more accurately and efficiently than using standard PyTorch-based gradients.
sentences.zh: 我们推导了定制的梯度公式，以比使用标准 PyTorch 梯度更精确、更高效地优化所提出的组件。

sentences.en: Our components are a plug-in replacement requiring little change in training or inference procedures that have already been put in place for Transformer-based models thus making our approach easy to incorporate in large industrial workflows.
sentences.zh: 我们的组件是即插即用的替代品，对已为基于 Transformer 的模型设置好的训练或推理流程几乎无需改动，从而使我们的方法易于整合进大型工业工作流。

sentences.en: We experiment on two very different transformer architectures GPT2-xl (1.5B) and Llama3 (3.2B), where the former we pre-train on OpenWebText and GneissWeb, while the latter we pre-train on the docling data mix which consists of nine different datasets.
sentences.zh: 我们在两个截然不同的 Transformer 架构上进行了实验：GPT2-xl（1.5B）与 Llama3（3.2B），前者我们在 OpenWebText 与 GneissWeb 上预训练，后者我们在由九个不同数据集组成的 docling 数据混合上预训练。

sentences.en: Results show that the performance on downstream classification, Q\& A, reasoning and text understanding tasks of our models is competitive and sometimes even superior to the original models with two thirds to half the parameters and shorter pre-training time.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，在仅用三分之二到一半的参数与更短的预训练时间下，我们模型在下游分类、问答、推理与文本理解任务上的性能与原始模型相当，有时甚至更优。

sentences.en: We believe that future implementations customized to hardware will further bring out the true potential of our architectures.
sentences.zh: 我们相信，未来针对硬件定制的实现将能进一步发挥我们架构的真正潜力。

title_en: COFT: Counterfactual–Conformal Decoding for Fair Chain‑of‑Thought Reasoning in Large Language Models
title_zh: COFT：通过反事实–共形解码实现大语言模型公平思维链推理

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) can reveal and amplify societal biases during chain-of-thought (CoT) generation.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）在思维链（CoT）生成过程中可能显露出并放大社会偏见。

sentences.en: We present COFT (Chain of Fair Thought), a training-free decoding method that applies token-level fairness control at decode time, with distribution-free marginal validity guarantees (under exchangeability) for any frozen causal language model.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 COFT（Chain of Fair Thought），一种免训练的解码方法，它在解码时应用词元级的公平性控制，并为任何冻结的因果语言模型提供无分布的边际有效性保证（在可交换性下）。

sentences.en: COFT operates in three stages.
sentences.zh: COFT 分三个阶段运作。

sentences.en: First, it creates a masked counterfactual prompt by replacing sensitive spans with neutral tokens.
sentences.zh: 首先，它通过将敏感片段替换为中性词元来创建一个掩码的反事实提示。

sentences.en: Second, it compares the factual and masked logit distributions through lightweight logit fusion to attenuate attribute-driven biases.
sentences.zh: 其次，它通过轻量级的 logit 融合比较事实与掩码的 logit 分布，以削弱属性驱动的偏差。

sentences.en: Third, it uses dual-branch split-conformal calibration to certify per-step candidate token sets at a user-chosen risk level.
sentences.zh: 第三，它使用双分支分裂保形校准，在用户选择的风险水平下认证每步骤的候选词元集合。

sentences.en: We evaluate COFT across six models and multiple bias benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 我们在六个模型与多个偏差基准上评估了 COFT。

sentences.en: Our method reduces standard bias metrics by 30–55\% (median 38\%) while preserving task utility and language quality.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法将标准偏差指标降低了 30–55\%（中位数 38\%），同时保持了任务效用与语言质量。

sentences.en: Reasoning accuracies remain unchanged within run-to-run noise margins.
sentences.zh: 推理准确率在运行间噪声范围内保持不变。

sentences.en: The computational overhead is modest, equivalent to one additional cached forward pass (<=11%).
sentences.zh: 计算开销适中，相当于额外一次缓存的 forward 传（不超过 11%）。

sentences.en: COFT offers a clear, auditable path to safer CoT generation with significant bias reduction, negligible utility loss, and no requirement for retraining, auxiliary classifiers, or weight access.
sentences.zh: COFT 为更安全的 CoT 生成提供了一条清晰、可审计的路径，具有显著的偏差削减、可忽略的效用损失，并且不需要重训练、辅助分类器或访问权重。

title_en: CoGe-GCD: Reframing Generalized Category Discovery with Compositional Generalization
title_zh: CoGe-GCD：利用组合泛化重构广义类别发现

sentences.en: Generalized Category Discovery (GCD) assigns unlabeled instances, mixed with labeled data, to known or novel categories, requiring human-like compositional reasoning: reusing primitives learned from known classes and deciding when new combinations imply new categories.
sentences.zh: 广义类别发现（GCD）将混有标注数据的无标注实例分配给已知或新颖类别，这需要类人的组合式推理：复用从已知类别学习到的基元，并判断何时新的组合意味着新的类别。

sentences.en: Existing GCD methods operate on unstructured token features and struggle to extrapolate to novel compositions.
sentences.zh: 现有的 GCD 方法在无结构的词元特征上运作，难以外推至新颖组合。

sentences.en: We propose CoGe-GCD, which rethinks GCD through compositional generalization with two coupled stages.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CoGe-GCD，它通过两个耦合阶段的组合泛化重新思考 GCD。

sentences.en: (i) Compositional Perception structures patch tokens by mapping them to a small vocabulary of primitives and refining token embeddings via competitive token-primitive assignment and information passing, yielding coherent groups for discovery.
sentences.zh: （i）组合感知（Compositional Perception）通过将块词元映射到一个小的基元词汇表，并借助竞争性的词元-基元分配与信息传递来精炼词元嵌入，从而构建用于发现的一致分组。

sentences.en: (ii) Generalizing Induction exploits the induced geometric structure and applies a structure-preserving calibration over spatial relations, maintaining probabilistic semantics while improving extrapolation to unseen primitive combinations.
sentences.zh: （ii）泛化归纳（Generalizing Induction）利用导出的几何结构，对空间关系应用保持结构的校准，在保持概率语义的同时改进对未见基元组合的外推。

sentences.en: CoGe-GCD is implemented as an inductive-bias module between backbone and projection head, without modifying heads or losses, and can be plugged into diverse GCD frameworks.
sentences.zh: CoGe-GCD 作为主干与投影头之间的一个归纳偏置模块实现，无需修改头部或损失，并且可以插入各种 GCD 框架。

sentences.en: On standard benchmarks, it consistently improves all-class accuracy, unknown-class number estimation, and geometric quality, with marginal computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 在标准基准上，它一贯地提升全类准确率、未知类别数估计与几何质量，计算开销边际化。

title_en: CoGenCast: A Coupled Autoregressive–Flow Generative Framework for Time Series Forecasting
title_zh: CoGenCast：时间序列预测的耦合自回归–流生成框架

sentences.en: Time series forecasting can be  viewed as a generative problem that requires both semantic understanding over contextual conditions and stochastic modeling of continuous temporal dynamics.
sentences.zh: 时间序列预测可以被视为一个生成问题，它既需要对语境条件的语义理解，也需要对连续时间动力学的随机建模。

sentences.en: Existing approaches typically rely on either autoregressive large language models (LLMs) for semantic context modeling or diffusion-like models for continuous probabilistic generation.
sentences.zh: 现有方法通常要么依赖自回归大语言模型（LLM）进行语义上下文建模，要么依赖扩散类模型进行连续概率生成。

sentences.en: However, neither method alone can adequately model both aspects simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 然而，这两种方法各自都无法同时充分建模这两个方面。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose CoGenCast, a hybrid generative framework that couples pre-trained LLMs with flow-matching mechanism for effective time series forecasting.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 CoGenCast，一个将预训练 LLM 与流匹配机制耦合起来的混合生成框架，用于有效的时间序列预测。

sentences.en: Specifically, we reconfigure  pre-trained decoder-only LLMs into a  native forecasting encoder–decoder backbone by modifying only the attention topology, enabling bidirectional context encoding and causal representation generation.
sentences.zh: 具体而言，我们仅通过修改注意力拓扑，就将预训练的解码器专用 LLM 重新配置为原生的预测编码器-解码器主干，从而实现双向上下文编码与因果表示生成。

sentences.en: Building on this, a flow-matching mechanism  is further integrated to model temporal evolution, capturing continuous stochastic dynamics conditioned on the autoregressively generated representation.
sentences.zh: 在此基础上，进一步整合一个流匹配机制来建模时间演化，捕获以自回归生成的表示为条件的连续随机动力学。

sentences.en: Notably, CoGenCast naturally supports multimodal forecasting and cross-domain unified training.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，CoGenCast 天然地支持多模态预测与跨域统一训练。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that CoGenCast achieves  competitive performance compared to previous  baselines.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，CoGenCast 相较于先前基线取得了有竞争力的性能。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/liuyaguo/_CoGenCast}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/liuyaguo/_CoGenCast} 获取。

title_en: CoGeoAD: Hierarchical Color-Geometric Fusion with Multi-View Attention for Zero-Shot 3D Anomaly Detection
title_zh: CoGeoAD：结合多视图注意力的分层颜色–几何融合，实现零样本三维异常检测

sentences.en: Zero-shot 3D anomaly detection is essential for industrial quality inspection, where labeled anomaly samples are scarce.
sentences.zh: 零样本 3D 异常检测对工业质检至关重要，因为在此类场景中有标签的异常样本十分稀缺。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, existing methods lack an effective mechanism to fuse complementary 2D color images with 3D geometric structures, limiting their ability to detect both surface and structural defects in a unified framework.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，现有方法缺乏一种有效机制来融合互补的 2D 彩色图像与 3D 几何结构，限制了它们在统一框架中同时检测表面缺陷与结构缺陷的能力。

sentences.en: To address these issues, we propose CoGeoAD, a unified CLIP-based framework that fuses color and geometric features by constructing pixel-aligned paired multi-view images.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们提出 CoGeoAD，一个统一的、基于 CLIP 的框架，它通过构建像素对齐的配对多视角图像来融合颜色与几何特征。

sentences.en: The framework introduces a Data-Driven Multi-View Attention (MVA) mechanism to adaptively aggregate 3D features and a Multi-Stage Color-Geometric Fusion (MS-CGF) module to hierarchically integrate multi-level features from both modalities.
sentences.zh: 该框架引入一种数据驱动的多视角注意力（MVA）机制以自适应地聚合 3D 特征，以及一个多阶段颜色-几何融合（MS-CGF）模块，以层次化地整合来自两种模态的多层特征。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on the MVTec3D-AD and Eyecandies benchmarks demonstrate that CoGeoAD achieves state-of-the-art performance, effectively capturing both structural and textural anomalies in complex industrial scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在 MVTec3D-AD 与 Eyecandies 基准上的大量实验表明，CoGeoAD 取得了最先进的性能，在复杂工业场景中有效地捕获了结构异常与纹理异常。

title_en: Cognitive Fatigue in Autoregressive Transformers: Formalization and Measurement
title_zh: 自回归 Transformer 的认知疲劳：形式化与测量

sentences.en: Autoregressive language models frequently degrade during long-horizon generation, producing repetitive text, losing instruction adherence, and exhibiting unstable entropy.
sentences.zh: 自回归语言模型在长时序生成过程中常常退化，产生重复文本、丢失指令遵从性，并表现出不稳定的熵。

sentences.en: Despite the prevalence of these failures, practitioners lack online diagnostics to detect them in real-time as they occur.
sentences.zh: 尽管这些失败普遍存在，从业者缺乏用于在它们发生时实时检测的在线诊断手段。

sentences.en: We formalize this degradation as cognitive fatigue, a measurable generation-time state characterized by decay in attention to the original prompt, representational drift, and entropy miscalibration.
sentences.zh: 我们将这种退化形式化为认知疲劳，一种可度量的生成时状态，其特征是对原始提示注意力的衰减、表示漂移以及熵的校准失当。

sentences.en: We introduce the Fatigue Index (FI), a lightweight, model-agnostic diagnostic that aggregates these three signals under explicit axioms (monotonicity, boundedness, interpretability) enabling reliable runtime monitoring.
sentences.zh: 我们引入疲劳指数（FI），一个轻量级、与模型无关的诊断指标，它在显式的公理（单调性、有界性、可解释性）下聚合这三种信号，实现可靠的运行时监控。

sentences.en: Across nine models (1B–13B parameters), FI trajectories exhibit structured temporal dynamics, predict task degradation (AUROC = 0.95) and repetition ($\rho = 0.94$), and reveal non-monotonic scaling behavior: instruction-tuned models below 3B exhibit faster collapse than base models, with this trend reversing at 7B.
sentences.zh: 在九个模型（1B–13B 参数）上，FI 轨迹表现出结构化的时间动态，可预测任务退化（AUROC = 0.95）与重复（$\rho = 0.94$），并揭示了非单调的扩展行为：3B 以下的指令微调模型比基础模型更早崩溃，这一趋势在 7B 时发生逆转。

sentences.en: Stress analyses further show that FI onset accelerates under longer contexts, middle-positioned evidence, and reduced numerical precision.
sentences.zh: 压力分析进一步表明，在更长的上下文、中位证据以及降低的数值精度下，FI 的出现会加速。

sentences.en: These results establish cognitive fatigue as a coherent and measurable phenomenon, and position FI as a principled tool for runtime reliability monitoring in production LLM systems.
sentences.zh: 这些结果确立了认知疲劳是一个连贯且可度量的现象，并将 FI 定位为生产级 LLM 系统中运行时可靠性监控的有原则的工具。

title_en: COGNOS: Universal Enhancement for Time Series Anomaly Detection via Constrained Gaussian-Noise Optimization and Smoothing
title_zh: COGNOS：通过约束高斯噪声优化与平滑普遍增强时间序列异常检测

sentences.en: Reconstruction-based methods are a dominant paradigm in time series anomaly detection (TSAD), however, their near-universal reliance on Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss results in statistically flawed reconstruction residuals.
sentences.zh: 基于重建的方法是时间序列异常检测（TSAD）中的主导范式，然而它们近乎普遍地依赖均方误差（MSE）损失，导致重建残差在统计上有缺陷。

sentences.en: This fundamental weakness leads to noisy, unstable anomaly scores, hindering reliable detection.
sentences.zh: 这一根本弱点导致嘈杂、不稳定的异常分数，阻碍了可靠的检测。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Constrained Gaussian-Noise Optimization and Smoothing (COGNOS), a universal, model-agnostic enhancement framework that tackles this issue at its source.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一问题，我们提出受约束高斯噪声优化与平滑（COGNOS），一个通用、与模型无关的增强框架，从源头上解决这一问题。

sentences.en: COGNOS introduces a novel Gaussian-White Noise Regularization strategy during training, which directly constrains the model's output residuals to conform to a Gaussian white noise distribution.
sentences.zh: COGNOS 在训练期间引入一种新颖的高斯白噪声正则化策略，直接约束模型的输出残差服从高斯白噪声分布。

sentences.en: This engineered statistical property creates the ideal precondition for our second contribution: Adaptive Residual Kalman Smoother that provably operates as a statistically robust estimator to denoise the raw anomaly scores.
sentences.zh: 这一经过工程设计的统计性质为我们的第二项贡献创造了理想的前提：一种自适应残差 Kalman 平滑器，它在证明层面作为一种统计稳健的估计器运作，对原始异常分数进行去噪。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that COGNOS consistently enhances the performance of state-of-the-art backbones significantly, validating the efficacy of coupling statistical regularization with adaptive filtering.
sentences.zh: 在多个基准上的大量实验表明，COGNOS 一致地显著增强最先进主干网络的性能，验证了将统计正则化与自适应滤波相耦合的有效性。

title_en: CoIRL-AD: Collaborative-Competitive Imitation-Reinforcement Learning in Latent World Models for Autonomous Driving
title_zh: CoIRL-AD：用于自动驾驶的潜在世界模型中的协作–竞争模仿强化学习

sentences.en: End-to-end autonomous driving models trained with imitation learning (IL) often generalize poorly, particularly in long-tail scenarios where expert demonstrations are sparse.
sentences.zh: 用模仿学习（IL）训练的端到端自动驾驶模型往往泛化不佳，尤其是在专家演示稀疏的长尾场景中。

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can provide complementary task-level supervision, but applying RL to real-world autonomous driving is challenging in offline settings without interactive simulators, where datasets are dominated by expert actions and provide limited behavioral diversity.
sentences.zh: 强化学习（RL）可以提供互补的任务级监督，但在没有交互式模拟器的离线设定下，将 RL 应用于现实世界的自动驾驶颇具挑战：此时数据集由专家动作主导，提供的行为多样性有限。

sentences.en: We propose CoIRL-AD, a competitive dual-policy framework that integrates IL and RL under a unified offline training regime.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CoIRL-AD，一个在统一离线训练机制下整合 IL 与 RL 的竞争性双策略框架。

sentences.en: CoIRL-AD decouples imitation and reward optimization into separate actors to alleviate objective conflicts, uses imagined future rollouts for long-horizon reward estimation, and introduces a competition mechanism that selectively transfers beneficial behaviors while keeping RL anchored to expert-like driving.
sentences.zh: CoIRL-AD 将模仿与奖励优化解耦为独立的行动者，以缓解目标冲突；使用想象的未来 rollout 进行长时间奖励估计；并引入一种竞争机制，选择性地迁移有益行为，同时使 RL 锚定于类似专家的驾驶。

sentences.en: Experiments on the nuScenes benchmark show that CoIRL-AD consistently improves robustness over strong IL-based baselines, with especially large gains in cross-city generalization and long-tail scenarios.
sentences.zh: 在 nuScenes 基准上的实验表明，CoIRL-AD 一贯地提升了相比强 IL 基线的稳健性，尤其是在跨城市泛化与长尾场景中带来巨大收益。

sentences.en: Code is available at: https://github.com/SEU-zxj/CoIRL-AD.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/SEU-zxj/CoIRL-AD 获取。

authors.name: Yuhang PENG
authors.institution: Institute for AI Industry Research, Tsinghua University

title_en: CoLA: Cross-Modal Low-rank Adaptation for Multimodal Downstream Tasks
title_zh: CoLA：面向多模态下游任务的跨模态低秩适配

sentences.en: Foundation models have revolutionized AI, but adapting them efficiently for multimodal tasks, particularly in dual-stream architectures composed of unimodal encoders, such as DINO and BERT, remains a significant challenge.
sentences.zh: 基础模型彻底改变了 AI，但如何高效地将其适配到多模态任务——尤其是由单模态编码器（如 DINO 与 BERT）组成的双流架构——仍然是一个重大挑战。

sentences.en: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) methods like Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enable lightweight adaptation, yet they operate in isolation within each modality, limiting their ability in capturing cross-modal interactions.
sentences.zh: 诸如低秩适配（LoRA）之类的参数高效微调（PEFT）方法实现了轻量适配，然而它们在每种模态内孤立地运作，限制了它们捕获跨模态交互的能力。

sentences.en: In this paper, we take a step in bridging this gap with Cross-Modal Low-Rank Adaptation (CoLA), a novel PEFT framework that extends LoRA by introducing a dedicated inter-modal adaptation pathway alongside the standard intra-modal one.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过跨模态低秩适配（CoLA）向弥合这一差距迈出了一步，这是一个新颖的 PEFT 框架，它通过在标准的模态内路径之外引入一条专用的模态间适配路径来扩展 LoRA。

sentences.en: This dual-path design enables CoLA to adapt unimodal foundation models to multimodal tasks effectively, without interference between modality-specific and cross-modal learning.
sentences.zh: 这一双路径设计使 CoLA 能够有效地将单模态基础模型适配到多模态任务，而不会在模态特定学习与跨模态学习之间产生干扰。

sentences.en: We evaluate CoLA across a range of vision-language (RefCOCO, RefCOCO+, RefCOCOg) and audio-visual (AVE, AVS) benchmarks, where it consistently outperforms LORA, achieving a relative gain of around 3\% and 2\%, respectively, while maintaining parameter efficiency.
sentences.zh: 我们在一系列视觉-语言（RefCOCO、RefCOCO+、RefCOCOg）与音频-视觉（AVE、AVS）基准上评估了 CoLA，它一致地优于 LoRA，分别实现了约 3\% 与 2\% 的相对收益，同时保持了参数效率。

sentences.en: Notably, CoLA enables the first multi-task PEFT framework for visual grounding, bridging a key gap in efficient multimodal adaptation.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，CoLA 实现了首个面向视觉接地的多任务 PEFT 框架，弥合了高效多模态适配中的一个关键差距。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/peterwisu/CoLA
sentences.zh: 代码可在 https://github.com/peterwisu/CoLA 获取。

title_en: Cold-Start Personalization via Bayesian Adaptive Questioning
title_zh: 通过贝叶斯自适应提问实现冷启动个性化

sentences.en: Cold-start personalization requires inferring preferences from minimal interaction when no user-specific historical data is available.
sentences.zh: 冷启动个性化要求在没有任何用户特定历史数据可用的情形下，从最少的交互中推断偏好。

sentences.en: The space of possible preferences is vast, yet users care about only a sparse subset and rarely articulate them upfront; combined with limited interaction budgets, this makes preference elicitation challenging.
sentences.zh: 可能偏好的空间极为广阔，然而用户只关心其中一个稀疏子集，并且很少一开始就明确说出；加之有限的交互预算，这使得偏好引出颇具挑战。

sentences.en: Our key insight is that preferences exhibit predictable structure across populations; e.g., users who want detailed explanations often also value worked examples.
sentences.zh: 我们的关键洞见是，偏好跨人群表现出可预测的结构；例如，想要详细解释的用户往往也重视带解答步骤的示例。

sentences.en: We propose CAPE (Cold start Adaptive Preference Elicitation with Priors), a principled system decomposition framework for cold-start personalization: learning a structured world model of preference correlations offline using latent variables, then performing Bayesian inference online without retraining.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 CAPE（带先验的冷启动自适应偏好引出），一个用于冷启动个性化的有原则系统分解框架：离线使用潜变量学习偏好相关性的结构化世界模型，然后在线执行贝叶斯推断，而无需重训练。

sentences.en: Even simple belief model instantiations (e.g., linear regression) substantially outperform end-to-end RL.
sentences.zh: 即便是简单的信念模型实例化（例如线性回归）也大幅优于端到端 RL。

sentences.en: Across medical, mathematical, social, and commonsense reasoning, CAPE achieves 80.8% alignment with ground-truth user preferences versus 68.5% for RL, requires 3-5× fewer interactions, and adapts twice as often.
sentences.zh: 在医学、数学、社交与常识推理中，CAPE 与真实用户偏好的对齐度达到 80.8%，而 RL 为 68.5%，所需交互次数减少 3–5×，并且自适应频率提高一倍。

sentences.en: Our contribution is a principled decomposition of cold-start personalization that makes Bayesian preference elicitation practical at scale for LLM systems.
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献是对冷启动个性化的一种有原则的分解，使得贝叶斯偏好引出能够在 LLM 系统上大规模落地。

authors.name: Avinandan Bose
authors.institution: University of Washington Meta AI FAIR

title_en: CollabBench: Benchmarking and Unleashing Collaborative Ability of LLMs with Diverse Players via Proactive Engagement
title_zh: CollabBench：通过主动参与评测并释放大语言模型与多样化参与者的协作能力

sentences.en: While LLM-based agents excel at individual tasks, effective collaboration with realistic human partners remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 虽然基于 LLM 的智能体在个体任务上表现出色，但与现实人类伙伴的有效协作仍然充满挑战。

sentences.en: Most of the existing conversation-level collaborative studies lack grounded interaction and behavioral execution, motivating the need for cooperative game environments that enable contextualized and immersive collaboration.
sentences.zh: 大多数现有的大多基于对话层面的协作研究缺乏落地的交互与行为执行，这促使了能够实现情境化、沉浸式协作的合作式博弈环境的需求。

sentences.en: To this end, this paper proposes CollabBench, a benchmark for evaluating and training collaborative agents in cooperative games.
sentences.zh: 为此，本文提出 CollabBench，一个用于在合作式博弈中评估与训练协作智能体的基准。

sentences.en: CollabBench features a Diverse Player Profile Simulation pipeline to model varied players behaviors, and a Collaborative Agentic Training paradigm that unifies reasoning, communication, and action via agentic rollouts, optimized with a hybrid reward balancing task efficiency and affective adaptation.
sentences.zh: CollabBench 具有一个多样化参与者画像模拟流水线来建模多变的参与者行为，以及一个协作式智能体训练范式，它通过智能体 rollout 统一推理、通信与行动，并借助一个在任务效率与情感适应之间取得平衡的混合奖励进行优化。

sentences.en: We further extend classic environments to CWAH-MultiPlayer and Cook-MultiPlayer for systematic evaluation under diverse personalities.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步将经典环境扩展到 CWAH-MultiPlayer 与 Cook-MultiPlayer，以便在多样人格下进行系统性评估。

sentences.en: Experiments with efficiency and affective metrics show that our trained models outperform base models, achieving 19.5% higher efficiency and 24.4% improved affective performance.
sentences.zh: 效率与情感指标的实验表明，我们训练的模型优于基础模型，实现了 19.5% 更高的效率与 24.4% 更好的情感表现。

sentences.en: Further analysis reveals key collaborative limitations of existing models and offers insights for future collaborative training.
sentences.zh: 进一步的分析揭示了现有模型的关键协作局限，并为未来的协作训练提供了洞见。

title_en: Collaborative and Efficient Fine-tuning: Leveraging Task Similarity
title_zh: 协作且高效的微调：利用任务相似性

sentences.en: *Adaptability* has been regarded as a central feature in the foundation models, enabling them to effectively acclimate to unseen downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: *适应性*一直被视为基础模型的核心特征，使它们能够有效地适应未见过的下游任务。

sentences.en: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning methods such as celebrated LoRA facilitate efficient adaptation of large foundation models using labeled, high-quality and generally scarce task data.
sentences.zh: 诸如广受赞誉的 LoRA 之类的参数高效微调方法，利用有标注、高质量且通常稀缺的任务数据，实现了大型基础模型的高效适配。

sentences.en: To mitigate data scarcity in fine-tuning of foundation models, we propose to leverage *task similarity* across downstream users.
sentences.zh: 为缓解基础模型微调中的数据稀缺，我们提出利用下游用户之间的*任务相似性*。

sentences.en: Intuitively, users with similar tasks must be able to assist each other in boosting the effective fine-tuning data size.
sentences.zh: 直觉上，具有相似任务的用户必须能够相互协助，以提升有效的微调数据规模。

sentences.en: We propose *Collaborative Low-Rank Adaptation*, or CoLoRA, which exploits task similarity to collaboratively and efficiently fine-tune personalized foundation models.
sentences.zh: 我们提出*协作式低秩适配*，即 CoLoRA，它利用任务相似性来协作且高效地微调个性化的基础模型。

sentences.en: The main idea in CoLoRA is to train one shared adapter capturing underlying task similarities across all tasks, and personalized adapters tailored to user-specific tasks.
sentences.zh: CoLoRA 的主要思想是训练一个捕获所有任务底层任务相似性的共享适配器，以及针对用户特定任务量身定制的个性化适配器。

sentences.en: We theoretically study CoLoRA on heterogeneous linear regression and provide provable guarantees for ground truth recovery.
sentences.zh: 我们在异构线性回归上对 CoLoRA 进行了理论研究，并为真实值恢复提供了可证明的保证。

sentences.en: We also conduct several natural language experiments with varying task similarity, which further demonstrate that when trained together with similar tasks, individual performances are significantly boosted.
sentences.zh: 我们还进行了若干具有不同任务相似度的自然语言实验，进一步表明当与相似任务一起训练时，个体性能得到显著提升。

title_en: Collaborative Disagreement Resolution for Scalable Oversight
title_zh: 用于可扩展监督的协作式分歧解决

sentences.en: *Debate*, where AI agents argue opposing positions, has emerged as a key approach to scalable oversight.
sentences.zh: *辩论*——AI 智能体就对立立场展开论争——已成为可扩展监督的关键方法。

sentences.en: However, debate faces a fundamental tension: models are incentivized to be persuasive to the judge, which may not always align with epistemic honesty.
sentences.zh: 然而，辩论面临一个根本性的张力：模型被激励去说服评判者，而这未必总是与认识论上的诚实一致。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose an alternative paradigm: *disagreement resolution*, which reframes the interaction mechanism from adversarial debate to collaborative truth seeking.
sentences.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出一个替代范式：*分歧解决*，它将交互机制从对抗性辩论重新框定为协作式求真。

sentences.en: Drawing on principles from human mediation and conflict resolution, where mediators facilitate dialogue to help disputing parties reach consensus rather than adjudicating between them, we design an automated pipeline that adapts these strategies to AI oversight.
sentences.zh: 借鉴人类调解与冲突解决的原则——调解人促进对话以帮助争议各方达成共识，而非在各方之间仲裁——我们设计了一条将这些策略适配到 AI 监督中的自动化流水线。

sentences.en: Unlike standard debate where models argue for fixed positions, our pipeline directs models to collaboratively identify points of disagreement, examine the evidence for conflicting claims, and converge toward consensus or isolate the specific ''crux'' of their disagreement.
sentences.zh: 与模型为固定立场辩论的标准辩论不同，我们的流水线引导模型协作地识别分歧点、审视相互冲突主张的证据，并趋向共识或隔离出他们分歧的具体“症结”。

sentences.en: We find that Disagreement Resolution consistently helps non-expert models identify the truth, achieving 62.1\% judging accuracy compared to 49.2\% for standard debate.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，分歧解决一致地帮助非专家模型识别真相，实现了 62.1\% 的评判准确率，而标准辩论为 49.2\%。

sentences.en: Our results provide encouraging empirical evidence for rethinking the scalable oversight protocol from adversarial persuasion to collaborative truth-seeking.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果为将可扩展监督协议从对抗性说服重新思考为协作式求真提供了令人鼓舞的实证证据。

topic: General Machine Learning->Unsupervised and Semi-supervised Learning
title_en: Collaborative Learning for Semi-Supervised LiDAR Semantic Segmentation
title_zh: 用于半监督激光雷达语义分割的协作学习

sentences.en: Annotating large-scale LiDAR point clouds for 3D semantic segmentation is costly and time-consuming, which motivates the use of semi-supervised learning (SemiSL).
sentences.zh: 为 3D 语义分割标注大规模 LiDAR 点云代价高昂且耗时，这推动了半监督学习（SemiSL）的采用。

sentences.en: Standard LiDAR SemiSL methods typically adopt a two-step training paradigm, where pseudo-labels are separately generated from a single distillation source, either from the same or another LiDAR representation.
sentences.zh: 标准的 LiDAR SemiSL 方法通常采用两步训练范式，其中伪标签由单一蒸馏源（来自同一或另一种 LiDAR 表示）分别生成。

sentences.en: Such supervision relies on a unique source of pseudo-labels, which can reinforce confirmation bias and propagate errors during training, ultimately limiting performance.
sentences.zh: 此类监督依赖唯一的伪标签来源，这可能强化确认偏误并在训练期间传播误差，最终限制性能。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we introduce *CoLLiS*, a novel framework that leverages **Co**llaborative **L**earning for **Li**DAR **S**emi-supervised segmentation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们引入 *CoLLiS*，一个利用**协**作**学**习进行 **Li**DAR **S**emiSL 的新框架。

sentences.en: Unlike prior paradigms with decoupled pseudo-labeling and training phases, *CoLLiS* trains multiple representations collaboratively in a single step by treating them as coequal students.
sentences.zh: 与先前的解耦伪标签与训练范式不同，*CoLLiS* 将多种表示视为平等的学生，在单步中协作地训练它们。

sentences.en: Each student is adaptively distilled from multiple representations, while inter-student disparities are monitored online to resolve contradictory supervision and effectively mitigate confirmation bias.
sentences.zh: 每个学生都从多种表示中被自适应地蒸馏，同时在线监控学生间的差异，以消解矛盾的监督并有效缓解确认偏误。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on three datasets demonstrate that *CoLLiS* consistently outperforms state-of-the-art LiDAR SemiSL methods, with particularly strong gains in low-label regimes.
sentences.zh: 在三个数据集上的大量实验表明，*CoLLiS* 一致地优于最先进的 LiDAR SemiSL 方法，尤其是在低标签情境下取得了显著增益。

title_en: Collaborative likelihood-ratio estimation over graphs
title_zh: 图上的协作似然比估计

sentences.en: This paper introduces the Collaborative Likelihood-ratio Estimation problem, which is relevant for applications involving multiple statistical estimation tasks that can be mapped to the nodes of a fixed graph expressing pairwise task similarity.
sentences.zh: 本文引入协作式似然比估计问题，它与如下应用相关：多个统计估计任务可以映射到一个表达成对任务相似性的固定图的节点上。

sentences.en: Each graph node $v$ observes i.i.d data from two unknown node-specific pdfs, $p_{v}$ and $q_{v}$, and the goal is to estimate the likelihood-ratios (or density-ratios), $r_{v}(x)=\frac{q_{v}(x)}{p_{v}(x)}$, for all $v$.
sentences.zh: 每个图节点 v 观测来自两个未知节点特定 pdf（p 与 q）的独立同分布数据，目标是估计所有 v 的似然比（或密度比） r(x)=q(x)/p(x)。

sentences.en: Our contribution is multifold: we present a non-parametric collaborative framework that leverages the graph structure of the problem to solve the tasks more efficiently; we present a concrete method that we call Graph-based Relative Unconstrained Least-Squares Importance Fitting (GRULSIF) along with an efficient implementation; we derive convergence rates that highlight the role of the main variables of the problem.
sentences.zh: 我们的贡献是多方面的：我们提出了一个利用问题图结构来更高效求解任务的非参数协作框架；我们提出了一种具体方法，称为基于图的相对无约束最小二乘重要性拟合（GRULSIF），并附有高效实现；我们推导了凸显问题主要变量作用的收敛率。

sentences.en: Our theoretical results explicit the conditions under which the collaborative estimation leads to performance gains compared to solving each estimation task independently.
sentences.zh: 我们的理论结果阐明了协作式估计相较于独立求解每个估计任务带来性能提升的条件。

sentences.en: Finally, in a series of experiments, we demonstrate that the joint likelihood-ratio estimation of GRULSIF at all graph nodes is more accurate compared to state-of-the-art methods that operate independently at each node, and we verify that the behavior of GRULSIF is in agreement with our theoretical analysis.
sentences.zh: 最后，在一系列实验中，我们证明 GRULSIF 在所有图节点上的联合似然比估计比在每个节点独立运作的最先进方法更准确，并验证了 GRULSIF 的行为与我们理论分析的一致性。

title_en: Collaborative Threshold Watermarking
title_zh: 协作式门限水印

sentences.en: In federated learning (FL), $K$ clients jointly train a model without sharing raw data.
sentences.zh: 在联邦学习（FL）中，K 个客户端在不共享原始数据的情况下联合训练一个模型。

sentences.en: Because each participant invests data and compute, clients need mechanisms to later prove the provenance of a jointly trained model.
sentences.zh: 由于每个参与者都投入了数据与计算，客户端需要一种机制来在之后证明联合训练模型的出处。

sentences.en: Model watermarking embeds a hidden signal in the weights, but naive approaches either do not scale with many clients as per-client watermarks dilute as $K$ grows, or give any individual client the ability to verify and potentially remove the watermark.
sentences.zh: 模型水印在权重中嵌入一个隐藏信号，但朴素的方法要么在客户端众多时无法扩展（因为每个客户端的独立水印会随 K 增大而稀释），要么赋予任何单个客户端验证并可能移除水印的能力。

sentences.en: We introduce $(t,K)$-threshold watermarking: clients collaboratively embed a shared watermark during training, while only coalitions of at least $t$ clients can reconstruct the watermark key and verify a suspect model.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 (t,K) 阈值水印：客户端在训练期间协作地嵌入一个共享水印，而只有至少 t 个客户端的联盟才能重建水印密钥并验证可疑模型。

sentences.en: We secret-share the watermark key $\tau$ so that coalitions of fewer than $t$ clients cannot reconstruct it, and verification can be performed without revealing $\tau$ in the clear.
sentences.zh: 我们对水印密钥进行秘密共享，使得少于 t 个客户端的联盟无法重建它，并且可以在不泄露明文的情况下完成验证。

sentences.en: We instantiate our protocol in the white-box setting and evaluate it on image classification tasks on both IID and non-IID partitions, as well as  language models fine-tuning setting.
sentences.zh: 我们在白盒设定中实例化了我们的协议，并在 IID 与非 IID 划分的图像分类任务以及语言模型微调设定上对其进行了评估。

sentences.en: Our watermark remains detectable at scale ($K=128$) with minimal accuracy loss and stays above the detection threshold ($z\ge 4$) under attacks including adaptive fine-tuning using up to 20% of the training data.
sentences.zh: 我们的水印在大规模（K=128）下仍保持可检测且精度损失极小，并且在进行使用多达 20% 训练数据的自适应微调等攻击下仍保持在检测阈值（z≥4）之上。

sentences.en: Code is available at \url{https://github.com/tameemalaa/collaborative-threshold-watermark}.
sentences.zh: 代码可在 \url{https://github.com/tameemalaa/collaborative-threshold-watermark} 获取。
